   795→
   796→// During rebase/cherry-pick/revert operations, phase transitions are skipped entirely.
   797→//
   798→
   799→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit(ctx context.Context) error { //nolint:unparam // error return is part of the hook contract; callers check it
   800→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   801→
   802→	_, openRepoSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "open_repository_and_head")
   803→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   804→	if err != nil {
   805→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   806→		openRepoSpan.End()
   807→		return nil
   808→	}
   809→
   810→	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
   811→	head, err := repo.Head()
   812→	if err != nil {
   813→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   814→		openRepoSpan.End()
   815→		return nil
   816→	}
   817→
   818→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   819→	if err != nil {

820→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   821→		openRepoSpan.End()
   822→		return nil
   823→	}
   824→
   825→	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   826→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   827→	openRepoSpan.End()
   828→
   829→	if !found {
   830→		// No trailer — user removed it or it was never added (mid-turn commit).
   831→		// Still update BaseCommit for active sessions so future commits can match.
   832→		s.postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly(ctx, head)
   833→		return nil
   834→	}
   835→
   836→	_, findSessionsSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "find_sessions_for_worktree")
   837→	worktreePath, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   838→	if err != nil {
   839→		findSessionsSpan.RecordError(err)
   840→		findSessionsSpan.End()
   841→		return nil
   842→	}
   843→
   844→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   845→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(ctx, worktreePath)
   846→	findSessionsSpan.RecordError(err)
   847→	findSessionsSpan.End()
   848→
   849→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   850→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: no active sessions despite trailer",
   851→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   852→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   853→		)
   854→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   855→	}
   856→
   857→	// Build transition context
   858→	isRebase := isGitSequenceOperation(ctx)
   859→	transitionCtx := session.TransitionContext{
   860→		IsRebaseInProgress: isRebase,
   861→	}
   862→
   863→	if isRebase {
   864→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: rebase/sequence in progress, skipping phase transitions",
   865→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   866→		)
   867→	}
   868→
   869→	// Track shadow branch names and whether they can be deleted
   870→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   871→	// Track active sessions that were NOT condensed — their shadow branches must be preserved
   872→	uncondensedActiveOnBranch := make(map[string]bool)
   873→
   874→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   875→
   876→	// Pre-resolve HEAD tree and parent tree once for the entire PostCommit.
   877→	// These are immutable within this hook invocation and used by multiple
   878→	// per-session functions (filesOverlapWithContent, filesWithRemainingAgentChanges,
   879→	// calculateSessionAttributions).
   880→	_, resolveTreesSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "resolve_commit_trees")
   881→	var headTree *object.Tree
   882→	if t, err := commit.Tree(); err == nil {
   883→		headTree = t
   884→	}
   885→	var parentTree *object.Tree
   886→	if commit.NumParents() > 0 {
   887→		if parent, err := commit.Parent(0); err == nil {
   888→			if t, err := parent.Tree(); err == nil {
   889→				parentTree = t
   890→			}
   891→		}
   892→	}
   893→
   894→	committedFileSet := filesChangedInCommit(ctx, worktreePath, commit, headTree, parentTree)
   895→	resolveTreesSpan.End()
   896→
   897→	for _, state := range sessions {
   898→		// Skip fully-condensed ended sessions — no work remains.
   899→		// These sessions only persist for LastCheckpointID (amend trailer reuse).
   900→		if state.FullyCondensed && state.Phase == session.PhaseEnded {
   901→			continue
   902→		}
   903→		s.postCommitProcessSession(ctx, repo, state, &transitionCtx, checkpointID,
   904→			head, commit, newHead, worktreePath, headTree, parentTree, committedFileSet,
   905→			shadowBranchesToDelete, uncondensedActiveOnBranch)
   906→	}
   907→
   908→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active
   909→	// or were condensed during this PostCommit.
   910→	_, cleanupBranchesSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "cleanup_shadow_branches")
   911→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   912→		if uncondensedActiveOnBranch[shadowBranchName] {
   913→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: preserving shadow branch (active session exists)",
   914→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   915→			)
   916→			continue
   917→		}
   918→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   919→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   920→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   921→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   922→		} else {
   923→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   924→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   925→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   926→			)
   927→		}
   928→	}
   929→	cleanupBranchesSpan.End()
   930→
   931→	return nil
   932→}
   933→
   934→// postCommitProcessSession handles a single session within the PostCommit loop.
   935→// Pre-resolved git objects (headTree, parentTree) are shared across all sessions;
   936→// per-session shadow ref/tree are resolved once here and threaded through sub-calls.
   937→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) postCommitProcessSession(
   938→	ctx context.Context,
   939→	repo *git.Repository,
   940→	state *SessionState,
   941→	transitionCtx *session.TransitionContext,
   942→	checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   943→	head *plumbing.Reference,
   944→	commit *object.Commit,
   945→	newHead string,
   946→	repoDir string,
   947→	headTree, parentTree *object.Tree,
   948→	committedFileSet map[string]struct{},
   949→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{},
   950→	uncondensedActiveOnBranch map[string]bool,
   951→) {
   952→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   953→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   954→
   955→	// Pre-resolve shadow branch ref and tree for this session.
   956→	// These are read 4+ times across sessionHasNewContent, filesOverlapWithContent,
   957→	// CondenseSession, filesWithRemainingAgentChanges, and calculateSessionAttributions.
   958→	_, resolveShadowBranchSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "resolve_shadow_branch")
   959→	var shadowRef *plumbing.Reference
   960→	var shadowTree *object.Tree
   961→	if ref, refErr := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName), true); refErr == nil {
   962→		shadowRef = ref
   963→		if sc, scErr := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash()); scErr == nil {
   964→			if st, stErr := sc.Tree(); stErr == nil {
   965→				shadowTree = st
   966→			}
   967→		}
   968→	}
   969→	resolveShadowBranchSpan.End()
   970→
   971→	// Check for new content (needed for TransitionContext and condensation).
   972→	// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content exists so we
   973→	// don't silently skip data that should have been condensed.
   974→	//
   975→	// For ACTIVE sessions: the commit has a checkpoint trailer (verified above),
   976→	// meaning PrepareCommitMsg already determined this commit is session-related.
   977→	// The trailer is only added when either:
   978→	//   - No TTY (agent/subagent committing) — added unconditionally
   979→	//   - TTY (human committing) — added after content detection confirmed agent work
   980→	// In both cases, PrepareCommitMsg already validated this commit. We trust
   981→	// that decision here. Transcript-based re-validation is unreliable because
   982→	// subagent transcripts may not be available yet (subagent still running).
   983→	_, checkContentSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "check_session_content")
   984→	var hasNew bool
   985→	if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   986→		hasNew = true
   987→	} else {
   988→		var contentErr error
   989→		hasNew, contentErr = s.sessionHasNewContent(ctx, repo, state, contentCheckOpts{shadowTree: shadowTree})
   990→		if contentErr != nil {
   991→			hasNew = true
   992→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: error checking session content, assuming new content",
   993→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   994→				slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()),
   995→			)
   996→		}
   997→	}
   998→	transitionCtx.HasFilesTouched = len(state.FilesTouched) > 0
   999→
  1000→	// Save FilesTouched BEFORE TransitionAndLog — the handler's condensation
  1001→	// clears it, but we need the original list for carry-forward computation.
  1002→	// Only fall back to transcript extraction for ACTIVE sessions — IDLE/ENDED
  1003→	// sessions have FilesTouched already populated by SaveStep/mergeFilesTouched.
  1004→	var filesTouchedBefore []string
  1005→	if state.Phase.IsActive() {
  1006→		filesTouchedBefore = s.resolveFilesTouched(ctx, state)
  1007→	} else if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
  1008→		filesTouchedBefore = make([]string, len(state.FilesTouched))
  1009→		copy(filesTouchedBefore, state.FilesTouched)
  1010→	}
  1011→	checkContentSpan.End()
  1012→
  1013→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward prep",
  1014→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1015→		slog.Bool("is_active", state.Phase.IsActive()),
  1016→		slog.String("transcript_path", state.TranscriptPath),
  1017→		slog.Int("files_touched_before", len(filesTouchedBefore)),
  1018→		slog.Any("files", filesTouchedBefore),
  1019→	)

1020→
  1021→	// Run the state machine transition with handler for strategy-specific actions.
  1022→	_, transitionAndCondenseSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "transition_and_condense")
  1023→	handler := &postCommitActionHandler{
  1024→		s:                      s,
  1025→		ctx:                    ctx,
  1026→		repo:                   repo,
  1027→		checkpointID:           checkpointID,
  1028→		head:                   head,
  1029→		commit:                 commit,
  1030→		newHead:                newHead,
  1031→		repoDir:                repoDir,
  1032→		shadowBranchName:       shadowBranchName,
  1033→		shadowBranchesToDelete: shadowBranchesToDelete,
  1034→		committedFileSet:       committedFileSet,
  1035→		hasNew:                 hasNew,
  1036→		filesTouchedBefore:     filesTouchedBefore,
  1037→		headTree:               headTree,
  1038→		parentTree:             parentTree,
  1039→		shadowRef:              shadowRef,
  1040→		shadowTree:             shadowTree,
  1041→	}
  1042→
  1043→	if err := TransitionAndLog(ctx, state, session.EventGitCommit, *transitionCtx, handler); err != nil {
  1044→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit action handler error",
  1045→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1046→	}
  1047→	transitionAndCondenseSpan.End()
  1048→
  1049→	// Record checkpoint ID for ACTIVE sessions so HandleTurnEnd can finalize
  1050→	// with full transcript. IDLE/ENDED sessions already have complete transcripts.
  1051→	// NOTE: This check runs AFTER TransitionAndLog updated the phase. It relies on
  1052→	// ACTIVE + GitCommit → ACTIVE (phase stays ACTIVE). If that state machine
  1053→	// transition ever changed, this guard would silently stop recording IDs.
  1054→	if handler.condensed && state.Phase.IsActive() {
  1055→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = append(state.TurnCheckpointIDs, checkpointID.String())
  1056→	}
  1057→
  1058→	// Carry forward remaining uncommitted files so the next commit gets its
  1059→	// own checkpoint ID. This applies to ALL phases — if a user splits their
  1060→	// commit across two `git commit` invocations, each gets a 1:1 checkpoint.
  1061→	// Uses content-aware comparison: if user did `git add -p` and committed
  1062→	// partial changes, the file still has remaining agent changes to carry forward.
  1063→	_, carryForwardSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "carry_forward_files")
  1064→	if handler.condensed {
  1065→		if handler.forceCondensed {
  1066→			state.FilesTouched = nil
  1067→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: skip carry-forward (force-condensed ended session)",
  1068→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1069→			)
  1070→		} else {
  1071→			remainingFiles := filesWithRemainingAgentChanges(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, commit, filesTouchedBefore, committedFileSet, overlapOpts{
  1072→				headTree:   headTree,
  1073→				shadowTree: shadowTree,
  1074→			})
  1075→			state.FilesTouched = remainingFiles
  1076→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward decision (content-aware)",
  1077→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1078→				slog.Int("files_touched_before", len(filesTouchedBefore)),
  1079→				slog.Int("committed_files", len(committedFileSet)),
  1080→				slog.Int("remaining_files", len(remainingFiles)),
  1081→				slog.Any("remaining", remainingFiles),
  1082→				slog.Any("committed_files", committedFileSet),
  1083→			)
  1084→			if len(remainingFiles) > 0 {
  1085→				s.carryForwardToNewShadowBranch(ctx, repo, state, remainingFiles)
  1086→			}
  1087→		}
  1088→
  1089→		// Clear filesystem prompt.txt only when ALL files are committed.
  1090→		// If carry-forward files remain, the prompt must persist so the next
  1091→		// condensation (triggered by the next commit) can read it.
  1092→		if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
  1093→			clearFilesystemPrompt(ctx, state.SessionID)
  1094→		}
  1095→	}
  1096→	carryForwardSpan.End()
  1097→
  1098→	// Mark ENDED sessions as fully condensed when there's nothing left to do.
  1099→	// Either we just condensed (no carry-forward remains) or there was never any
  1100→	// new content. PostCommit will skip these on future commits; they persist only
  1101→	// for LastCheckpointID (amend trailer restoration).
  1102→	if state.Phase == session.PhaseEnded && len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 && (handler.condensed || !hasNew) {
  1103→		state.FullyCondensed = true
  1104→	}
  1105→
  1106→	// Save the updated state
  1107→	_, saveSessionStateSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "save_session_state")
  1108→	if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
  1109→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session state",
  1110→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),

// TestPostCommit_RecentEndedSession_NotForceCondensed verifies that an ENDED
// session within the forceCondenseThreshold is NOT force-condensed — the user
// may still commit those files in a separate commit.
func TestPostCommit_RecentEndedSession_NotForceCondensed(t *testing.T) {
	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
	t.Chdir(dir)

	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}

	// Create ENDED session that ended 5 minutes ago (within threshold)
	endedSessionID := "recent-ended-session"
	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, endedSessionID)

	endedState, err := s.loadSessionState(context.Background(), endedSessionID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	recentEndedAt := time.Now().Add(-5 * time.Minute) // within forceCondenseThreshold
	endedState.Phase = session.PhaseEnded
	endedState.EndedAt = &recentEndedAt
	endedState.FilesTouched = []string{"test.txt"}
	endedState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0
	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(context.Background(), endedState))

	originalStepCount := endedState.StepCount

	// Create an unrelated commit with checkpoint trailer
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "unrelated.txt"), []byte("unrelated"), 0o644))
	wt, err := repo.Worktree()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = wt.Add("unrelated.txt")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	cpID := "rc01rc02rc03"
	commitMsg := "unrelated commit\n\n" + trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + cpID + "\n"
	_, err = wt.Commit(commitMsg, &git.CommitOptions{
		Author: &object.Signature{Name: "Test", Email: "test@test.com", When: time.Now()},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// Run PostCommit
	err = s.PostCommit(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// Verify: recent ENDED session was NOT force-condensed
	endedState, err = s.loadSessionState(context.Background(), endedSessionID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, originalStepCount, endedState.StepCount,
		"StepCount should be unchanged — session is too recent for force-condensation")
	assert.False(t, endedState.FullyCondensed,
		"Recent ENDED session should NOT be marked FullyCondensed")
	assert.Equal(t, []string{"test.txt"}, endedState.FilesTouched,
		"FilesTouched should be preserved for future commits")
}

   226→// hasUserContent checks if the message has any content besides comments and our trailer.
   227→func hasUserContent(message string) bool {
   228→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   229→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   230→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   231→		// Skip empty lines
   232→		if trimmed == "" {
   233→			continue
   234→		}
   235→		// Skip comment lines
   236→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "#") {
   237→			continue
   238→		}
   239→		// Skip our trailer line
   240→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, trailerPrefix) {
   241→			continue
   242→		}
   243→		// Found user content
   244→		return true
   245→	}
   246→	return false
   247→}

   250→func stripCheckpointTrailer(message string) string {
   251→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   252→	var result []string
   253→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {

   429→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   430→	}
   431→
   432→	// Determine agent type and last prompt from session
   433→	var agentType types.AgentType
   434→	var lastPrompt string
   435→	if len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   436→		firstSession := sessionsWithContent[0]
   437→		if firstSession.AgentType != "" {
   438→			agentType = firstSession.AgentType
   439→		}
   440→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(ctx, repo, firstSession)
   441→	}
   442→
   443→	// Prepare prompt for display: collapse newlines/whitespace, then truncate (rune-safe)
   444→	displayPrompt := stringutil.TruncateRunes(stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(lastPrompt), 80, "...")
   445→
   446→	// Load commit_linking setting to decide whether to prompt
   447→	commitLinking := settings.CommitLinkingPrompt // safe default
   448→	if stngs, loadErr := settings.Load(ctx); loadErr == nil {
   449→		commitLinking = stngs.GetCommitLinking()
   450→	}
   451→	resolveMetadataSpan.End()
   452→
   453→	// Add trailer differently based on commit source
   454→	// NOTE: TTY confirmation (askConfirmTTY) is intentionally NOT wrapped in a span
   455→	// because it blocks on user input and would skew timing.
   456→	switch source {
   457→	case "message":
   458→		// Using -m or -F: behavior depends on TTY availability and commit_linking setting
   459→		switch {
   460→		case !hasTTY():
   461→			// No TTY (agent subprocess, CI) — auto-link without prompting
   462→			message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   463→		case commitLinking == settings.CommitLinkingAlways:
   464→			// User previously chose "always" — auto-link without prompting
   465→			message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   466→		default:
   467→			// Human at terminal — prompt interactively
   468→			header := "Entire: Active " + string(agentType) + " session detected"
   469→			var details []string
   470→			if displayPrompt != "" {
   471→				details = append(details, "Last prompt: "+displayPrompt)
   472→			}
   473→
   474→			result := askConfirmTTY(header, details, "Link this commit to session context?", true)
   475→			if result == ttyResultSkip {
   476→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: user declined trailer",
   477→					slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   478→					slog.String("source", source),
   479→				)
   480→				return nil
   481→			}
   482→			if result == ttyResultLinkAlways {
   483→				// Persist preference so future commits auto-link (non-fatal if it fails)
   484→				if saveErr := saveCommitLinkingAlways(ctx); saveErr != nil {
   485→					logging.Warn(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: failed to save commit_linking=always",
   486→						slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()),
   487→					)
   488→				}
   489→			}
   490→			message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   491→		}
   492→	default:
   493→		// Normal editor flow: add trailer with explanatory comment (will be stripped by git)
   494→		message = addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message, checkpointID, string(agentType), displayPrompt)
   495→	}
   496→
   497→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer added",
   498→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   499→		slog.String("source", source),
   500→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   501→	)
   502→
   503→	// Write updated message back
   504→	_, writeCommitMessageSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "write_commit_message")
   505→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil { //nolint:gosec // path from git hook arg
   506→		writeCommitMessageSpan.RecordError(err)
   507→		writeCommitMessageSpan.End()
   508→		return nil
   509→	}
   510→	writeCommitMessageSpan.End()
   511→
   512→	return nil
   513→}

   515→// handleAmendCommitMsg handles the prepare-commit-msg hook for amend operations
   516→// (source="commit"). It preserves existing trailers or restores from LastCheckpointID.
   517→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) handleAmendCommitMsg(ctx context.Context, commitMsgFile string) error {
   518→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   519→	// Read current commit message
   520→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   521→	if err != nil {
   522→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   523→	}
   524→
   525→	message := string(content)
   526→
   527→	// If message already has a trailer, keep it unchanged
   528→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   529→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend preserves existing trailer",
   530→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   531→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   532→		)
   533→		return nil
   534→	}
   535→
   536→	// No trailer in message — check if any session has LastCheckpointID to restore
   537→	worktreePath, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   538→	if err != nil {
   539→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   540→	}
   541→
   542→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(ctx, worktreePath)
   543→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   544→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions - nothing to restore
   545→	}
   546→
   547→	// For amend, HEAD^ is the commit being amended, and HEAD is where we are now.
   548→	// We need to match sessions whose BaseCommit equals HEAD (the commit being amended
   549→	// was created from this base). This prevents stale sessions from injecting
   550→	// unrelated checkpoint IDs.
   551→	repo, repoErr := OpenRepository(ctx)
   552→	if repoErr != nil {
   553→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   554→	}
   555→	head, headErr := repo.Head()
   556→	if headErr != nil {
   557→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   558→	}
   559→	currentHead := head.Hash().String()
   560→
   561→	// Find first matching session with LastCheckpointID to restore.
   562→	// LastCheckpointID is set after condensation completes.
   563→	for _, state := range sessions {
   564→		if state.BaseCommit != currentHead {
   565→			continue
   566→		}
   567→		if state.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   568→			continue
   569→		}
   570→		cpID := state.LastCheckpointID
   571→		source := "LastCheckpointID"
   572→
   573→		// Restore the trailer
   574→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
   575→		if writeErr := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); writeErr != nil { //nolint:gosec // path from git hook arg
   576→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   577→		}
   578→
   579→		logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: restored trailer on amend",
   580→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   581→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
   582→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   583→			slog.String("source", source),
   584→		)
   585→		return nil
   586→	}
   587→
   588→	// No checkpoint ID found - leave message unchanged
   589→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend with no checkpoint to restore",
   590→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   591→	)
   592→	return nil
   593→}

   595→// PostCommit is called by the git post-commit hook after a commit is created.
   596→// Uses the session state machine to determine what action to take per session:
   597→//   - ACTIVE → condense immediately (each commit gets its own checkpoint)
   598→//   - IDLE → condense immediately
   599→//   - ENDED → condense if files touched, discard if empty

595→// PostCommit is called by the git post-commit hook after a commit is created.
   596→// Uses the session state machine to determine what action to take per session:
   597→//   - ACTIVE → condense immediately (each commit gets its own checkpoint)
   598→//   - IDLE → condense immediately
   599→//   - ENDED → condense if files touched, discard if empty
   600→//
   601→// After condensation for ACTIVE sessions, remaining uncommitted files are
   602→// carried forward to a new shadow branch so the next commit gets its own checkpoint.
   603→//
   604→// Shadow branches are only deleted when ALL sessions sharing the branch are non-active
   605→// and were condensed during this PostCommit.
   606→
   607→// postCommitActionHandler implements session.ActionHandler for PostCommit.
   608→// Each session in the loop gets its own handler with per-session context.
   609→// Handler methods use the *State parameter from ApplyTransition (same pointer
   610→// as the state being transitioned) rather than capturing state separately.
   611→type postCommitActionHandler struct {
   612→	s                      *ManualCommitStrategy
   613→	ctx                    context.Context
   614→	repo                   *git.Repository
   615→	checkpointID           id.CheckpointID
   616→	head                   *plumbing.Reference
   617→	commit                 *object.Commit
   618→	newHead                string
   619→	repoDir                string
   620→	shadowBranchName       string
   621→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{}
   622→	committedFileSet       map[string]struct{}
   623→	hasNew                 bool
   624→	filesTouchedBefore     []string
   625→
   626→	// Cached git objects — resolved once per PostCommit invocation to avoid
   627→	// redundant reads across filesOverlapWithContent, filesWithRemainingAgentChanges,
   628→	// CondenseSession, and calculateSessionAttributions.
   629→	headTree   *object.Tree        // HEAD commit tree (shared across all sessions)
   630→	parentTree *object.Tree        // HEAD's first parent tree (shared, nil for initial commits)
   631→	shadowRef  *plumbing.Reference // Per-session shadow branch ref (nil if branch doesn't exist)
   632→	shadowTree *object.Tree        // Per-session shadow commit tree (nil if branch doesn't exist)
   633→
   634→	// Output: set by handler methods, read by caller after TransitionAndLog.
   635→	condensed bool
   636→}

   638→func (h *postCommitActionHandler) HandleCondense(state *session.State) error {
   639→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(h.ctx, "checkpoint")
   640→	shouldCondense := h.shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck(state.Phase.IsActive(), state.LastInteractionTime)
   641→
   642→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: HandleCondense decision",
   643→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   644→		slog.String("phase", string(state.Phase)),
   645→		slog.Bool("has_new", h.hasNew),
   646→		slog.Bool("should_condense", shouldCondense),
   647→		slog.String("shadow_branch", h.shadowBranchName),
   648→	)
   649→
   650→	if shouldCondense {
   651→		h.condensed = h.s.condenseAndUpdateState(h.ctx, h.repo, h.checkpointID, state, h.head, h.shadowBranchName, h.shadowBranchesToDelete, h.committedFileSet, condenseOpts{
   652→			shadowRef:      h.shadowRef,
   653→			headTree:       h.headTree,
   654→			repoDir:        h.repoDir,
   655→			headCommitHash: h.newHead,
   656→		})
   657→	} else {
   658→		h.s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(h.ctx, state, h.newHead)
   659→	}
   660→	return nil
   661→}

   663→func (h *postCommitActionHandler) HandleCondenseIfFilesTouched(state *session.State) error {
   664→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(h.ctx, "checkpoint")
   665→	shouldCondense := len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 && h.shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck(state.Phase.IsActive(), state.LastInteractionTime)
   666→
   667→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: HandleCondenseIfFilesTouched decision",
   668→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   669→		slog.String("phase", string(state.Phase)),
   670→		slog.Bool("has_new", h.hasNew),
   671→		slog.Int("files_touched", len(state.FilesTouched)),
   672→		slog.Bool("should_condense", shouldCondense),
   673→		slog.String("shadow_branch", h.shadowBranchName),
   674→	)
   675→
   676→	if shouldCondense {
   677→		h.condensed = h.s.condenseAndUpdateState(h.ctx, h.repo, h.checkpointID, state, h.head, h.shadowBranchName, h.shadowBranchesToDelete, h.committedFileSet, condenseOpts{
   678→			shadowRef:      h.shadowRef,
   679→			headTree:       h.headTree,
   680→			repoDir:        h.repoDir,
   681→			headCommitHash: h.newHead,
   682→		})
   683→	} else {
   684→		h.s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(h.ctx, state, h.newHead)
   685→	}
   686→	return nil
   687→}

   689→// shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck returns true if the session should be condensed
   690→// into this commit. Active sessions with recent interaction always condense
   691→// (bypasses overlap check). Stale ACTIVE and IDLE/ENDED sessions require
   692→// file overlap evidence between tracked files and committed files.
   693→func (h *postCommitActionHandler) shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck(isActive bool, lastInteraction *time.Time) bool {
   694→	if !h.hasNew {
   695→		return false
   696→	}
   697→	// ACTIVE sessions with recent interaction: skip the overlap check.
   698→	// PrepareCommitMsg already validated this commit is session-related
   699→	// (added trailer). The overlap check is only meaningful when we need
   700→	// heuristic evidence that a commit was related to the session.
   701→	//
   702→	// We check LastInteractionTime to avoid condensing stale ACTIVE sessions
   703→	// (agent killed without Stop hook) into every subsequent commit. A stale
   704→	// session has no recent interaction and falls through to the overlap check.
   705→	if isActive && isRecentInteraction(lastInteraction) {
   706→		return true
   707→	}
   708→	if len(h.filesTouchedBefore) == 0 {
   709→		return false // No files tracked = no overlap evidence
   710→	}
   711→	// Only check files that were actually changed in this commit.
   712→	// Without this, files that exist in the tree but weren't changed
   713→	// would pass the "modified file" check in filesOverlapWithContent
   714→	// (because the file exists in the parent tree), causing stale
   715→	// sessions to be incorrectly condensed.
   716→	var committedTouchedFiles []string
   717→	for _, f := range h.filesTouchedBefore {
   718→		if _, ok := h.committedFileSet[f]; ok {
   719→			committedTouchedFiles = append(committedTouchedFiles, f)
   720→		}
   721→	}
   722→	if len(committedTouchedFiles) == 0 {
   723→		return false
   724→	}
   725→	return filesOverlapWithContent(h.ctx, h.repo, h.shadowBranchName, h.commit, committedTouchedFiles, overlapOpts{
   726→		headTree:      h.headTree,
   727→		shadowTree:    h.shadowTree,
   728→		parentTree:    h.parentTree,
   729→		hasParentTree: true,
   730→	})
   731→}
   732→
   733→// activeSessionInteractionThreshold is the maximum age of LastInteractionTime
   734→// for an ACTIVE session to be considered genuinely active. 24h is generous
   735→// because LastInteractionTime only updates at TurnStart, not per-tool-call.
   736→const activeSessionInteractionThreshold = 24 * time.Hour
   737→
   738→// isRecentInteraction returns true if lastInteraction is non-nil and within
   739→// activeSessionInteractionThreshold of now.
   740→func isRecentInteraction(lastInteraction *time.Time) bool {
   741→	return lastInteraction != nil && time.Since(*lastInteraction) < activeSessionInteractionThreshold
   742→}
   743→
   744→func (h *postCommitActionHandler) HandleDiscardIfNoFiles(state *session.State) error {
   745→	if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   746→		logging.Debug(logging.WithComponent(h.ctx, "checkpoint"), "post-commit: skipping empty ended session (no files to condense)",
   747→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   748→		)
   749→	}
   750→	h.s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(h.ctx, state, h.newHead)
   751→	return nil
   752→}

   756→	return nil

   759→// During rebase/cherry-pick/revert operations, phase transitions are skipped entirely.
   760→//
   761→
   762→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit(ctx context.Context) error { //nolint:unparam // error return is part of the hook contract; callers check it
   763→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   764→
   765→	_, openRepoSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "open_repository_and_head")
   766→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   767→	if err != nil {
   768→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   769→		openRepoSpan.End()
   770→		return nil
   771→	}
   772→
   773→	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
   774→	head, err := repo.Head()
   775→	if err != nil {
   776→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   777→		openRepoSpan.End()
   778→		return nil
   779→	}
   780→
   781→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   782→	if err != nil {
   783→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   784→		openRepoSpan.End()
   785→		return nil
   786→	}
   787→
   788→	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   789→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   790→	openRepoSpan.End()
   791→
   792→	if !found {
   793→		// No trailer — user removed it or it was never added (mid-turn commit).
   794→		// Still update BaseCommit for active sessions so future commits can match.
   795→		s.postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly(ctx, head)
   796→		return nil
   797→	}
   798→
   799→	_, findSessionsSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "find_sessions_from_shadow_tree")
   800→	worktreePath, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   801→	if err != nil {
   802→		findSessionsSpan.RecordError(err)
   803→		findSessionsSpan.End()
   804→		return nil
   805→	}
   806→
   807→	// Use shadow-tree-based session discovery: only load sessions whose
   808→	// BaseCommit == parent of HEAD (i.e., sessions on the current shadow branch).
   809→	// Sessions from different base commits are structurally irrelevant — their
   810→	// ENDED BaseCommit is frozen, so they belong to a different checkpoint epoch.
   811→	// This gives O(1) PostCommit regardless of total accumulated session count.
   812→	parentHash := ""
   813→	if commit.NumParents() > 0 {
   814→		if parent, pErr := commit.Parent(0); pErr == nil {
   815→			parentHash = parent.Hash.String()
   816→		}
   817→	}
   818→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsFromShadowTree(ctx, repo, parentHash, worktreePath)
   819→	findSessionsSpan.RecordError(err)
   820→	findSessionsSpan.End()
   821→
   822→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   823→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: no active sessions despite trailer",
   824→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   825→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   826→		)
   827→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   828→	}
   829→
   830→	// Build transition context
   831→	isRebase := isGitSequenceOperation(ctx)
   832→	transitionCtx := session.TransitionContext{
   833→		IsRebaseInProgress: isRebase,
   834→	}
   835→
   836→	if isRebase {
   837→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: rebase/sequence in progress, skipping phase transitions",
   838→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   839→		)
   840→	}
   841→
   842→	// Track shadow branch names and whether they can be deleted
   843→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   844→	// Track active sessions that were NOT condensed — their shadow branches must be preserved
   845→	uncondensedActiveOnBranch := make(map[string]bool)
   846→
   847→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   848→
   849→	// Pre-resolve HEAD tree and parent tree once for the entire PostCommit.
   850→	// These are immutable within this hook invocation and used by multiple
   851→	// per-session functions (filesOverlapWithContent, filesWithRemainingAgentChanges,
   852→	// calculateSessionAttributions).
   853→	_, resolveTreesSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "resolve_commit_trees")
   854→	var headTree *object.Tree
   855→	if t, err := commit.Tree(); err == nil {
   856→		headTree = t
   857→	}
   858→	var parentTree *object.Tree
   859→	if commit.NumParents() > 0 {
   860→		if parent, err := commit.Parent(0); err == nil {
   861→			if t, err := parent.Tree(); err == nil {
   862→				parentTree = t
   863→			}
   864→		}
   865→	}
   866→
   867→	committedFileSet := filesChangedInCommit(ctx, worktreePath, commit, headTree, parentTree)
   868→	resolveTreesSpan.End()
   869→
   870→	for _, state := range sessions {
   871→		// Skip fully-condensed ended sessions — no work remains.
   872→		// These sessions only persist for LastCheckpointID (amend trailer reuse).
   873→		if state.FullyCondensed && state.Phase == session.PhaseEnded {
   874→			continue
   875→		}
   876→		s.postCommitProcessSession(ctx, repo, state, &transitionCtx, checkpointID,
   877→			head, commit, newHead, worktreePath, headTree, parentTree, committedFileSet,
   878→			shadowBranchesToDelete, uncondensedActiveOnBranch)
   879→	}
   880→
   881→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active
   882→	// or were condensed during this PostCommit.
   883→	_, cleanupBranchesSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "cleanup_shadow_branches")
   884→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   885→		if uncondensedActiveOnBranch[shadowBranchName] {
   886→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: preserving shadow branch (active session exists)",
   887→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   888→			)
   889→			continue
   890→		}
   891→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   892→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   893→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   894→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   895→		} else {
   896→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   897→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   898→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   899→			)
   900→		}
   901→	}
   902→	cleanupBranchesSpan.End()
   903→
   904→	return nil
   905→}
   906→
   907→// postCommitProcessSession handles a single session within the PostCommit loop.
   908→// Pre-resolved git objects (headTree, parentTree) are shared across all sessions;
   909→// per-session shadow ref/tree are resolved once here and threaded through sub-calls.
   910→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) postCommitProcessSession(
   911→	ctx context.Context,
   912→	repo *git.Repository,
   913→	state *SessionState,
   914→	transitionCtx *session.TransitionContext,
   915→	checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   916→	head *plumbing.Reference,
   917→	commit *object.Commit,
   918→	newHead string,
   919→	repoDir string,
   920→	headTree, parentTree *object.Tree,
   921→	committedFileSet map[string]struct{},
   922→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{},
   923→	uncondensedActiveOnBranch map[string]bool,
   924→) {
   925→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   926→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   927→
   928→	// Pre-resolve shadow branch ref and tree for this session.
   929→	// These are read 4+ times across sessionHasNewContent, filesOverlapWithContent,
   930→	// CondenseSession, filesWithRemainingAgentChanges, and calculateSessionAttributions.
   931→	_, resolveShadowBranchSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "resolve_shadow_branch")

848→// CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed condenses an ENDED session and marks it
   849→// FullyCondensed in one operation. Used by the session stop hook to eagerly
   850→// clean up sessions so PostCommit doesn't have to process them.
   851→//
   852→// This does NOT call CondenseSessionByID because that method has two behaviors
   853→// we don't want: (1) it calls clearSessionState when no shadow branch exists
   854→// (deletes the state file entirely), and (2) it sets Phase = IDLE. Instead,
   855→// we inline the condensation logic with ENDED-appropriate behavior.
   856→//
   857→// Fail-open: if condensation fails, the session is left in its current state
   858→// and PostCommit's force-condense safety net will catch it later.
   859→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   860→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   861→
   862→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   863→	if err != nil {
   864→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   865→	}
   866→	if state == nil {
   867→		return nil // No state file
   868→	}
   869→
   870→	// Sessions with FilesTouched must be processed by PostCommit for carry-forward
   871→	// tracking — each user commit that overlaps with tracked files gets its own
   872→	// checkpoint. Eagerly condensing here would prevent that 1:1 linkage.
   873→	if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   874→		return nil
   875→	}
   876→
   877→	// Only condense if there's uncondensed data
   878→	if state.StepCount <= 0 {
   879→		// No data and no files — mark FullyCondensed
   880→		state.FullyCondensed = true
   881→		return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
   882→	}
   883→
   884→	// Check if shadow branch exists — required for condensation
   885→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   886→	if err != nil {
   887→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to open repository",
   888→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   889→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   890→		)
   891→		return nil // fail-open
   892→	}
   893→
   894→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   895→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   896→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   897→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   898→
   899→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   900→		// No shadow branch = no checkpoint data to condense.
   901→		// Unlike CondenseSessionByID, we do NOT delete the state file.
   902→		logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense: no shadow branch",
   903→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   904→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   905→		)
   906→		state.StepCount = 0
   907→		state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)

### Key Insight

- Shadow branch name is `entire/<baseCommit[:7]>-<worktreeHash[:6]>`
- The shadow tree contains `.entire/metadata/<session-id>/` directories — one per session with data
- ENDED sessions' BaseCommit is frozen (updateBaseCommitIfChanged skips non-active sessions at line 1196)
- So: BaseCommit == parent of HEAD means the session is on the current shadow branch. BaseCommit != parent means it's either from a different branch or structurally stale — skip it either way.

- `forceCondenseThreshold` constant and `isStaleEnded()` function in `manual_commit_hooks.go`

**Replace** `findSessionsForWorktree` (which loads ALL state files + does N ref lookups) with a new approach:

1. Get parent commit hash from HEAD
2. Compute worktree hash using `checkpoint.HashWorktreeID(worktreePath)` 
3. Compute shadow branch: `checkpoint.ShadowBranchPrefix + parentHash[:7] + "-" + worktreeHash`
4. Single ref lookup → resolve shadow branch commit → get tree
5. List `.entire/metadata/*` entries in the shadow tree → extract session IDs
6. Load ONLY those session state files via `loadSessionState()`
7. Also load any ACTIVE sessions from state files that might not have shadow branch data yet (they may not have had a SaveStep yet)

Revert the condition at the end of `postCommitProcessSession` to: `handler.condensed && state.Phase == ENDED && len(state.FilesTouched) == 0`
(Remove the `|| !hasNew` expansion)

Remove the force-condense case. The switch becomes just two cases:
- `shouldCondense`: condense normally
- `default`: updateBaseCommitIfChanged

- `lifecycle.go` eager condense call

   309→func calculateSessionAttributions(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState, opts ...attributionOpts) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
   310→	// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
   311→	// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
   312→	// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
   313→	//
   314→	// When shadowRef is nil (agent committed mid-turn before SaveStep),
   315→	// HEAD is used as the shadow tree. This is correct because the agent's
   316→	// commit IS HEAD — there are no user edits between agent work and commit.
   317→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "attribution")
   318→
   319→	var o attributionOpts
   320→	if len(opts) > 0 {
   321→		o = opts[0]
   322→	}
   323→
   324→	headTree := o.headTree
   325→	if headTree == nil {
   326→		headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
   327→		if headErr != nil {
   328→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
   329→				slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
   330→			return nil
   331→		}
   332→
   333→		headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
   334→		if commitErr != nil {
   335→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
   336→				slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
   337→			return nil
   338→		}
   339→
   340→		var treeErr error
   341→		headTree, treeErr = headCommit.Tree()
   342→		if treeErr != nil {
   343→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
   344→				slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
   345→			return nil
   346→		}
   347→	}
   348→
   349→	// Get shadow tree: from pre-resolved cache, shadow branch, or HEAD (agent committed directly).
   350→	shadowTree := o.shadowTree
   351→	if shadowTree == nil {
   352→		if shadowRef != nil {
   353→			shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
   354→			if shadowErr != nil {
   355→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
   356→					slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
   357→					slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
   358→				return nil
   359→			}
   360→			var shadowTreeErr error
   361→			shadowTree, shadowTreeErr = shadowCommit.Tree()
   362→			if shadowTreeErr != nil {
   363→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
   364→					slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
   365→				return nil
   366→			}
   367→		} else {
   368→			// No shadow branch: agent committed mid-turn. Use HEAD as shadow
   369→			// because the agent's work is the commit itself.
   370→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: using HEAD as shadow (no shadow branch)")
   371→			shadowTree = headTree
   372→		}
   373→	}
   374→
   375→	// Get base tree (state before session started)
   376→	var baseTree *object.Tree
   377→	attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   378→	if attrBase == "" {
   379→		attrBase = state.BaseCommit // backward compat
   380→	}
   381→	if baseCommit, baseErr := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(attrBase)); baseErr == nil {
   382→		if tree, baseTErr := baseCommit.Tree(); baseTErr == nil {
   383→			baseTree = tree
   384→		} else {
   385→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base tree unavailable",
   386→				slog.String("error", baseTErr.Error()))
   387→		}
   388→	} else {
   389→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base commit unavailable",
   390→			slog.String("error", baseErr.Error()),
   391→			slog.String("attribution_base", attrBase))
   392→	}
   393→
   394→	// Log accumulated prompt attributions for debugging
   395→	var totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved int
   396→	for i, pa := range state.PromptAttributions {
   397→		totalUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   398→		totalUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   399→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution data",
   400→			slog.Int("checkpoint", pa.CheckpointNumber),
   401→			slog.Int("user_added", pa.UserLinesAdded),
   402→			slog.Int("user_removed", pa.UserLinesRemoved),
   403→			slog.Int("agent_added", pa.AgentLinesAdded),
   404→			slog.Int("agent_removed", pa.AgentLinesRemoved),
   405→			slog.Int("index", i))
   406→	}
   407→
   408→	attribution := CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   409→		ctx,
   410→		baseTree,
   411→		shadowTree,
   412→		headTree,
   413→		sessionData.FilesTouched,
   414→		state.PromptAttributions,
   415→		o.repoDir,
   416→		o.attributionBaseCommit,
   417→		o.headCommitHash,
   418→	)
   419→
   420→	if attribution != nil {
   421→		logging.Info(logCtx, "attribution calculated",
   422→			slog.Int("agent_lines", attribution.AgentLines),
   423→			slog.Int("human_added", attribution.HumanAdded),
   424→			slog.Int("human_modified", attribution.HumanModified),
   425→			slog.Int("human_removed", attribution.HumanRemoved),
   426→			slog.Int("total_committed", attribution.TotalCommitted),
   427→			slog.Float64("agent_percentage", attribution.AgentPercentage),
   428→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_added", totalUserAdded),
   429→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_removed", totalUserRemoved),
   430→			slog.Int("files_touched", len(sessionData.FilesTouched)))
   431→	}
   432→
   433→	return attribution
   434→}

   465→		// Only wait for flush when the session is active — for idle/ended sessions the
   466→		// transcript is already fully flushed (the Stop hook completed the flush).
   467→		if isActive {
   468→			prepareTranscriptIfNeeded(ctx, ag, liveTranscriptPath)
   469→		}
   470→		if liveData, readErr := os.ReadFile(liveTranscriptPath); readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state
   471→			fullTranscript = string(liveData)
   472→		}
   473→	}
   474→	if fullTranscript == "" {
   475→		// Fall back to shadow branch copy
   476→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   477→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   478→				fullTranscript = content
   479→			}
   480→		} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   481→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   482→				fullTranscript = content
   483→			}
   484→		}
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	// Process transcript based on agent type
   488→	if fullTranscript != "" {
   489→		data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
   490→		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(agentType, fullTranscript)
   491→		// Read prompts from shadow branch tree (source of truth after SaveStep)
   492→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.PromptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   493→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil && content != "" {
   494→				data.Prompts = splitPromptContent(content)
   495→			}
   496→		}
   497→		// Filesystem fallback (written at turn start, covers mid-turn commits)
   498→		if len(data.Prompts) == 0 {
   499→			data.Prompts = readPromptsFromFilesystem(ctx, sessionID)
   500→		}
   501→	}
   502→
   503→	// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
   504→	data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
   505→
   506→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   507→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   508→		data.TokenUsage = agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, checkpointTranscriptStart, "") //TODO: why do we not use here subagents dir?
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	return data, nil
   512→}

   552→// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
   553→// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
   554→// For Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
   555→// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
   556→func countTranscriptItems(agentType types.AgentType, content string) int {
   557→	if content == "" {
   558→		return 0
   559→	}
   560→
   561→	// OpenCode uses export JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]}
   562→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   563→		session, err := opencode.ParseExportSession([]byte(content))
   564→		if err == nil && session != nil {
   565→			return len(session.Messages)
   566→		}
   567→		return 0
   568→	}
   569→
   570→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   571→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   572→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
   573→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   574→			return len(transcript.Messages)
   575→		}
   576→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
   577→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   578→			return 0
   579→		}
   580→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   581→	}
   582→
   583→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   584→	allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   585→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   586→	for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   587→		allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   588→	}
   589→	return len(allLines)
   590→}

   592→// extractUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from transcript content.
   593→// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
   594→func extractUserPrompts(agentType types.AgentType, content string) []string {
   595→	if content == "" {
   596→		return nil
   597→	}
   598→
   599→	// Droid has its own envelope format — use its parser to normalize first
   600→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeFactoryAIDroid {
   601→		lines, _, err := factoryaidroid.ParseDroidTranscriptFromBytes([]byte(content), 0)
   602→		if err != nil {
   603→			return nil
   604→		}
   605→		var prompts []string
   606→		for _, line := range lines {
   607→			if line.Type != transcript.TypeUser {
   608→				continue
   609→			}
   610→			if text := transcript.ExtractUserContent(line.Message); text != "" {
   611→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(text); stripped != "" {
   612→					prompts = append(prompts, stripped)
   613→				}
   614→			}
   615→		}
   616→		return prompts
   617→	}
   618→
   619→	// OpenCode uses JSONL with a different per-line schema than Claude Code
   620→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   621→		prompts, err := opencode.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   622→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   623→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   624→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   625→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   626→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   627→				}
   628→			}
   629→			return cleaned
   630→		}
   631→		return nil
   632→	}
   633→
   634→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   635→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   636→		prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   637→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   638→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   639→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   640→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   641→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   642→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   643→				}
   644→			}
   645→			return cleaned
   646→		}
   647→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
   648→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   649→			return nil
   650→		}
   651→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   652→	}
   653→
   654→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   655→	return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
   656→}

   658→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   659→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   660→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   661→	var prompts []string
   662→	for _, line := range lines {
   663→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   664→		if line == "" {
   665→			continue
   666→		}
   667→
   668→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   669→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   670→			continue
   671→		}
   672→
   673→		// Check for user message:
   674→		// - Claude Code uses "type": "human" or "type": "user"
   675→		// - Cursor uses "role": "user"
   676→		msgType, _ := entry["type"].(string) //nolint:errcheck // type assertion on interface{} from JSON
   677→		msgRole, _ := entry["role"].(string) //nolint:errcheck // type assertion on interface{} from JSON
   678→		isUser := msgType == "human" || msgType == "user" || msgRole == "user"
   679→		if !isUser {
   680→			continue
   681→		}
   682→
   683→		// Extract message content
   684→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   685→		if !ok {
   686→			continue
   687→		}
   688→
   689→		// Handle string content
   690→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   691→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   692→			if cleaned != "" {
   693→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   694→			}
   695→			continue
   696→		}
   697→
   698→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   699→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   700→			var texts []string
   701→			for _, item := range arr {
   702→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   703→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   704→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   705→							texts = append(texts, text)
   706→						}
   707→					}
   708→				}
   709→			}
   710→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   711→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   712→				if cleaned != "" {
   713→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   714→				}
   715→			}
   716→		}
   717→	}
   718→	return prompts
   719→}

   721→// splitPromptContent splits prompt.txt content on the "\n\n---\n\n" separator.
   722→// Returns nil if content is empty.
   723→func splitPromptContent(content string) []string {
   724→	if content == "" {
   725→		return nil
   726→	}
   727→	parts := strings.Split(content, "\n\n---\n\n")
   728→	var result []string
   729→	for _, p := range parts {
   730→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(p)
   731→		if trimmed != "" {
   732→			result = append(result, trimmed)
   733→		}
   734→	}
   735→	return result
   736→}

   766→// CondenseSessionByID condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
   767→// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
   768→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   769→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "condense-by-id")
   770→
   771→	// Load session state
   772→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   773→	if err != nil {
   774→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   775→	}
   776→	if state == nil {
   777→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   778→	}
   779→
   780→	// Open repository
   781→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   782→	if err != nil {
   783→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   784→	}
   785→
   786→	// Generate a checkpoint ID
   787→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   788→	if err != nil {
   789→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   790→	}
   791→
   792→	// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
   793→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   794→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   795→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   796→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   797→
   798→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   799→		// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
   800→		// Just clean up the state file.
   801→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
   802→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   803→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   804→		)
   805→		if err := s.clearSessionState(ctx, sessionID); err != nil {
   806→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   807→		}
   808→		return nil
   809→	}
   810→
   811→	// Condense the session
   812→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
   813→	if err != nil {
   814→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
   815→	}
   816→
   817→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed by ID",
   818→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   819→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   820→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   821→	)
   822→
   823→	// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
   824→	state.StepCount = 0
   825→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   826→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   827→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   828→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   829→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   830→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   831→
   832→	if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
   833→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   834→	}
   835→
   836→	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
   837→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   838→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   839→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   840→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   841→		)
   842→		// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
   843→	}
   844→
   845→	return nil
   846→}

   848→// CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed condenses an ENDED session and marks it
   849→// FullyCondensed in one operation. Used by the session stop hook to eagerly
   850→// clean up sessions so PostCommit doesn't have to process them.
   851→//
   852→// This does NOT call CondenseSessionByID because that method has two behaviors
   853→// we don't want: (1) it calls clearSessionState when no shadow branch exists
   854→// (deletes the state file entirely), and (2) it sets Phase = IDLE. Instead,
   855→// we inline the condensation logic with ENDED-appropriate behavior.
   856→//
   857→// Fail-open: if condensation fails, the session is left in its current state.
   858→// PostCommit will re-discover the session on the next commit if its BaseCommit
   859→// still matches the parent of HEAD.
   860→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   861→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   862→
   863→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   864→	if err != nil {
   865→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   866→	}
   867→	if state == nil {
   868→		return nil // No state file
   869→	}
   870→
   871→	// Sessions with FilesTouched must be processed by PostCommit for carry-forward
   872→	// tracking — each user commit that overlaps with tracked files gets its own
   873→	// checkpoint. Eagerly condensing here would prevent that 1:1 linkage.
   874→	if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   875→		return nil
   876→	}
   877→
   878→	// Only condense if there's uncondensed data
   879→	if state.StepCount <= 0 {
   880→		// No data and no files — mark FullyCondensed
   881→		state.FullyCondensed = true
   882→		return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
   883→	}
   884→
   885→	// Check if shadow branch exists — required for condensation
   886→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   887→	if err != nil {
   888→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to open repository",
   889→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   890→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   891→		)
   892→		return nil // fail-open
   893→	}
   894→
   895→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   896→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   897→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   898→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   899→
   900→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   901→		// No shadow branch = no checkpoint data to condense.
   902→		// Unlike CondenseSessionByID, we do NOT delete the state file.
   903→		logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense: no shadow branch",
   904→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   905→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   906→		)
   907→		state.StepCount = 0
   908→		state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
   909→		return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
   910→	}
   911→
   912→	// Generate checkpoint ID and condense
   913→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   914→	if err != nil {
   915→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to generate checkpoint ID",
   916→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   917→		)
   918→		return nil // fail-open
   919→	}
   920→
   921→	// Condense with nil committedFiles (include all FilesTouched)
   922→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
   923→	if err != nil {
   924→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop failed, PostCommit will retry",
   925→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   926→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   927→		)
   928→		return nil // fail-open
   929→	}
   930→
   931→	// Update state — keep Phase = ENDED (unlike CondenseSessionByID which sets IDLE)
   932→	state.StepCount = 0
   933→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   934→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   935→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   936→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   937→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   938→	state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
   939→	// Phase stays ENDED — do NOT set to IDLE
   940→
   941→	logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop succeeded",
   942→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   943→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   944→	)
   945→
   946→	if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
   947→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   948→	}
   949→
   950→	// Clean up shadow branch
   951→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   952→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to clean up shadow branch",
   953→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   954→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   955→		)
   956→	}
   957→
   958→	return nil
   959→}

   961→// cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused deletes a shadow branch if no other active sessions reference it.
   962→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx context.Context, _ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
   963→	// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
   964→	allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates(ctx)
   965→	if err != nil {
   966→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   967→	}
   968→
   969→	for _, state := range allStates {
   970→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   971→			continue
   972→		}
   973→		otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   974→		if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
   975→			// Another session still needs this shadow branch
   976→			return nil
   977→		}
   978→	}
   979→
   980→	// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
   981→	// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
   982→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(ctx, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   983→		// Branch already gone is not an error
   984→		if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
   985→			return nil
   986→		}
   987→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
   988→	}
   989→	return nil
   990→}

1→// lifecycle.go implements the generic lifecycle event dispatcher.
     2→// It routes normalized events from any agent to the appropriate framework actions.
     3→//
     4→// The dispatcher inverts the current flow from "agent handler calls framework functions"
     5→// to "framework dispatcher calls agent methods." Agents are passive data providers;
     6→// the dispatcher handles all orchestration: state transitions, strategy calls,
     7→// file change detection, metadata generation.
     8→package cli
     9→
    10→import (
    11→	"context"
    12→	"errors"
    13→	"fmt"
    14→	"log/slog"
    15→	"os"
    16→	"path/filepath"
    17→	"strings"
    18→	"time"
    19→
    20→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent"
    21→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/logging"
    22→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/paths"
    23→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/session"
    24→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy"
    25→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/transcript"
    26→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/validation"
    27→	"github.com/entireio/cli/perf"
    28→)

    30→// DispatchLifecycleEvent routes a normalized lifecycle event to the appropriate handler.
    31→// Returns nil if the event was handled successfully.
    32→func DispatchLifecycleEvent(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
    33→	if ag == nil {
    34→		return errors.New("agent cannot be nil")
    35→	}
    36→	if event == nil {
    37→		return errors.New("event cannot be nil")
    38→	}
    39→
    40→	switch event.Type {
    41→	case agent.SessionStart:
    42→		return handleLifecycleSessionStart(ctx, ag, event)
    43→	case agent.TurnStart:
    44→		return handleLifecycleTurnStart(ctx, ag, event)
    45→	case agent.TurnEnd:
    46→		return handleLifecycleTurnEnd(ctx, ag, event)
    47→	case agent.Compaction:
    48→		return handleLifecycleCompaction(ctx, ag, event)
    49→	case agent.SessionEnd:
    50→		return handleLifecycleSessionEnd(ctx, ag, event)
    51→	case agent.SubagentStart:
    52→		return handleLifecycleSubagentStart(ctx, ag, event)
    53→	case agent.SubagentEnd:
    54→		return handleLifecycleSubagentEnd(ctx, ag, event)
    55→	case agent.ModelUpdate:
    56→		return handleLifecycleModelUpdate(ctx, ag, event)
    57→	default:
    58→		return fmt.Errorf("unknown lifecycle event type: %d", event.Type)
    59→	}
    60→}

    62→// handleLifecycleSessionStart handles session start: shows banner, checks concurrent sessions,
    63→// fires state machine transition.
    64→func handleLifecycleSessionStart(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
    65→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
    66→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-start",
    67→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
    68→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
    69→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
    70→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
    71→	)
    72→
    73→	if event.SessionID == "" {
    74→		return fmt.Errorf("no session_id in %s event", event.Type)
    75→	}
    76→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(event.SessionID); err != nil {
    77→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s event: %w", event.Type, err)
    78→	}
    79→
    80→	// Build informational message
    81→	message := "\n\nPowered by Entire:\n  This conversation will be linked to your next commit."
    82→
    83→	// Check for concurrent sessions and append count if any
    84→	_, countSessionsSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "count_active_sessions")
    85→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
    86→	if count, err := strat.CountOtherActiveSessionsWithCheckpoints(ctx, event.SessionID); err == nil && count > 0 {
    87→		message += fmt.Sprintf("\n  %d other active conversation(s) in this workspace will also be included.\n  Use 'entire status' for more information.", count)
    88→	}
    89→	countSessionsSpan.End()
    90→
    91→	// Output informational message if the agent supports hook responses.
    92→	// Claude Code reads JSON from stdout; agents that don't implement
    93→	// HookResponseWriter silently skip (avoids raw JSON in their terminal).
    94→	_, hookResponseSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "write_hook_response")
    95→	if event.ResponseMessage != "" {
    96→		message = event.ResponseMessage
    97→	}
    98→	if writer, ok := agent.AsHookResponseWriter(ag); ok {
    99→		if err := writer.WriteHookResponse(message); err != nil {
   100→			hookResponseSpan.RecordError(err)
   101→			hookResponseSpan.End()
   102→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write hook response: %w", err)
   103→		}
   104→	}
   105→	hookResponseSpan.End()
   106→
   107→	// Store model hint if the agent provided model info on SessionStart
   108→	if event.Model != "" {
   109→		if err := strategy.StoreModelHint(ctx, event.SessionID, event.Model); err != nil {
   110→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to store model hint on session start",
   111→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   112→		}
   113→	}
   114→
   115→	// Fire EventSessionStart for the current session (if state exists).
   116→	if state, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, event.SessionID); loadErr != nil {
   117→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state on start",
   118→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   119→	} else if state != nil {
   120→		persistEventMetadataToState(event, state)
   121→		if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, state, session.EventSessionStart, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   122→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "session start transition failed",
   123→				slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   124→		}
   125→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   126→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session state on start",
   127→				slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   128→		}
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	return nil
   132→}
   133→
   134→// handleLifecycleModelUpdate persists the model name for the current session.
   135→//
   136→// If the session state file already exists (e.g., Gemini's BeforeModel fires
   137→// after TurnStart), the model is written directly to state.ModelName — no hint
   138→// file needed. Otherwise falls back to StoreModelHint for cross-process
   139→// persistence (see its doc comment for the full rationale).
   140→func handleLifecycleModelUpdate(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   141→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   142→	logging.Info(logCtx, "model-update",
   143→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   144→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
   145→	)
   146→
   147→	if event.SessionID == "" || event.Model == "" {
   148→		return nil
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	// Prefer writing directly to session state when it exists
   152→	state, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, event.SessionID)
   153→	if loadErr != nil {
   154→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "could not load session state for model update, using hint file",
   155→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   156→	}
   157→	if loadErr == nil && state != nil {
   158→		state.ModelName = event.Model
   159→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   160→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session state with model",
   161→				slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   162→		}
   163→		return nil
   164→	}
   165→
   166→	// State doesn't exist yet (or failed to load) — use hint file (see StoreModelHint doc)
   167→	if err := strategy.StoreModelHint(ctx, event.SessionID, event.Model); err != nil {
   168→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to store model hint",
   169→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   170→	}
   171→
   172→	return nil
   173→}
