   175→// handleLifecycleTurnStart handles turn start: captures pre-prompt state,
   176→// ensures strategy setup, initializes session.
   177→func handleLifecycleTurnStart(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   178→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   179→	logging.Info(logCtx, "turn-start",
   180→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   181→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   182→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
   183→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
   184→	)
   185→
   186→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   187→	if sessionID == "" {
   188→		return fmt.Errorf("no session_id in %s event", event.Type)
   189→	}
   190→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   191→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s event: %w", event.Type, err)
   192→	}
   193→
   194→	// Fill model from hint file if the agent didn't provide it on this hook
   195→	if event.Model == "" {
   196→		if hint := strategy.LoadModelHint(ctx, sessionID); hint != "" {
   197→			event.Model = hint
   198→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "loaded model from hint file",
   199→				slog.String("model", hint))
   200→		}
   201→	}
   202→
   203→	// Capture pre-prompt state (including transcript position via TranscriptAnalyzer)
   204→	_, captureSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "capture_pre_prompt_state")
   205→	if err := CapturePrePromptState(ctx, ag, sessionID, event.SessionRef); err != nil {
   206→		captureSpan.RecordError(err)
   207→		captureSpan.End()
   208→		return err
   209→	}
   210→	captureSpan.End()
   211→
   212→	// Append prompt to prompt.txt on filesystem so it's available for
   213→	// mid-turn commits (before SaveStep writes it to the shadow branch).
   214→	// Prompts are separated by "\n\n---\n\n" to support multiple turns.
   215→	if event.Prompt != "" {
   216→		sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   217→		if sessionDirAbs, absErr := paths.AbsPath(ctx, sessionDir); absErr == nil {
   218→			if mkErr := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); mkErr == nil {
   219→				promptPath := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   220→				existing, readErr := os.ReadFile(promptPath) //nolint:gosec // session metadata path
   221→				var content string
   222→				if readErr == nil && len(existing) > 0 {
   223→					content = string(existing) + "\n\n---\n\n" + event.Prompt
   224→				} else {
   225→					content = event.Prompt
   226→				}
   227→				if writeErr := os.WriteFile(promptPath, []byte(content), 0o600); writeErr != nil { //nolint:gosec // path from internal metadata, not user input
   228→					logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to write prompt.txt",
   229→						slog.String("error", writeErr.Error()))
   230→				}
   231→			}
   232→		}
   233→	}
   234→
   235→	// Ensure strategy setup and initialize session
   236→	_, initSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "init_session")
   237→	if err := strategy.EnsureSetup(ctx); err != nil {
   238→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to ensure strategy setup",
   239→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   243→	if err := strat.InitializeSession(ctx, sessionID, ag.Type(), event.SessionRef, event.Prompt, event.Model); err != nil {
   244→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to initialize session state",
   245→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   246→	}
   247→	initSpan.End()
   248→
   249→	return nil
   250→}

   252→// handleLifecycleTurnEnd handles turn end: validates transcript, extracts metadata,
   253→// detects file changes, saves step + checkpoint, transitions phase.
   254→//
   255→//nolint:maintidx // high complexity due to sequential orchestration of 8 steps (validation, extraction, file detection, filtering, token calc, step save, phase transition, cleanup) - splitting would obscure the flow
   256→func handleLifecycleTurnEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   257→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   258→	logging.Info(logCtx, "turn-end",
   259→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   260→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   261→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
   262→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
   263→	)
   264→
   265→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   266→	if sessionID == "" {
   267→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   268→	}
   269→
   270→	// Fill model from hint file if the agent didn't provide it on this hook
   271→	if event.Model == "" && sessionID != unknownSessionID {
   272→		if hint := strategy.LoadModelHint(ctx, sessionID); hint != "" {
   273→			event.Model = hint
   274→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "loaded model from hint file",
   275→				slog.String("model", hint))
   276→		}
   277→	}
   278→
   279→	transcriptRef := event.SessionRef
   280→	if transcriptRef == "" {
   281→		return errors.New("transcript file not specified")
   282→	}
   283→
   284→	// If agent implements TranscriptPreparer, materialize the transcript file.
   285→	// This must run BEFORE fileExists: agents like OpenCode lazily fetch transcripts
   286→	// via `opencode export`, so the file doesn't exist until PrepareTranscript creates it.
   287→	// Claude Code's PrepareTranscript just flushes (always succeeds). Agents without
   288→	// TranscriptPreparer (Gemini, Droid) are unaffected.
   289→	_, prepareSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "prepare_and_validate_transcript")
   290→	if preparer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptPreparer(ag); ok {
   291→		if err := preparer.PrepareTranscript(ctx, transcriptRef); err != nil {
   292→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to prepare transcript",
   293→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   294→		}
   295→	}
   296→
   297→	if !fileExists(transcriptRef) {
   298→		prepareSpan.RecordError(fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found: %s", transcriptRef))
   299→		prepareSpan.End()
   300→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found: %s", transcriptRef)
   301→	}
   302→
   303→	// Early check: bail out quickly if the repo has no commits yet.
   304→	if repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository(ctx); err == nil && strategy.IsEmptyRepository(repo) {
   305→		prepareSpan.RecordError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   306→		prepareSpan.End()
   307→		logging.Info(logCtx, "skipping checkpoint - will activate after first commit")
   308→		return NewSilentError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   309→	}
   310→	prepareSpan.End()
   311→
   312→	// Create session metadata directory
   313→	_, copySpan := perf.Start(ctx, "copy_transcript")
   314→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   315→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(ctx, sessionDir)
   316→	if err != nil {
   317→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir
   318→	}
   319→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   320→		copySpan.RecordError(err)
   321→		copySpan.End()
   322→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   323→	}
   324→
   325→	// Copy transcript to session directory
   326→	transcriptData, err := ag.ReadTranscript(transcriptRef)
   327→	if err != nil {
   328→		copySpan.RecordError(err)
   329→		copySpan.End()
   330→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read transcript: %w", err)
   331→	}
   332→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   333→	if err := os.WriteFile(logFile, transcriptData, 0o600); err != nil {
   334→		copySpan.RecordError(err)
   335→		copySpan.End()
   336→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write transcript: %w", err)
   337→	}
   338→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "copied transcript",
   339→		slog.String("path", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName))
   340→	copySpan.End()
   341→
   342→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on TurnStart)
   343→	_, extractSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "extract_metadata")
   344→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID)
   345→	if err != nil {
   346→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load pre-prompt state",
   347→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   348→	}
   349→
   350→	// Determine transcript offset
   351→	transcriptOffset := resolveTranscriptOffset(ctx, preState, sessionID)
   352→
   353→	// Backfill prompt.txt from transcript when prompt data is missing.
   354→	// This handles agents whose exec mode doesn't fire UserPromptSubmit (e.g., Factory AI
   355→	// Droid). The transcript is the source of truth — if ExtractPrompts returns nothing,
   356→	// there genuinely were no prompts. We track whether backfill occurred so we can
   357→	// update session state after SaveStep (which may reinitialize state).
   358→	var backfilledPrompt string
   359→	promptPath := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   360→	existingPrompt, readPromptErr := os.ReadFile(promptPath) //nolint:gosec // file content is safe session metadata
   361→	if readPromptErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(readPromptErr) {
   362→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to read prompt.txt, skipping backfill",
   363→			slog.String("error", readPromptErr.Error()))
   364→	} else if len(existingPrompt) == 0 {
   365→		if extractor, ok := agent.AsPromptExtractor(ag); ok {
   366→			prompts, extractErr := extractor.ExtractPrompts(transcriptRef, transcriptOffset)
   367→			if extractErr != nil {
   368→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract prompts from transcript",
   369→					slog.String("error", extractErr.Error()))
   370→			} else if len(prompts) > 0 {
   371→				content := strings.Join(prompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   372→				if writeErr := os.WriteFile(promptPath, []byte(content), 0o600); writeErr != nil {
   373→					logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to backfill prompt.txt from transcript",
   374→						slog.String("error", writeErr.Error()))
   375→				} else {
   376→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "backfilled prompt.txt from transcript",
   377→						slog.Int("prompt_count", len(prompts)))
   378→					backfilledPrompt = prompts[len(prompts)-1]
   379→				}
   380→			}
   381→		}
   382→	}
   383→
   384→	// Compute subagents directory for agents that support subagent extraction.
   385→	// Subagent transcripts live in <transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/
   386→	subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptRef), event.SessionID, "subagents")
   387→
   388→	// Extract metadata via agent interface (modified files)
   389→	var modifiedFiles []string
   390→
   391→	if analyzer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptAnalyzer(ag); ok {
   392→		// Extract modified files - prefer SubagentAwareExtractor if available to include subagent files
   393→		if subagentExtractor, subOk := agent.AsSubagentAwareExtractor(ag); subOk {
   394→			if files, fileErr := subagentExtractor.ExtractAllModifiedFiles(transcriptData, transcriptOffset, subagentsDir); fileErr != nil {
   395→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files (with subagents)",
   396→					slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   397→			} else {
   398→				modifiedFiles = files
   399→			}
   400→		} else {
   401→			// Fall back to basic extraction (main transcript only)
   402→			if files, _, fileErr := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(transcriptRef, transcriptOffset); fileErr != nil {
   403→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files",
   404→					slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   405→			} else {
   406→				modifiedFiles = files
   407→			}
   408→		}
   409→	}
   410→	extractSpan.End()
   411→
   412→	// Generate commit message from last prompt (read from session state, set at TurnStart).
   413→	// In exec mode, session state LastPrompt may be empty because UserPromptSubmit never fires.
   414→	// Fall back to backfilledPrompt extracted from the transcript.
   415→	_, commitMsgSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "generate_commit_message")
   416→	lastPrompt := ""
   417→	if sessionState, stateErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID); stateErr == nil && sessionState != nil {
   418→		lastPrompt = sessionState.LastPrompt
   419→	}
   420→	if lastPrompt == "" && backfilledPrompt != "" {
   421→		lastPrompt = backfilledPrompt
   422→	}
   423→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt, ag.Type())
   424→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "using commit message",
   425→		slog.Int("message_length", len(commitMessage)))
   426→	commitMsgSpan.End()
   427→
   428→	// Get worktree root for path normalization
   429→	_, detectSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "detect_file_changes")
   430→	repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   431→	if err != nil {
   432→		detectSpan.RecordError(err)
   433→		detectSpan.End()
   434→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree root: %w", err)
   435→	}
   436→
   437→	var preUntrackedFiles []string
   438→	if preState != nil {
   439→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "pre-prompt state",
   440→			slog.Int("pre_existing_untracked_files", len(preState.UntrackedFiles)))
   441→		preUntrackedFiles = preState.PreUntrackedFiles()
   442→	}
   443→
   444→	// Detect file changes via git status
   445→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(ctx, preUntrackedFiles)
   446→	if err != nil {
   447→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to compute file changes",
   448→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   449→	}
   450→	detectSpan.End()
   451→
   452→	// Filter and normalize all paths
   453→	_, normalizeSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "filter_and_normalize_paths")
   454→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   455→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   456→	if changes != nil {
   457→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   458→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   459→
   460→		// Merge git-status modified files as a fallback for transcript parsing.
   461→		// Transcript parsing is the primary source for modified files, but it can miss
   462→		// files if the agent uses an unrecognized tool or the transcript format changes.
   463→		// Git status catches any tracked file with working-tree changes.
   464→		relModifiedFiles = mergeUnique(relModifiedFiles, FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Modified, repoRoot))
   465→	}

   467→	// Filter transcript-extracted files to exclude files already committed to HEAD.
   468→	// When an agent commits files mid-turn, those files are condensed by PostCommit
   469→	// and should not be re-added to FilesTouched by SaveStep. A file is "committed"
   470→	// if it exists in HEAD with the same content as the working tree.
   471→	relModifiedFiles = filterToUncommittedFiles(ctx, relModifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   472→	normalizeSpan.End()
   473→
   474→	// Backfill session state LastPrompt early so `entire status` shows the prompt
   475→	// even when no files were modified (before the early return below).
   476→	if backfilledPrompt != "" {
   477→		if state, stateErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID); stateErr == nil && state != nil && state.LastPrompt == "" {
   478→			state.LastPrompt = backfilledPrompt
   479→			if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   480→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to backfill LastPrompt in session state",
   481→					slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   482→			}
   483→		}
   484→	}
   485→
   486→	// Check if there are any changes
   487→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   488→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   489→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no files modified during session, skipping checkpoint")
   490→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(ctx, sessionID, event)
   491→		if cleanupErr := CleanupPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID); cleanupErr != nil {
   492→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to cleanup pre-prompt state",
   493→				slog.String("error", cleanupErr.Error()))
   494→		}
   495→		return nil
   496→	}
   497→
   498→	// Log file changes
   499→	logFileChanges(ctx, relModifiedFiles, relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles)
   500→
   501→	// Get git author
   502→	author, err := GetGitAuthor(ctx)
   503→	if err != nil {
   504→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   505→	}
   506→
   507→	// Get strategy and agent type
   508→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   509→	agentType := ag.Type()
   510→
   511→	// Get transcript position/identifier from pre-prompt state
   512→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   513→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   514→	if preState != nil {
   515→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   516→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.TranscriptOffset
   517→	}
   518→
   519→	// Calculate token usage - prefer SubagentAwareExtractor to include subagent tokens
   520→	tokenUsage := agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, transcriptData, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   521→
   522→	// Build fully-populated step context and delegate to strategy
   523→	stepCtx := strategy.StepContext{
   524→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   525→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   526→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   527→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   528→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   529→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   530→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   531→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptRef,
   532→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   533→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   534→		AgentType:                agentType,
   535→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   536→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   537→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   538→	}
   539→
   540→	if err := strat.SaveStep(ctx, stepCtx); err != nil {
   541→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save step: %w", err)
   542→	}
   543→
   544→	// Update session state with backfilled prompt after SaveStep.
   545→	// Done after SaveStep because SaveStep may reinitialize session state,
   546→	// which would overwrite an earlier LastPrompt update.
   547→	if backfilledPrompt != "" {
   548→		if state, stateErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID); stateErr == nil && state != nil && state.LastPrompt == "" {
   549→			state.LastPrompt = backfilledPrompt
   550→			if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   551→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to backfill LastPrompt in session state",
   552→					slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   553→			}
   554→		}
   555→	}
   556→
   557→	// Transition session phase and cleanup
   558→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(ctx, sessionID, event)
   559→	if cleanupErr := CleanupPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID); cleanupErr != nil {
   560→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to cleanup pre-prompt state",
   561→			slog.String("error", cleanupErr.Error()))
   562→	}
   563→
   564→	return nil
   565→}

   567→// handleLifecycleCompaction handles context compaction: saves current progress
   568→// but stays in ACTIVE phase (unlike TurnEnd which transitions to IDLE).
   569→// Also resets the transcript offset since the transcript may be truncated.
   570→func handleLifecycleCompaction(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   571→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   572→	logging.Info(logCtx, "compaction",
   573→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   574→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   575→	)
   576→
   577→	// Fire EventCompaction to trigger ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched (stays in ACTIVE)
   578→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   579→	sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   580→	if loadErr != nil {
   581→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state for compaction",
   582→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   583→	}
   584→	if sessionState != nil {
   585→		persistEventMetadataToState(event, sessionState)
   586→
   587→		if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, sessionState, session.EventCompaction, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   588→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "compaction transition failed",
   589→				slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   590→		}
   591→
   592→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, sessionState); saveErr != nil {
   593→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to save session state after compaction",
   594→				slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   595→		}
   596→	}
   597→
   598→	logging.Info(logCtx, "context compaction detected")
   599→	return nil
   600→}

   602→// handleLifecycleSessionEnd handles session end: marks the session as ended.
   603→func handleLifecycleSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   604→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   605→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-end",
   606→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   607→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   608→	)
   609→
   610→	if event.SessionID == "" {
   611→		return nil // No session to update
   612→	}
   613→
   614→	// Note: We intentionally don't clean up cached transcripts here.
   615→	// Post-session commits (carry-forward in ENDED phase) may still need
   616→	// the transcript to extract file changes. Cleanup is handled by
   617→	// `entire clean` or when the session state is fully removed.
   618→
   619→	if err := markSessionEnded(ctx, event, event.SessionID); err != nil {
   620→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to mark session ended",
   621→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   622→		// Don't attempt eager condense if we couldn't even mark the session ended —
   623→		// the session state may be in an inconsistent state.
   624→		return nil
   625→	}
   626→
   627→	// Eagerly condense session data so PostCommit doesn't have to process it.
   628→	// This prevents zombie ENDED sessions from accumulating and causing O(N)
   629→	// overhead on every future commit (GitHub issue #591).
   630→	// Fail-open: if this fails, the session remains in its current state and
   631→	// PostCommit will re-discover it if its BaseCommit matches the parent of HEAD.
   632→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   633→	if err := strat.CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed(ctx, event.SessionID); err != nil {
   634→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop failed",
   635→			slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   636→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   637→	}
   638→
   639→	return nil
   640→}

   660→// handleLifecycleSubagentEnd handles subagent end: detects changes, saves task checkpoint.
   661→func handleLifecycleSubagentEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   662→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   663→	if event.SubagentType == "" && event.TaskDescription == "" {
   664→		// Extract subagent type and description from tool input
   665→		event.SubagentType, event.TaskDescription = ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(event.ToolInput)
   666→	}
   667→
   668→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   669→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(event.SessionRef)
   670→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   671→	if event.SubagentID != "" {
   672→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, event.SubagentID)
   673→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   674→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   675→		}
   676→	}
   677→
   678→	// Log context
   679→	subagentEndAttrs := []any{
   680→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   681→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   682→		slog.String("tool_use_id", event.ToolUseID),
   683→	}
   684→	if event.SubagentID != "" {
   685→		subagentEndAttrs = append(subagentEndAttrs, slog.String("agent_id", event.SubagentID))
   686→	}
   687→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   688→		subagentEndAttrs = append(subagentEndAttrs, slog.String("subagent_transcript", subagentTranscriptPath))
   689→	}
   690→	logging.Info(logCtx, "subagent completed", subagentEndAttrs...)
   691→
   692→	// Extract modified files from hook payload and/or subagent transcript
   693→	var modifiedFiles []string
   694→	modifiedFiles = append(modifiedFiles, event.ModifiedFiles...)
   695→	if analyzer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptAnalyzer(ag); ok {
   696→		transcriptToScan := event.SessionRef
   697→		if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   698→			transcriptToScan = subagentTranscriptPath
   699→		}
   700→		if files, _, fileErr := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(transcriptToScan, 0); fileErr != nil {
   701→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files from subagent",
   702→				slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   703→		} else {
   704→			modifiedFiles = mergeUnique(modifiedFiles, files)
   705→		}
   706→	}
   707→
   708→	// Load pre-task state and detect file changes.
   709→	// If no pre-task state exists (agent doesn't support pre-task hook), fall back
   710→	// to the session's pre-prompt state. Without either, DetectFileChanges receives
   711→	// nil and treats ALL untracked files as new — which would create spurious task
   712→	// checkpoints for pre-existing untracked files (e.g., .github/hooks/entire.json).
   713→	preState, err := LoadPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID)
   714→	if err != nil {
   715→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load pre-task state",
   716→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   717→	}
   718→	var preUntrackedFiles []string
   719→	if preState != nil {
   720→		preUntrackedFiles = preState.PreUntrackedFiles()
   721→	}
   722→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(ctx, preUntrackedFiles)
   723→	if err != nil {
   724→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to compute file changes",
   725→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   726→	}
   727→
   728→	// Get worktree root and normalize paths
   729→	repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   730→	if err != nil {
   731→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree root: %w", err)
   732→	}
   733→
   734→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   735→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   736→	if changes != nil {
   737→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   738→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   739→		relModifiedFiles = mergeUnique(relModifiedFiles, FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Modified, repoRoot))
   740→	}
   741→
   742→	// If no changes, skip
   743→	if len(relModifiedFiles) == 0 && len(relNewFiles) == 0 && len(relDeletedFiles) == 0 {
   744→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no file changes detected, skipping task checkpoint")
   745→		_ = CleanupPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   746→		return nil
   747→	}
   748→
   749→	// Find checkpoint UUID from main transcript (best-effort)
   750→	var checkpointUUID string
   751→	// Use the existing CLI-level checkpoint UUID finder
   752→	mainLines, _ := parseTranscriptForCheckpointUUID(event.SessionRef) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort
   753→	if mainLines != nil {
   754→		checkpointUUID, _ = FindCheckpointUUID(mainLines, event.ToolUseID)
   755→	}
   756→
   757→	// Get git author
   758→	author, err := GetGitAuthor(ctx)
   759→	if err != nil {
   760→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   761→	}
   762→
   763→	// Build task checkpoint context
   764→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   765→	agentType := ag.Type()
   766→
   767→	taskStepCtx := strategy.TaskStepContext{
   768→		SessionID:              event.SessionID,
   769→		ToolUseID:              event.ToolUseID,
   770→		AgentID:                event.SubagentID,
   771→		ModifiedFiles:          relModifiedFiles,
   772→		NewFiles:               relNewFiles,
   773→		DeletedFiles:           relDeletedFiles,
   774→		TranscriptPath:         event.SessionRef,
   775→		SubagentTranscriptPath: subagentTranscriptPath,
   776→		CheckpointUUID:         checkpointUUID,
   777→		AuthorName:             author.Name,
   778→		AuthorEmail:            author.Email,
   779→		SubagentType:           event.SubagentType,
   780→		TaskDescription:        event.TaskDescription,
   781→		AgentType:              agentType,
   782→	}
   783→
   784→	if err := strat.SaveTaskStep(ctx, taskStepCtx); err != nil {
   785→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save task step: %w", err)
   786→	}
   787→
   788→	_ = CleanupPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   789→	return nil
   790→}

   794→// resolveTranscriptOffset determines the transcript offset to use for parsing.
   795→// Prefers pre-prompt state, falls back to session state.
   796→func resolveTranscriptOffset(ctx context.Context, preState *PrePromptState, sessionID string) int {
   797→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle")
   798→	if preState != nil && preState.TranscriptOffset > 0 {
   799→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "pre-prompt state found, parsing transcript from offset",
   800→			slog.Int("offset", preState.TranscriptOffset))
   801→		return preState.TranscriptOffset
   802→	}
   803→
   804→	// Fall back to session state
   805→	sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   806→	if loadErr != nil {
   807→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state",
   808→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   809→		return 0
   810→	}
   811→	if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   812→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "session state found, parsing transcript from offset",
   813→			slog.Int("offset", sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart))
   814→		return sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   815→	}
   816→
   817→	return 0
   818→}

   830→// transitionSessionTurnEnd transitions the session phase to IDLE and dispatches turn-end actions.
   831→func transitionSessionTurnEnd(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, event *agent.Event) {
   832→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle")
   833→	turnState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   834→	if loadErr != nil {
   835→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state for turn end",
   836→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   837→		return
   838→	}
   839→	if turnState == nil {
   840→		return
   841→	}
   842→
   843→	persistEventMetadataToState(event, turnState)
   844→
   845→	if err := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, turnState, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); err != nil {
   846→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "turn-end transition failed",
   847→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   848→	}
   849→
   850→	// Always dispatch to strategy for turn-end handling. The strategy reads
   851→	// work items from state (e.g. TurnCheckpointIDs), not the action list.
   852→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   853→	if err := strat.HandleTurnEnd(ctx, turnState); err != nil {
   854→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "turn-end action dispatch failed",
   855→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   856→	}
   857→
   858→	if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, turnState); updateErr != nil {
   859→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session phase on turn end",
   860→			slog.String("error", updateErr.Error()))
   861→	}
   862→}

   864→// markSessionEnded transitions the session to ENDED phase via the state machine.
   865→// If event is non-nil, hook-provided metrics are persisted to state before saving.
   866→func markSessionEnded(ctx context.Context, event *agent.Event, sessionID string) error {
   867→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   868→	if err != nil {
   869→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   870→	}
   871→	if state == nil {
   872→		return nil // No state file, nothing to update
   873→	}
   874→
   875→	if event != nil {
   876→		persistEventMetadataToState(event, state)
   877→	}
   878→
   879→	if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, state, session.EventSessionStop, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   880→		logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), "session stop transition failed",
   881→			slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   882→	}
   883→
   884→	now := time.Now()
   885→	state.EndedAt = &now
   886→
   887→	if err := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
   888→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   889→	}
   890→	return nil
   891→}

   902→func persistEventMetadataToState(event *agent.Event, state *strategy.SessionState) {
   903→	// Update ModelName if provided (model is known by turn-end even on first turn)
   904→	if event.Model != "" {
   905→		state.ModelName = event.Model
   906→	}
   907→
   908→	// Persist hook-provided session metrics (e.g., from Cursor hooks)
   909→	if event.DurationMs > 0 {
   910→		state.SessionDurationMs = event.DurationMs
   911→	}
   912→	// Use hook-reported turn count if available (take max); otherwise
   913→	// increment on each TurnEnd event to count turns ourselves.
   914→	if event.TurnCount > 0 {
   915→		if event.TurnCount > state.SessionTurnCount {
   916→			state.SessionTurnCount = event.TurnCount
   917→		}
   918→	} else if event.Type == agent.TurnEnd {
   919→		state.SessionTurnCount++
   920→	}
   921→	if event.ContextTokens > 0 {
   922→		state.ContextTokens = event.ContextTokens
   923→	}
   924→	if event.ContextWindowSize > 0 {
   925→		state.ContextWindowSize = event.ContextWindowSize
   926→	}
   927→}

    39→// hasTTY checks if /dev/tty is available for interactive prompts.
    40→// Returns false when running as an agent subprocess (no controlling terminal).
    41→//
    42→// In test environments, ENTIRE_TEST_TTY overrides the real check:
    43→//   - ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=1 → simulate human (TTY available)
    44→//   - ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=0 → simulate agent (no TTY)
    45→func hasTTY() bool {
    46→	if v := os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_TTY"); v != "" {
    47→		return v == "1"
    48→	}
    49→
    50→	// Gemini CLI sets GEMINI_CLI=1 when running shell commands.
    51→	// Gemini subprocesses may have access to the user's TTY, but they can't
    52→	// actually respond to interactive prompts. Treat them as non-TTY.
    53→	// See: https://geminicli.com/docs/tools/shell/
    54→	if os.Getenv("GEMINI_CLI") != "" {
    55→		return false
    56→	}
    57→
    58→	// Copilot CLI sets COPILOT_CLI=1 when running hook subprocesses (v0.0.421+).
    59→	// Like Gemini, the subprocess may inherit the user's TTY but can't respond
    60→	// to interactive prompts.
    61→	if os.Getenv("COPILOT_CLI") != "" {
    62→		return false
    63→	}
    64→
    65→	// GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 disables git's own terminal prompts.
    66→	// Factory AI Droid (and other non-interactive environments like CI) set this.
    67→	// Since we run as a git hook, respect it — if the environment doesn't want
    68→	// git prompting, our hook shouldn't prompt either.
    69→	if os.Getenv("GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT") == "0" {
    70→		return false
    71→	}
    72→
    73→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
    74→	if err != nil {
    75→		return false
    76→	}
    77→	_ = tty.Close()
    78→	return true
    79→}

    81→// ttyResult represents the outcome of a TTY confirmation prompt.
    82→type ttyResult int
    83→
    84→const (
    85→	ttyResultLink       ttyResult = iota // Link: add the checkpoint trailer
    86→	ttyResultSkip                        // Skip: don't add the trailer
    87→	ttyResultLinkAlways                  // Link and remember: add trailer + save "always" preference
    88→)
    89→
    90→// askConfirmTTY prompts the user via /dev/tty whether to link a commit to session context.
    91→// This requires a controlling terminal — callers must check hasTTY() first and handle
    92→// the no-TTY case (agent subprocesses, CI) themselves.
    93→//
    94→// header is displayed as the first line (e.g., "Entire: Active Claude Code session").
    95→// detail lines are displayed indented below the header.
    96→func askConfirmTTY(header string, details []string, prompt string, defaultYes bool) ttyResult {
    97→	defaultResult := ttyResultSkip
    98→	if defaultYes {
    99→		defaultResult = ttyResultLink
   100→	}
   101→
   102→	// In test mode, don't try to interact with the real TTY — just use the default.
   103→	// ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=1 simulates "a human is present" for the hasTTY() check
   104→	// but we can't actually read from the TTY in tests.
   105→	if os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_TTY") != "" {
   106→		return defaultResult
   107→	}
   108→
   109→	// Open /dev/tty for both reading and writing.
   110→	// This is the controlling terminal, which works even when stdin/stderr are redirected
   111→	// (e.g., human runs git commit -m where stdin is not a pipe).
   112→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
   113→	if err != nil {
   114→		return defaultResult
   115→	}
   116→	defer tty.Close()
   117→
   118→	// Write to tty directly, not stderr, since git hooks may redirect stderr to /dev/null
   119→	fmt.Fprintf(tty, "\n%s\n", header)
   120→	for _, line := range details {
   121→		fmt.Fprintf(tty, "  %s\n", line)
   122→	}
   123→
   124→	// Show prompt with option descriptions
   125→	fmt.Fprintf(tty, "\n%s\n", prompt)
   126→	if defaultYes {
   127→		fmt.Fprint(tty, "  [Y]es / [n]o / [a]lways (remember my choice): ")
   128→	} else {
   129→		fmt.Fprint(tty, "  [y]es / [N]o / [a]lways (remember my choice): ")
   130→	}
   131→
   132→	// Read response
   133→	reader := bufio.NewReader(tty)
   134→	response, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   135→	if err != nil {
   136→		return defaultResult
   137→	}
   138→
   139→	response = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(response))
   140→	switch response {
   141→	case "y", "yes":
   142→		return ttyResultLink
   143→	case "n", "no":
   144→		return ttyResultSkip
   145→	case "a", "always":
   146→		return ttyResultLinkAlways
   147→	default:
   148→		// Empty or invalid input - use default
   149→		return defaultResult
   150→	}
   151→}

   153→// saveCommitLinkingAlways persists commit_linking = "always" to settings.local.json.
   154→// Uses raw JSON merge to set only the commit_linking field without affecting other
   155→// fields. This avoids writing unintended defaults (e.g., enabled: true) when the
   156→// local settings file doesn't exist yet.
   157→func saveCommitLinkingAlways(ctx context.Context) error {
   158→	localPath, err := paths.AbsPath(ctx, settings.EntireSettingsLocalFile)
   159→	if err != nil {
   160→		return fmt.Errorf("resolving local settings path: %w", err)
   161→	}
   162→
   163→	// Read existing file as raw JSON map to preserve all existing fields.
   164→	// If the file doesn't exist, start with an empty map so we only write commit_linking.
   165→	var raw map[string]json.RawMessage
   166→	data, readErr := os.ReadFile(localPath) //nolint:gosec // path is from AbsPath
   167→	if readErr == nil {
   168→		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
   169→			return fmt.Errorf("parsing local settings: %w", err)
   170→		}
   171→	} else if !os.IsNotExist(readErr) {
   172→		return fmt.Errorf("reading local settings: %w", readErr)
   173→	}
   174→	if raw == nil {
   175→		raw = make(map[string]json.RawMessage)
   176→	}
   177→
   178→	raw["commit_linking"] = json.RawMessage(`"` + settings.CommitLinkingAlways + `"`)
   179→
   180→	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(raw, "", "  ")
   181→	if err != nil {
   182→		return fmt.Errorf("marshaling local settings: %w", err)
   183→	}
   184→	out = append(out, '\n')
   185→
   186→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(localPath), 0o750); err != nil {
   187→		return fmt.Errorf("creating settings directory: %w", err)
   188→	}
   189→	//nolint:gosec // G306: settings file is config, not secrets; 0o644 is appropriate
   190→	if err := os.WriteFile(localPath, out, 0o644); err != nil {
   191→		return fmt.Errorf("writing local settings: %w", err)
   192→	}
   193→	return nil
   194→}

   196→// CommitMsg is called by the git commit-msg hook after the user edits the message.
   197→// If the message contains only our trailer (no actual user content), strip it
   198→// so git will abort the commit due to empty message.
   199→
   200→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CommitMsg(_ context.Context, commitMsgFile string) error { //nolint:unparam // error return is part of the hook contract; callers check it

200→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CommitMsg(_ context.Context, commitMsgFile string) error { //nolint:unparam // error return is part of the hook contract; callers check it
   201→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // Path comes from git hook
   202→	if err != nil {
   203→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   204→	}
   205→
   206→	message := string(content)
   207→
   208→	// Check if our trailer is present (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   209→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); !found {
   210→		// No trailer, nothing to do
   211→		return nil
   212→	}
   213→
   214→	// Check if there's any user content (non-comment, non-trailer lines)
   215→	if !hasUserContent(message) {
   216→		// No user content - strip the trailer so git aborts
   217→		message = stripCheckpointTrailer(message)
   218→		if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   219→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   220→		}
   221→	}
   222→
   223→	return nil
   224→}
   225→
   226→// hasUserContent checks if the message has any content besides comments and our trailer.
   227→func hasUserContent(message string) bool {
   228→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   229→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   230→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   231→		// Skip empty lines
   232→		if trimmed == "" {
   233→			continue
   234→		}
   235→		// Skip comment lines
   236→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "#") {
   237→			continue
   238→		}
   239→		// Skip our trailer line
   240→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, trailerPrefix) {
   241→			continue
   242→		}
   243→		// Found user content
   244→		return true
   245→	}
   246→	return false
   247→}
   248→
   249→// stripCheckpointTrailer removes the Entire-Checkpoint trailer line from the message.
   250→func stripCheckpointTrailer(message string) string {
   251→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   252→	var result []string
   253→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   254→		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), trailerPrefix) {
   255→			result = append(result, line)
   256→		}
   257→	}
   258→	return strings.Join(result, "\n")
   259→}

   261→// isGitSequenceOperation checks if git is currently in the middle of a rebase,
   262→// cherry-pick, or revert operation. During these operations, commits are being
   263→// replayed and should not be linked to agent sessions.
   264→//
   265→// Detects:
   266→//   - rebase: .git/rebase-merge/ or .git/rebase-apply/ directories
   267→//   - cherry-pick: .git/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD file
   268→//   - revert: .git/REVERT_HEAD file
   269→func isGitSequenceOperation(ctx context.Context) bool {
   270→	// Get git directory (handles worktrees and relative paths correctly)
   271→	gitDir, err := GetGitDir(ctx)
   272→	if err != nil {
   273→		return false // Can't determine, assume not in sequence operation
   274→	}
   275→
   276→	// Check for rebase state directories
   277→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-merge")); err == nil {
   278→		return true
   279→	}
   280→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-apply")); err == nil {
   281→		return true
   282→	}
   283→
   284→	// Check for cherry-pick and revert state files
   285→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "CHERRY_PICK_HEAD")); err == nil {
   286→		return true
   287→	}
   288→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "REVERT_HEAD")); err == nil {
   289→		return true
   290→	}
   291→
   292→	return false
   293→}

   295→// PrepareCommitMsg is called by the git prepare-commit-msg hook.
   296→// Adds an Entire-Checkpoint trailer to the commit message with a stable checkpoint ID.
   297→// Only adds a trailer if there's actually new session content to condense.
   298→// The actual condensation happens in PostCommit - if the user removes the trailer,
   299→// the commit will not be linked to the session (useful for "manual" commits).
   300→// For amended commits, preserves the existing checkpoint ID.
   301→//
   302→// The source parameter indicates how the commit was initiated:
   303→//   - "" or "template": normal editor flow - adds trailer with explanatory comment
   304→//   - "message": using -m or -F flag - prompts user interactively via /dev/tty
   305→//   - "merge", "squash": skip trailer entirely (auto-generated messages)
   306→//   - "commit": amend operation - preserves existing trailer or restores from LastCheckpointID
   307→//
   308→
   309→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PrepareCommitMsg(ctx context.Context, commitMsgFile string, source string) error {
   310→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   311→
   312→	// Skip during rebase, cherry-pick, or revert operations
   313→	// These are replaying existing commits and should not be linked to agent sessions
   314→	if isGitSequenceOperation(ctx) {
   315→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped during git sequence operation",
   316→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   317→			slog.String("source", source),
   318→		)
   319→		return nil
   320→	}
   321→
   322→	// Skip for merge and squash sources
   323→	// These are auto-generated messages - not from Claude sessions
   324→	switch source {
   325→	case "merge", "squash":
   326→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped for source",
   327→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   328→			slog.String("source", source),
   329→		)
   330→		return nil
   331→	}
   332→
   333→	// Handle amend (source="commit") separately: preserve or restore trailer
   334→	if source == "commit" {
   335→		return s.handleAmendCommitMsg(ctx, commitMsgFile)
   336→	}
   337→
   338→	_, openRepoSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "open_repository")
   339→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   340→	if err != nil {
   341→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   342→		openRepoSpan.End()
   343→		return nil
   344→	}
   345→	openRepoSpan.End()
   346→
   347→	_, findSessionsSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "find_sessions_for_worktree")
   348→	worktreePath, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   349→	if err != nil {
   350→		findSessionsSpan.RecordError(err)
   351→		findSessionsSpan.End()
   352→		return nil
   353→	}
   354→
   355→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   356→	// We match by worktree (not BaseCommit) because the user may have made
   357→	// intermediate commits without entering new prompts, causing HEAD to diverge
   358→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(ctx, worktreePath)
   359→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   360→		findSessionsSpan.RecordError(err)
   361→		findSessionsSpan.End()
   362→		// No active sessions or error listing - silently skip (hooks must be resilient)
   363→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no active sessions",
   364→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   365→			slog.String("source", source),
   366→		)
   367→		return nil
   368→	}
   369→	findSessionsSpan.End()
   370→
   371→	// Fast path: when an agent is committing (ACTIVE session + no TTY), skip
   372→	// content detection and interactive prompts. The agent can't respond to TTY
   373→	// prompts and the content detection can miss mid-session work (no shadow
   374→	// branch yet, transcript analysis may fail). Generate a checkpoint ID and
   375→	// add the trailer directly.
   376→	if !hasTTY() {
   377→		for _, state := range sessions {
   378→			if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   379→				return s.addTrailerForAgentCommit(logCtx, commitMsgFile, state, source)
   380→			}
   381→		}
   382→	}
   383→
   384→	// Check if any session has new content to condense
   385→	_, filterSessionsSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "filter_sessions_with_content")
   386→	sessionsWithContent := s.filterSessionsWithNewContent(ctx, repo, sessions)
   387→	filterSessionsSpan.End()
   388→
   389→	if len(sessionsWithContent) == 0 {
   390→		// No new content — no trailer needed
   391→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no content to link",
   392→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   393→			slog.String("source", source),
   394→			slog.Int("sessions_found", len(sessions)),
   395→		)
   396→		return nil
   397→	}
   398→
   399→	// Read current commit message
   400→	_, readCommitMessageSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "read_commit_message")
   401→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   402→	if err != nil {
   403→		readCommitMessageSpan.RecordError(err)
   404→		readCommitMessageSpan.End()
   405→		return nil
   406→	}
   407→
   408→	message := string(content)
   409→
   410→	// Check if trailer already exists (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   411→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   412→		readCommitMessageSpan.End()
   413→		// Trailer already exists (e.g., amend) - keep it
   414→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer already exists",
   415→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   416→			slog.String("source", source),
   417→			slog.String("existing_checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   418→		)
   419→		return nil
   420→	}
   421→	readCommitMessageSpan.End()
   422→
   423→	// Generate a fresh checkpoint ID and resolve session metadata
   424→	_, resolveMetadataSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "resolve_session_metadata")
   425→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   426→	if err != nil {
   427→		resolveMetadataSpan.RecordError(err)
   428→		resolveMetadataSpan.End()
   429→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   430→	}
   431→
   432→	// Determine agent type and last prompt from session
   433→	var agentType types.AgentType
   434→	var lastPrompt string
   435→	if len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   436→		firstSession := sessionsWithContent[0]
   437→		if firstSession.AgentType != "" {
   438→			agentType = firstSession.AgentType
   439→		}
   440→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(ctx, repo, firstSession)
   441→	}
   442→
   443→	// Prepare prompt for display: collapse newlines/whitespace, then truncate (rune-safe)
   444→	displayPrompt := stringutil.TruncateRunes(stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(lastPrompt), 80, "...")
   445→
   446→	// Load commit_linking setting to decide whether to prompt
   447→	commitLinking := settings.CommitLinkingPrompt // safe default
   448→	if stngs, loadErr := settings.Load(ctx); loadErr == nil {
   449→		commitLinking = stngs.GetCommitLinking()
   450→	}
   451→	resolveMetadataSpan.End()
   452→
   453→	// Add trailer differently based on commit source
   454→	// NOTE: TTY confirmation (askConfirmTTY) is intentionally NOT wrapped in a span
   455→	// because it blocks on user input and would skew timing.
   456→	switch source {
   457→	case "message":
   458→		// Using -m or -F: behavior depends on TTY availability and commit_linking setting
   459→		switch {
   460→		case !hasTTY():
   461→			// No TTY (agent subprocess, CI) — auto-link without prompting
   462→			message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   463→		case commitLinking == settings.CommitLinkingAlways:
   464→			// User previously chose "always" — auto-link without prompting
   465→			message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   466→		default:
   467→			// Human at terminal — prompt interactively
   468→			header := "Entire: Active " + string(agentType) + " session detected"
   469→			var details []string
   470→			if displayPrompt != "" {
   471→				details = append(details, "Last prompt: "+displayPrompt)
   472→			}
   473→
   474→			result := askConfirmTTY(header, details, "Link this commit to session context?", true)
   475→			if result == ttyResultSkip {
   476→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: user declined trailer",
   477→					slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   478→					slog.String("source", source),
   479→				)
   480→				return nil
   481→			}
   482→			if result == ttyResultLinkAlways {
   483→				// Persist preference so future commits auto-link (non-fatal if it fails)
   484→				if saveErr := saveCommitLinkingAlways(ctx); saveErr != nil {
   485→					logging.Warn(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: failed to save commit_linking=always",
   486→						slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()),
   487→					)
   488→				}
   489→			}
   490→			message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   491→		}
   492→	default:
   493→		// Normal editor flow: add trailer with explanatory comment (will be stripped by git)
   494→		message = addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message, checkpointID, string(agentType), displayPrompt)
   495→	}
   496→
   497→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer added",
   498→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   499→		slog.String("source", source),

500→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   501→	)
   502→
   503→	// Write updated message back
   504→	_, writeCommitMessageSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "write_commit_message")
   505→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil { //nolint:gosec // path from git hook arg
   506→		writeCommitMessageSpan.RecordError(err)
   507→		writeCommitMessageSpan.End()
   508→		return nil
   509→	}
   510→	writeCommitMessageSpan.End()
   511→
   512→	return nil
   513→}

   515→// handleAmendCommitMsg handles the prepare-commit-msg hook for amend operations
   516→// (source="commit"). It preserves existing trailers or restores from LastCheckpointID.
   517→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) handleAmendCommitMsg(ctx context.Context, commitMsgFile string) error {
   518→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   519→	// Read current commit message
   520→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   521→	if err != nil {
   522→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   523→	}
   524→
   525→	message := string(content)
   526→
   527→	// If message already has a trailer, keep it unchanged
   528→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   529→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend preserves existing trailer",
   530→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   531→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   532→		)
   533→		return nil
   534→	}
   535→
   536→	// No trailer in message — check if any session has LastCheckpointID to restore
   537→	worktreePath, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   538→	if err != nil {
   539→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   540→	}
   541→
   542→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(ctx, worktreePath)
   543→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   544→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions - nothing to restore
   545→	}
   546→
   547→	// For amend, HEAD^ is the commit being amended, and HEAD is where we are now.
   548→	// We need to match sessions whose BaseCommit equals HEAD (the commit being amended
   549→	// was created from this base). This prevents stale sessions from injecting
   550→	// unrelated checkpoint IDs.
   551→	repo, repoErr := OpenRepository(ctx)
   552→	if repoErr != nil {
   553→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   554→	}
   555→	head, headErr := repo.Head()
   556→	if headErr != nil {
   557→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   558→	}
   559→	currentHead := head.Hash().String()
   560→
   561→	// Find first matching session with LastCheckpointID to restore.
   562→	// LastCheckpointID is set after condensation completes.
   563→	for _, state := range sessions {
   564→		if state.BaseCommit != currentHead {
   565→			continue
   566→		}
   567→		if state.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   568→			continue
   569→		}
   570→		cpID := state.LastCheckpointID
   571→		source := "LastCheckpointID"
   572→
   573→		// Restore the trailer
   574→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
   575→		if writeErr := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); writeErr != nil { //nolint:gosec // path from git hook arg
   576→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   577→		}
   578→
   579→		logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: restored trailer on amend",
   580→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   581→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
   582→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   583→			slog.String("source", source),
   584→		)
   585→		return nil
   586→	}
   587→
   588→	// No checkpoint ID found - leave message unchanged
   589→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend with no checkpoint to restore",
   590→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   591→	)
   592→	return nil
   593→}

   595→// PostCommit is called by the git post-commit hook after a commit is created.
   596→// Uses the session state machine to determine what action to take per session:
   597→//   - ACTIVE → condense immediately (each commit gets its own checkpoint)
   598→//   - IDLE → condense immediately
   599→//   - ENDED → condense if files touched, discard if empty
   600→//
   601→// After condensation for ACTIVE sessions, remaining uncommitted files are
   602→// carried forward to a new shadow branch so the next commit gets its own checkpoint.
   603→//
   604→// Shadow branches are only deleted when ALL sessions sharing the branch are non-active
   605→// and were condensed during this PostCommit.
   606→
   607→// postCommitActionHandler implements session.ActionHandler for PostCommit.
   608→// Each session in the loop gets its own handler with per-session context.
   609→// Handler methods use the *State parameter from ApplyTransition (same pointer
   610→// as the state being transitioned) rather than capturing state separately.
   611→type postCommitActionHandler struct {
   612→	s                      *ManualCommitStrategy
   613→	ctx                    context.Context
   614→	repo                   *git.Repository
   615→	checkpointID           id.CheckpointID
   616→	head                   *plumbing.Reference
   617→	commit                 *object.Commit
   618→	newHead                string
   619→	repoDir                string
   620→	shadowBranchName       string
   621→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{}
   622→	committedFileSet       map[string]struct{}
   623→	hasNew                 bool
   624→	filesTouchedBefore     []string
   625→
   626→	// Cached git objects — resolved once per PostCommit invocation to avoid
   627→	// redundant reads across filesOverlapWithContent, filesWithRemainingAgentChanges,
   628→	// CondenseSession, and calculateSessionAttributions.
   629→	headTree   *object.Tree        // HEAD commit tree (shared across all sessions)
   630→	parentTree *object.Tree        // HEAD's first parent tree (shared, nil for initial commits)
   631→	shadowRef  *plumbing.Reference // Per-session shadow branch ref (nil if branch doesn't exist)
   632→	shadowTree *object.Tree        // Per-session shadow commit tree (nil if branch doesn't exist)
   633→
   634→	// Output: set by handler methods, read by caller after TransitionAndLog.
   635→	condensed bool
   636→}

   638→func (h *postCommitActionHandler) HandleCondense(state *session.State) error {
   639→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(h.ctx, "checkpoint")
   640→	shouldCondense := h.shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck(state.Phase.IsActive(), state.LastInteractionTime)
   641→
   642→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: HandleCondense decision",
   643→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   644→		slog.String("phase", string(state.Phase)),
   645→		slog.Bool("has_new", h.hasNew),
   646→		slog.Bool("should_condense", shouldCondense),
   647→		slog.String("shadow_branch", h.shadowBranchName),
   648→	)
   649→
   650→	if shouldCondense {
   651→		h.condensed = h.s.condenseAndUpdateState(h.ctx, h.repo, h.checkpointID, state, h.head, h.shadowBranchName, h.shadowBranchesToDelete, h.committedFileSet, condenseOpts{
   652→			shadowRef:      h.shadowRef,
   653→			headTree:       h.headTree,
   654→			repoDir:        h.repoDir,
   655→			headCommitHash: h.newHead,
   656→		})
   657→	} else {
   658→		h.s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(h.ctx, state, h.newHead)
   659→	}
   660→	return nil
   661→}

   663→func (h *postCommitActionHandler) HandleCondenseIfFilesTouched(state *session.State) error {
   664→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(h.ctx, "checkpoint")
   665→	shouldCondense := len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 && h.shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck(state.Phase.IsActive(), state.LastInteractionTime)
   666→
   667→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: HandleCondenseIfFilesTouched decision",
   668→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   669→		slog.String("phase", string(state.Phase)),
   670→		slog.Bool("has_new", h.hasNew),
   671→		slog.Int("files_touched", len(state.FilesTouched)),
   672→		slog.Bool("should_condense", shouldCondense),
   673→		slog.String("shadow_branch", h.shadowBranchName),
   674→	)
   675→
   676→	if shouldCondense {
   677→		h.condensed = h.s.condenseAndUpdateState(h.ctx, h.repo, h.checkpointID, state, h.head, h.shadowBranchName, h.shadowBranchesToDelete, h.committedFileSet, condenseOpts{
   678→			shadowRef:      h.shadowRef,
   679→			headTree:       h.headTree,
   680→			repoDir:        h.repoDir,
   681→			headCommitHash: h.newHead,
   682→		})
   683→	} else {
   684→		h.s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(h.ctx, state, h.newHead)
   685→	}
   686→	return nil
   687→}

   689→// shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck returns true if the session should be condensed
   690→// into this commit. Active sessions with recent interaction always condense
   691→// (bypasses overlap check). Stale ACTIVE and IDLE/ENDED sessions require
   692→// file overlap evidence between tracked files and committed files.
   693→func (h *postCommitActionHandler) shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck(isActive bool, lastInteraction *time.Time) bool {
   694→	if !h.hasNew {
   695→		return false
   696→	}
   697→	// ACTIVE sessions with recent interaction: skip the overlap check.
   698→	// PrepareCommitMsg already validated this commit is session-related
   699→	// (added trailer). The overlap check is only meaningful when we need
   700→	// heuristic evidence that a commit was related to the session.
   701→	//
   702→	// We check LastInteractionTime to avoid condensing stale ACTIVE sessions
   703→	// (agent killed without Stop hook) into every subsequent commit. A stale
   704→	// session has no recent interaction and falls through to the overlap check.
   705→	if isActive && isRecentInteraction(lastInteraction) {
   706→		return true
   707→	}
   708→	if len(h.filesTouchedBefore) == 0 {
   709→		return false // No files tracked = no overlap evidence
   710→	}
   711→	// Only check files that were actually changed in this commit.
   712→	// Without this, files that exist in the tree but weren't changed
   713→	// would pass the "modified file" check in filesOverlapWithContent
   714→	// (because the file exists in the parent tree), causing stale
   715→	// sessions to be incorrectly condensed.
   716→	var committedTouchedFiles []string
   717→	for _, f := range h.filesTouchedBefore {
   718→		if _, ok := h.committedFileSet[f]; ok {
   719→			committedTouchedFiles = append(committedTouchedFiles, f)
   720→		}
   721→	}
   722→	if len(committedTouchedFiles) == 0 {
   723→		return false
   724→	}
   725→	return filesOverlapWithContent(h.ctx, h.repo, h.shadowBranchName, h.commit, committedTouchedFiles, overlapOpts{
   726→		headTree:      h.headTree,
   727→		shadowTree:    h.shadowTree,
   728→		parentTree:    h.parentTree,
   729→		hasParentTree: true,
   730→	})
   731→}
   732→
   733→// activeSessionInteractionThreshold is the maximum age of LastInteractionTime
   734→// for an ACTIVE session to be considered genuinely active. 24h is generous
   735→// because LastInteractionTime only updates at TurnStart, not per-tool-call.
   736→const activeSessionInteractionThreshold = 24 * time.Hour
   737→
   738→// isRecentInteraction returns true if lastInteraction is non-nil and within
   739→// activeSessionInteractionThreshold of now.
   740→func isRecentInteraction(lastInteraction *time.Time) bool {
   741→	return lastInteraction != nil && time.Since(*lastInteraction) < activeSessionInteractionThreshold
   742→}

   744→func (h *postCommitActionHandler) HandleDiscardIfNoFiles(state *session.State) error {
   745→	if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   746→		logging.Debug(logging.WithComponent(h.ctx, "checkpoint"), "post-commit: skipping empty ended session (no files to condense)",
   747→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   748→		)
   749→	}
   750→	h.s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(h.ctx, state, h.newHead)
   751→	return nil
   752→}

   755→	// Not produced by EventGitCommit; no-op for exhaustiveness.
   756→	return nil
