   759→// During rebase/cherry-pick/revert operations, phase transitions are skipped entirely.
   760→//
   761→
   762→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit(ctx context.Context) error { //nolint:unparam // error return is part of the hook contract; callers check it
   763→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   764→
   765→	_, openRepoSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "open_repository_and_head")
   766→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   767→	if err != nil {
   768→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   769→		openRepoSpan.End()
   770→		return nil
   771→	}
   772→
   773→	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
   774→	head, err := repo.Head()
   775→	if err != nil {
   776→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   777→		openRepoSpan.End()
   778→		return nil
   779→	}
   780→
   781→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   782→	if err != nil {
   783→		openRepoSpan.RecordError(err)
   784→		openRepoSpan.End()
   785→		return nil
   786→	}
   787→
   788→	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   789→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   790→	openRepoSpan.End()
   791→
   792→	if !found {
   793→		// No trailer — user removed it or it was never added (mid-turn commit).
   794→		// Still update BaseCommit for active sessions so future commits can match.
   795→		s.postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly(ctx, head)
   796→		return nil
   797→	}
   798→
   799→	_, findSessionsSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "find_sessions_from_shadow_tree")
   800→	worktreePath, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   801→	if err != nil {
   802→		findSessionsSpan.RecordError(err)
   803→		findSessionsSpan.End()
   804→		return nil
   805→	}
   806→
   807→	// Use shadow-tree-based session discovery: only load sessions whose
   808→	// BaseCommit == parent of HEAD (i.e., sessions on the current shadow branch).
   809→	// Sessions from different base commits are structurally irrelevant — their
   810→	// ENDED BaseCommit is frozen, so they belong to a different checkpoint epoch.
   811→	// This gives O(1) PostCommit regardless of total accumulated session count.
   812→	parentHash := ""
   813→	if commit.NumParents() > 0 {
   814→		if parent, pErr := commit.Parent(0); pErr == nil {
   815→			parentHash = parent.Hash.String()
   816→		}
   817→	}
   818→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsFromShadowTree(ctx, repo, parentHash, worktreePath)
   819→	findSessionsSpan.RecordError(err)
   820→	findSessionsSpan.End()
   821→
   822→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   823→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: no active sessions despite trailer",
   824→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   825→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   826→		)
   827→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   828→	}
   829→
   830→	// Build transition context
   831→	isRebase := isGitSequenceOperation(ctx)
   832→	transitionCtx := session.TransitionContext{
   833→		IsRebaseInProgress: isRebase,
   834→	}
   835→
   836→	if isRebase {
   837→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: rebase/sequence in progress, skipping phase transitions",
   838→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   839→		)
   840→	}
   841→
   842→	// Track shadow branch names and whether they can be deleted
   843→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   844→	// Track active sessions that were NOT condensed — their shadow branches must be preserved
   845→	uncondensedActiveOnBranch := make(map[string]bool)
   846→
   847→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   848→
   849→	// Pre-resolve HEAD tree and parent tree once for the entire PostCommit.

850→	// These are immutable within this hook invocation and used by multiple
   851→	// per-session functions (filesOverlapWithContent, filesWithRemainingAgentChanges,
   852→	// calculateSessionAttributions).
   853→	_, resolveTreesSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "resolve_commit_trees")
   854→	var headTree *object.Tree
   855→	if t, err := commit.Tree(); err == nil {
   856→		headTree = t
   857→	}
   858→	var parentTree *object.Tree
   859→	if commit.NumParents() > 0 {
   860→		if parent, err := commit.Parent(0); err == nil {
   861→			if t, err := parent.Tree(); err == nil {
   862→				parentTree = t
   863→			}
   864→		}
   865→	}
   866→
   867→	committedFileSet := filesChangedInCommit(ctx, worktreePath, commit, headTree, parentTree)
   868→	resolveTreesSpan.End()
   869→
   870→	for _, state := range sessions {
   871→		// Skip fully-condensed ended sessions — no work remains.
   872→		// These sessions only persist for LastCheckpointID (amend trailer reuse).
   873→		if state.FullyCondensed && state.Phase == session.PhaseEnded {
   874→			continue
   875→		}
   876→		s.postCommitProcessSession(ctx, repo, state, &transitionCtx, checkpointID,
   877→			head, commit, newHead, worktreePath, headTree, parentTree, committedFileSet,
   878→			shadowBranchesToDelete, uncondensedActiveOnBranch)
   879→	}
   880→
   881→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active
   882→	// or were condensed during this PostCommit.
   883→	_, cleanupBranchesSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "cleanup_shadow_branches")
   884→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   885→		if uncondensedActiveOnBranch[shadowBranchName] {
   886→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: preserving shadow branch (active session exists)",
   887→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   888→			)
   889→			continue
   890→		}
   891→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   892→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   893→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   894→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   895→		} else {
   896→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   897→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   898→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   899→			)
   900→		}
   901→	}
   902→	cleanupBranchesSpan.End()
   903→
   904→	return nil
   905→}
   906→
   907→// postCommitProcessSession handles a single session within the PostCommit loop.
   908→// Pre-resolved git objects (headTree, parentTree) are shared across all sessions;
   909→// per-session shadow ref/tree are resolved once here and threaded through sub-calls.
   910→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) postCommitProcessSession(
   911→	ctx context.Context,
   912→	repo *git.Repository,
   913→	state *SessionState,
   914→	transitionCtx *session.TransitionContext,
   915→	checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   916→	head *plumbing.Reference,
   917→	commit *object.Commit,
   918→	newHead string,
   919→	repoDir string,
   920→	headTree, parentTree *object.Tree,
   921→	committedFileSet map[string]struct{},
   922→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{},
   923→	uncondensedActiveOnBranch map[string]bool,
   924→) {
   925→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   926→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   927→
   928→	// Pre-resolve shadow branch ref and tree for this session.
   929→	// These are read 4+ times across sessionHasNewContent, filesOverlapWithContent,
   930→	// CondenseSession, filesWithRemainingAgentChanges, and calculateSessionAttributions.
   931→	_, resolveShadowBranchSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "resolve_shadow_branch")
   932→	var shadowRef *plumbing.Reference
   933→	var shadowTree *object.Tree
   934→	if ref, refErr := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName), true); refErr == nil {
   935→		shadowRef = ref
   936→		if sc, scErr := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash()); scErr == nil {
   937→			if st, stErr := sc.Tree(); stErr == nil {
   938→				shadowTree = st
   939→			}
   940→		}
   941→	}
   942→	resolveShadowBranchSpan.End()
   943→
   944→	// Check for new content (needed for TransitionContext and condensation).
   945→	// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content exists so we
   946→	// don't silently skip data that should have been condensed.
   947→	//
   948→	// For ACTIVE sessions: the commit has a checkpoint trailer (verified above),
   949→	// meaning PrepareCommitMsg already determined this commit is session-related.
   950→	// The trailer is only added when either:
   951→	//   - No TTY (agent/subagent committing) — added unconditionally
   952→	//   - TTY (human committing) — added after content detection confirmed agent work
   953→	// In both cases, PrepareCommitMsg already validated this commit. We trust
   954→	// that decision here. Transcript-based re-validation is unreliable because
   955→	// subagent transcripts may not be available yet (subagent still running).
   956→	_, checkContentSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "check_session_content")
   957→	var hasNew bool
   958→	if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   959→		hasNew = true
   960→	} else {
   961→		var contentErr error
   962→		hasNew, contentErr = s.sessionHasNewContent(ctx, repo, state, contentCheckOpts{shadowTree: shadowTree})
   963→		if contentErr != nil {
   964→			hasNew = true
   965→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: error checking session content, assuming new content",
   966→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   967→				slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()),
   968→			)
   969→		}
   970→	}
   971→	transitionCtx.HasFilesTouched = len(state.FilesTouched) > 0
   972→
   973→	// Save FilesTouched BEFORE TransitionAndLog — the handler's condensation
   974→	// clears it, but we need the original list for carry-forward computation.
   975→	// Only fall back to transcript extraction for ACTIVE sessions — IDLE/ENDED
   976→	// sessions have FilesTouched already populated by SaveStep/mergeFilesTouched.
   977→	var filesTouchedBefore []string
   978→	if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   979→		filesTouchedBefore = s.resolveFilesTouched(ctx, state)
   980→	} else if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   981→		filesTouchedBefore = make([]string, len(state.FilesTouched))
   982→		copy(filesTouchedBefore, state.FilesTouched)
   983→	}
   984→	checkContentSpan.End()
   985→
   986→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward prep",
   987→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   988→		slog.Bool("is_active", state.Phase.IsActive()),
   989→		slog.String("transcript_path", state.TranscriptPath),
   990→		slog.Int("files_touched_before", len(filesTouchedBefore)),
   991→		slog.Any("files", filesTouchedBefore),
   992→	)
   993→
   994→	// Run the state machine transition with handler for strategy-specific actions.
   995→	_, transitionAndCondenseSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "transition_and_condense")
   996→	handler := &postCommitActionHandler{
   997→		s:                      s,
   998→		ctx:                    ctx,
   999→		repo:                   repo,
  1000→		checkpointID:           checkpointID,
  1001→		head:                   head,
  1002→		commit:                 commit,
  1003→		newHead:                newHead,
  1004→		repoDir:                repoDir,
  1005→		shadowBranchName:       shadowBranchName,
  1006→		shadowBranchesToDelete: shadowBranchesToDelete,
  1007→		committedFileSet:       committedFileSet,
  1008→		hasNew:                 hasNew,
  1009→		filesTouchedBefore:     filesTouchedBefore,
  1010→		headTree:               headTree,
  1011→		parentTree:             parentTree,
  1012→		shadowRef:              shadowRef,
  1013→		shadowTree:             shadowTree,
  1014→	}
  1015→
  1016→	if err := TransitionAndLog(ctx, state, session.EventGitCommit, *transitionCtx, handler); err != nil {
  1017→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit action handler error",
  1018→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1019→	}
  1020→	transitionAndCondenseSpan.End()
  1021→
  1022→	// Record checkpoint ID for ACTIVE sessions so HandleTurnEnd can finalize
  1023→	// with full transcript. IDLE/ENDED sessions already have complete transcripts.
  1024→	// NOTE: This check runs AFTER TransitionAndLog updated the phase. It relies on
  1025→	// ACTIVE + GitCommit → ACTIVE (phase stays ACTIVE). If that state machine
  1026→	// transition ever changed, this guard would silently stop recording IDs.
  1027→	if handler.condensed && state.Phase.IsActive() {
  1028→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = append(state.TurnCheckpointIDs, checkpointID.String())
  1029→	}
  1030→
  1031→	// Carry forward remaining uncommitted files so the next commit gets its
  1032→	// own checkpoint ID. This applies to ALL phases — if a user splits their
  1033→	// commit across two `git commit` invocations, each gets a 1:1 checkpoint.
  1034→	// Uses content-aware comparison: if user did `git add -p` and committed
  1035→	// partial changes, the file still has remaining agent changes to carry forward.
  1036→	_, carryForwardSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "carry_forward_files")
  1037→	if handler.condensed {
  1038→		remainingFiles := filesWithRemainingAgentChanges(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, commit, filesTouchedBefore, committedFileSet, overlapOpts{
  1039→			headTree:   headTree,
  1040→			shadowTree: shadowTree,
  1041→		})
  1042→		state.FilesTouched = remainingFiles
  1043→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward decision (content-aware)",
  1044→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1045→			slog.Int("files_touched_before", len(filesTouchedBefore)),
  1046→			slog.Int("committed_files", len(committedFileSet)),
  1047→			slog.Int("remaining_files", len(remainingFiles)),
  1048→			slog.Any("remaining", remainingFiles),
  1049→			slog.Any("committed_files", committedFileSet),
  1050→		)
  1051→		if len(remainingFiles) > 0 {
  1052→			s.carryForwardToNewShadowBranch(ctx, repo, state, remainingFiles)
  1053→		}
  1054→
  1055→		// Clear filesystem prompt.txt only when ALL files are committed.
  1056→		// If carry-forward files remain, the prompt must persist so the next
  1057→		// condensation (triggered by the next commit) can read it.
  1058→		if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
  1059→			clearFilesystemPrompt(ctx, state.SessionID)
  1060→		}
  1061→	}
  1062→	carryForwardSpan.End()
  1063→
  1064→	// Mark ENDED sessions as fully condensed when there's nothing left to do:
  1065→	// condensed with no carry-forward remaining.
  1066→	if handler.condensed && state.Phase == session.PhaseEnded && len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
  1067→		state.FullyCondensed = true
  1068→	}
  1069→
  1070→	// Save the updated state
  1071→	_, saveSessionStateSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "save_session_state")
  1072→	if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
  1073→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session state",
  1074→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1075→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1076→	}
  1077→	saveSessionStateSpan.End()
  1078→
  1079→	// Only preserve shadow branch for active sessions that were NOT condensed.
  1080→	// Condensed sessions already have their data on entire/checkpoints/v1.
  1081→	if state.Phase.IsActive() && !handler.condensed {
  1082→		uncondensedActiveOnBranch[shadowBranchName] = true
  1083→	}
  1084→}
  1085→
  1086→// condenseAndUpdateState runs condensation for a session and updates state afterward.
  1087→// Returns true if condensation succeeded.
  1088→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) condenseAndUpdateState(

+// TestPostCommit_Issue591_SubagentScaleRegression is a regression test for GitHub
+// issue #591: accumulated stale ENDED sessions caused O(N) overhead on every commit
+// (~73-103ms per session, indefinitely). After the fix, they are force-condensed on
+// the first PostCommit and skipped via FullyCondensed on all subsequent commits.
+//
+// Behavioral coverage (FullyCondensed/StepCount/FilesTouched assertions) lives in
+// TestPostCommit_EndedSessionCarryForward_ForceCondensedWithoutOverlap. This test
+// focuses on the performance contract: the second PostCommit must be significantly
+// faster than the first once sessions are marked FullyCondensed.
+func TestPostCommit_Issue591_SubagentScaleRegression(t *testing.T) {
+	const sessionCount = 10
+
+	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
+	t.Chdir(dir)
+	paths.ClearWorktreeRootCache()
+
+	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
+
+	// Create sessions with shadow branches, then mark them stale ENDED.
+	// Each session's FilesTouched = ["test.txt"], which won't overlap with the
+	// unrelated.txt commit below, triggering the force-condense path.
+	for i := range sessionCount {
+		sessionID := fmt.Sprintf("ended-session-%d", i)
+		setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
+		state, err := s.loadSessionState(context.Background(), sessionID)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		staleAt := time.Now().Add(-(forceCondenseThreshold + time.Minute))
+		state.Phase = session.PhaseEnded
+		state.EndedAt = &staleAt
+		require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(context.Background(), state))
+	}
+
+	// Commit an unrelated file — no overlap with any session's FilesTouched.
+	wt, err := repo.Worktree()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "unrelated.txt"), []byte("user work"), 0o644))
+	_, err = wt.Add("unrelated.txt")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = wt.Commit("unrelated\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: a1b2c3d4e5f6\n", &git.CommitOptions{
+		Author: &object.Signature{Name: "User", Email: "user@test.com", When: time.Now()},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	paths.ClearWorktreeRootCache()

# Code Review: perf/force-condense-ended-sessions (Shadow-Tree-as-Index Optimization)

## Summary

This branch replaces the old O(N) PostCommit session discovery (scan ALL session state files + N ref lookups) with an O(1) approach: compute the single shadow branch that matters based on the parent of HEAD, then list session IDs from its `.entire/metadata/*` tree entries. Additionally, it adds eager condensation on session stop via `CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed` and removes the time-based `forceCondenseThreshold` entirely.

## Previous Review Status

No previous reviews found.

## Findings

### Critical (Must Fix)

None.

### Important (Should Fix)

1. **[manual_commit_session.go:192-219] Step 2 fallback scans all session state files, partially undermining O(1) claim.**
   The `findSessionsFromShadowTree` function has a Step 2 that iterates `store.List(ctx)` (all session state files) to catch ACTIVE sessions without SaveStep and carry-forward sessions not visible in the shadow tree. While the per-iteration cost is cheap (JSON parse, no ref lookups), this still means PostCommit touches every state file on disk. The O(1) claim in the docstring/commit message is technically inaccurate -- it's O(1) in ref lookups but O(N) in state file reads.

   This is an important caveat to document honestly. In practice, reading N small JSON files from `.git/entire-sessions/` is much cheaper than N ref lookups, so the performance improvement is real. But future readers of the "O(1)" comment may be surprised when they see the full scan.

   **Suggestion:** Update the docstring on `findSessionsFromShadowTree` and the PostCommit comment at line 811 from "O(1) PostCommit regardless of total accumulated session count" to something like "O(1) in git ref lookups; state file scan is cheap JSON-only (no git operations)."

2. **[phase_postcommit_test.go:1694-1741] `TestPostCommit_EndedSession_SameBaseCommit_ProcessedNormally` covers the overlap path but not the no-overlap-with-carry-forward path.**
   This test creates an ENDED session with `FilesTouched = ["test.txt"]` and then commits `test.txt` (which overlaps). This validates the normal condensation path. However, the diff originally had `TestPostCommit_RecentEndedSession_NotForceCondensed` which appears to have been removed in the final simplification. The current branch has no test verifying what happens when an ENDED session with carry-forward files on the *same shadow branch* does NOT have file overlap with the committed files.

   Looking at the code path: such a session would be discovered (Step 1 or Step 2b of `findSessionsFromShadowTree`), then `HandleCondenseIfFilesTouched` fires, `shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck` returns false (no overlap), and `updateBaseCommitIfChanged` skips it (non-active). The session remains unchanged -- it's not condensed, not FullyCondensed, and its BaseCommit is frozen. This is correct behavior (the session will eventually become structurally invisible when HEAD moves to a new base), but there's no explicit unit test for this exact scenario.

   **Suggestion:** Add a small test that creates an ENDED session with carry-forward files on the same shadow branch, commits an unrelated file, and asserts the session is NOT condensed and NOT marked FullyCondensed. The integration test `TestSubagentAccumulation_Issue591` covers this indirectly in Phase 3, but a focused unit test would make the contract explicit.

### Suggestions (Consider)

1. **[manual_commit_condensation.go:860-959] `CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed` fail-open behavior is well-designed.**
   The method correctly fails open on errors, logging warnings rather than propagating errors. The early-exit conditions (FilesTouched > 0 means skip, StepCount <= 0 means mark FullyCondensed immediately) are well-documented. # Code Review: perf/force-condense-ended-sessions (Shadow-Tree-as-Index Optimization)

## Summary

This branch replaces the old O(N) PostCommit session discovery (scan ALL session state files + N ref lookups) with an O(1) approach: compute the single shadow branch that matters based on the parent of HEAD, then list session IDs from its `.entire/metadata/*` tree entries. Additionally, it adds eager condensation on session stop via `CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed` and removes the time-based `forceCondenseThreshold` entirely.

## Previous Review Status

No previous reviews found.

## Findings

### Critical (Must Fix)

None.

### Important (Should Fix)

1. **[manual_commit_session.go:192-219] Step 2 fallback scans all session state files, partially undermining O(1) claim.**
   The `findSessionsFromShadowTree` function has a Step 2 that iterates `store.List(ctx)` (all session state files) to catch ACTIVE sessions without SaveStep and carry-forward sessions not visible in the shadow tree. While the per-iteration cost is cheap (JSON parse, no ref lookups), this still means PostCommit touches every state file on disk. The O(1) claim in the docstring/commit message is technically inaccurate -- it's O(1) in ref lookups but O(N) in state file reads.

   This is an important caveat to document honestly. In practice, reading N small JSON files from `.git/entire-sessions/` is much cheaper than N ref lookups, so the performance improvement is real. But future readers of the "O(1)" comment may be surprised when they see the full scan.

   **Suggestion:** Update the docstring on `findSessionsFromShadowTree` and the PostCommit comment at line 811 from "O(1) PostCommit regardless of total accumulated session count" to something like "O(1) in git ref lookups; state file scan is cheap JSON-only (no git operations)."

2. **[phase_postcommit_test.go:1694-1741] `TestPostCommit_EndedSession_SameBaseCommit_ProcessedNormally` covers the overlap path but not the no-overlap-with-carry-forward path.**
   This test creates an ENDED session with `FilesTouched = ["test.txt"]` and then commits `test.txt` (which overlaps). This validates the normal condensation path. However, the diff originally had `TestPostCommit_RecentEndedSession_NotForceCondensed` which appears to have been removed in the final simplification. The current branch has no test verifying what happens when an ENDED session with carry-forward files on the *same shadow branch* does NOT have file overlap with the committed files.

   Looking at the code path: such a session would be discovered (Step 1 or Step 2b of `findSessionsFromShadowTree`), then `HandleCondenseIfFilesTouched` fires, `shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck` returns false (no overlap), and `updateBaseCommitIfChanged` skips it (non-active). The session remains unchanged -- it's not condensed, not FullyCondensed, and its BaseCommit is frozen. This is correct behavior (the session will eventually become structurally invisible when HEAD moves to a new base), but there's no explicit unit test for this exact scenario.

   **Suggestion:** Add a small test that creates an ENDED session with carry-forward files on the same shadow branch, commits an unrelated file, and asserts the session is NOT condensed and NOT marked FullyCondensed. The integration test `TestSubagentAccumulation_Issue591` covers this indirectly in Phase 3, but a focused unit test would make the contract explicit.

### Suggestions (Consider)

1. **[manual_commit_condensation.go:860-959] `CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed` fail-open behavior is well-designed.**
   The method correctly fails open on errors, logging warnings rather than propagating errors. The early-exit conditions (FilesTouched > 0 means skip, StepCount <= 0 means mark FullyCondensed immediately) are well-documented. One minor note: the method name suggests it always condenses, but it has several no-op paths. A docstring addition like "Returns nil without condensing when..." would help.

2. **[accumulation_bench_test.go:28] Test name still references "SubagentScale" in the diff but the on-disk version correctly references "ShadowTreeIndex".**
   This is already resolved in the final version -- the on-disk file has `TestPostCommit_Issue591_ShadowTreeIndexPerformance` which accurately describes the test.

3. **[integration_test/subagent_accumulation_test.go:160-181] The Phase 4 assertion is wisely flexible.**
   The test checks that sessions are either cleaned up (state file gone) OR still present but NOT FullyCondensed. This accounts for both possible outcomes (orphaned cleanup vs. structural invisibility) without being brittle. Good pattern.

4. **[lifecycle.go:618-637] Early return on `markSessionEnded` failure is correct.**
   The original code continued past `markSessionEnded` errors. Adding the early return prevents attempting eager condensation on a session in potentially inconsistent state. Good defensive improvement.

### Praise

- **Shadow-tree-as-index approach is architecturally elegant.** Instead of adding more heuristics (time thresholds, force-condense), the optimization leverages a structural invariant (ENDED sessions have frozen BaseCommit) to make them invisible when HEAD moves forward. This is a much cleaner solution than time-based garbage collection.

- **The invariant that ENDED sessions' BaseCommit is frozen is well-enforced.** `updateBaseCommitIfChanged` has an explicit guard at line 1160 that skips non-active sessions, and this invariant is documented in the CLAUDE.md requirements context.

- **Eager condense on session stop (`CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed`) is a good defense-in-depth.** Sessions without FilesTouched are cleaned up immediately at session end, so PostCommit never even sees them. Sessions WITH FilesTouched are left for PostCommit but become structurally invisible once HEAD advances. Two complementary cleanup paths.

- **Test coverage is thorough.** The branch adds unit tests for the FullyCondensed marking (`TestPostCommit_EmptyEndedSession_MarkedFullyCondensed`), eager condensation guards (`TestCondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed_Guards`, `_WithDataNoFiles`), same-base-commit discovery (`TestPostCommit_EndedSession_SameBaseCommit_ProcessedNormally`), performance regression (`TestPostCommit_Issue591_ShadowTreeIndexPerformance`), and an integration test for the full subagent accumulation scenario.

- **The `extractSessionIDsFromTree` function is simple and robust.** It navigates to `.entire/metadata/` in the shadow tree and reads directory entries -- no fragile parsing or assumptions about tree structure.

- **Clean removal of `forceCondenseThreshold`.** No vestiges of the time-threshold code remain in the codebase.

## Edge Cases Analysis

1. **Initial commit (no parent):** `parentHash` is empty string, Step 1 of `findSessionsFromShadowTree` is skipped. Step 2 still catches ACTIVE sessions. Correct.

2. **ACTIVE session without SaveStep yet:** No shadow branch data, but Step 2a catches it via `state.Phase.IsActive()`. Correct.

3. **Carry-forward sessions with matching BaseCommit:** Step 2b catches them via `state.BaseCommit == parentCommitHash && len(state.FilesTouched) > 0`. Correct.

4. **Concurrent sessions on same shadow branch:** Both sessions' metadata exist in the shadow tree, so `extractSessionIDsFromTree` finds both. Correct.

5. **Branch switching:** When user switches branches, HEAD changes. ENDED sessions from the old branch have a different BaseCommit, so they're structurally invisible. Correct.

6. **Merge commits with multiple parents:** The code only checks `commit.Parent(0)` (first parent). For merge commits, this is the branch being merged into. Sessions from the other branch's shadow won't be discovered, which is correct -- those sessions belong to a different commit lineage.

## Verdict: **APPROVE**

The shadow-tree-as-index optimization is well-designed and correctly leverages the structural invariant that ENDED sessions have frozen BaseCommit. The code is clean, the test coverage is comprehensive, and the fallback paths are defensive. The two "Important" items above are documentation accuracy (O(1) claim) and a missing targeted unit test for the no-overlap-same-branch case -- neither blocks merge.

**Estimated effort to address feedback:** 30 minutes (documentation tweaks + one small test).

### Iteration 1 Results

**Reviewer verdict: APPROVE**

Two non-critical items flagged:
1. **Documentation accuracy**: The O(1) claim in comments is misleading — it's O(1) in ref lookups but still O(N) in state file reads (cheap JSON, no git ops). Suggest updating docstrings.
2. **Missing unit test**: No explicit test for ENDED session with carry-forward files on the *same* shadow branch but no file overlap (should be skipped/left unchanged).

Since the reviewer approved but has actionable suggestions, let me send these back to the developer for a quick fix.

The shadow-branch-as-index optimization is implemented and passing all tests. Here's what was built:

### Architecture Change
- **Before**: PostCommit scanned ALL session state files (`findSessionsForWorktree` → `listAllSessionStates`) doing N ref lookups
- **After**: PostCommit computes the one shadow branch that matters from parent commit hash, extracts session IDs from the shadow tree's `.entire/metadata/*` entries, loads only those state files

### Key Changes
- **`manual_commit_session.go`**: New `findSessionsFromShadowTree()` replaces `findSessionsForWorktree` in PostCommit. Uses shadow tree as index + cheap state file fallback for ACTIVE sessions and carry-forward sessions
- **`manual_commit_hooks.go`**: Removed `forceCondenseThreshold`, `isStaleEnded()`, `forceCondensed` field, and force-condense code path. PostCommit uses new session discovery. Simplified `FullyCondensed` marking condition

Review all changed files for reuse, quality, and efficiency. Fix any issues found.

## Phase 1: Identify Changes

Run `git diff` (or `git diff HEAD` if there are staged changes) to see what changed. If there are no git changes, review the most recently modified files that the user mentioned or that you edited earlier in this conversation.

## Phase 2: Launch Three Review Agents in Parallel

Use the Agent tool to launch all three agents concurrently in a single message. Pass each agent the full diff so it has the complete context.

### Agent 1: Code Reuse Review

For each change:

1. **Search for existing utilities and helpers** that could replace newly written code. Look for similar patterns elsewhere in the codebase — common locations are utility directories, shared modules, and files adjacent to the changed ones.
2. **Flag any new function that duplicates existing functionality.** Suggest the existing function to use instead.
3. **Flag any inline logic that could use an existing utility** — hand-rolled string manipulation, manual path handling, custom environment checks, ad-hoc type guards, and similar patterns are common candidates.

### Agent 2: Code Quality Review

Review the same changes for hacky patterns:

1. **Redundant state**: state that duplicates existing state, cached values that could be derived, observers/effects that could be direct calls
2. **Parameter sprawl**: adding new parameters to a function instead of generalizing or restructuring existing ones
3. **Copy-paste with slight variation**: near-duplicate code blocks that should be unified with a shared abstraction
4. **Leaky abstractions**: exposing internal details that should be encapsulated, or breaking existing abstraction boundaries
5. **Stringly-typed code**: using raw strings where constants, enums (string unions), or branded types already exist in the codebase
6. **Unnecessary JSX nesting**: wrapper Boxes/elements that add no layout value — check if inner component props (flexShrink, alignItems, etc.) already provide the needed behavior

### Agent 3: Efficiency Review

Review the same changes for efficiency:

1. **Unnecessary work**: redundant computations, repeated file reads, duplicate network/API calls, N+1 patterns
2. **Missed concurrency**: independent operations run sequentially when they could run in parallel
3. **Hot-path bloat**: new blocking work added to startup or per-request/per-render hot paths
4. **Recurring no-op updates**: state/store updates inside polling loops, intervals, or event handlers that fire unconditionally — add a change-detection guard so downstream consumers aren't notified when nothing changed. Also: if a wrapper function takes an updater/reducer callback, verify it honors same-reference returns (or whatever the "no change" signal is) — otherwise callers' early-return no-ops are silently defeated
5. **Unnecessary existence checks**: pre-checking file/resource existence before operating (TOCTOU anti-pattern) — operate directly and handle the error
6. **Memory**: unbounded data structures, missing cleanup, event listener leaks
7. **Overly broad operations**: reading entire files when only a portion is needed, loading all items when filtering for one

## Phase 3: Fix Issues

Wait for all three agents to complete. Aggregate their findings and fix each issue directly. If a finding is a false positive or not worth addressing, note it and move on — do not argue with the finding, just skip it.

+//go:build integration
+
+package integration
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/session"
+)
+
+// TestSubagentAccumulation_Issue591 reproduces the issue #591 shape: multiple
+// subagent sessions end with uncommitted files that never overlap with a later
+// parent-session commit. The stale ENDED subagent sessions must be force-condensed
+// on that later commit so they do not accumulate and get re-processed forever.
+func TestSubagentAccumulation_Issue591(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t)
+
+	type subagentInfo struct {
+		SessionID string
+		File      string
+	}
+
+	t.Log("Phase 1: start parent session and create stale ended subagent sessions")
+
+	parent := env.NewSession()
+	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(parent.ID); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit for parent failed: %v", err)
+	}
+	parent.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Use subagents to investigate the work and then create the parent file.")
+
+	const numSubagents = 4
+	subagents := make([]subagentInfo, 0, numSubagents)
+
+	for i := 0; i < numSubagents; i++ {
+		sub := env.NewSession()
+		file := fmt.Sprintf("subagent_work_%d.go", i)
+		content := fmt.Sprintf("package main\n\nfunc SubagentWork%d() {}\n", i)
+
+		if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(sub.ID); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit for subagent %d failed: %v", i, err)
+		}
+
+		env.WriteFile(file, content)
+		sub.CreateTranscript("Create "+file, []FileChange{
+			{Path: file, Content: content},
+		})
+
+		if err := env.SimulateStop(sub.ID, sub.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("SimulateStop for subagent %d failed: %v", i, err)
+		}
+		if err := env.SimulateSessionEnd(sub.ID); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("SimulateSessionEnd for subagent %d failed: %v", i, err)
+		}
+
+		state, err := env.GetSessionState(sub.ID)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("GetSessionState for subagent %d failed: %v", i, err)
+		}
+		if state == nil {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d session state missing", i)
+		}
+		if state.Phase != session.PhaseEnded {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d phase = %s, want ended", i, state.Phase)
+		}
+		if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d FilesTouched should be non-empty before cleanup", i)
+		}
+		if state.StepCount == 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d StepCount should be > 0 before cleanup", i)
+		}
+		if state.FullyCondensed {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d should not be FullyCondensed before cleanup", i)
+		}
+
+		staleEndedAt := time.Now().Add(-2 * time.Hour)
+		state.EndedAt = &staleEndedAt
+		if err := env.WriteSessionState(sub.ID, state); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("WriteSessionState for subagent %d failed: %v", i, err)
+		}
+
+		taskToolUseID := fmt.Sprintf("toolu_parent_subagent_%d", i)
+		parent.TranscriptBuilder.AddTaskToolUse(taskToolUseID, "Create "+file)
+		parent.TranscriptBuilder.AddTaskToolResult(taskToolUseID, sub.ID)
+
+		subagents = append(subagents, subagentInfo{
+			SessionID: sub.ID,
+			File:      file,
+		})
+	}
+
+	t.Log("Phase 2: parent commits unrelated work")
+
+	parentFile := "parent_work.go"
+	parentContent := "package main\n\nfunc ParentWork() {}\n"
+	env.WriteFile(parentFile, parentContent)
+	parentToolUseID := parent.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", parentFile, parentContent)
+	parent.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(parentToolUseID)
+	parent.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done.")
+	if err := parent.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(parent.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to write parent transcript: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	if err := env.SimulateStop(parent.ID, parent.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop for parent failed: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Parent commit", parentFile)
+
+	t.Log("Phase 3: verify stale ended subagent sessions were force-condensed")
+
+	for i, sub := range subagents {
+		state, err := env.GetSessionState(sub.SessionID)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("GetSessionState after parent commit for subagent %d failed: %v", i, err)
+		}
+		if state == nil {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d session state missing after parent commit", i)
+		}
+		if state.Phase != session.PhaseEnded {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d phase after parent commit = %s, want ended", i, state.Phase)
+		}
+		if state.StepCount != 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d StepCount = %d, want 0 after force-condense", i, state.StepCount)
+		}
+		if len(state.FilesTouched) != 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d FilesTouched = %v, want empty after force-condense", i, state.FilesTouched)
+		}
+		if !state.FullyCondensed {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d should be FullyCondensed after force-condense", i)
+		}
+	}
+
+	t.Log("Phase 4: make another unrelated commit and verify fully-condensed subagents stay skipped")
+
+	followUp := env.NewSession()
+	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(followUp.ID); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit for follow-up session failed: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	followUpFile := "follow_up.go"
+	followUpContent := "package main\n\nfunc FollowUp() {}\n"
+	env.WriteFile(followUpFile, followUpContent)
+	followUp.CreateTranscript("Create "+followUpFile, []FileChange{
+		{Path: followUpFile, Content: followUpContent},
+	})
+	if err := env.SimulateStop(followUp.ID, followUp.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop for follow-up session failed: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Follow-up commit", followUpFile)
+
+	for i, sub := range subagents {
+		state, err := env.GetSessionState(sub.SessionID)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("GetSessionState after follow-up commit for subagent %d failed: %v", i, err)
+		}
+		if state == nil {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d session state missing after follow-up commit", i)
+		}
+		if !state.FullyCondensed {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d should remain FullyCondensed after follow-up commit", i)
+		}
+		if state.StepCount != 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d StepCount = %d after follow-up commit, want 0", i, state.StepCount)
+		}
+	}
+}

+package strategy
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/paths"
+	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/session"
+
+	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v6"
+	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v6/plumbing/object"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+// TestPostCommit_Issue591_SubagentScaleRegression is a regression test for GitHub
+// issue #591: accumulated stale ENDED sessions caused O(N) overhead on every commit
+// (~73-103ms per session, indefinitely). After the fix, they are force-condensed on
+// the first PostCommit and skipped via FullyCondensed on all subsequent commits.
+//
+// Behavioral coverage (FullyCondensed/StepCount/FilesTouched assertions) lives in
+// TestPostCommit_EndedSessionCarryForward_ForceCondensedWithoutOverlap. This test
+// focuses on the performance contract: the second PostCommit must be significantly
+// faster than the first once sessions are marked FullyCondensed.
+func TestPostCommit_Issue591_SubagentScaleRegression(t *testing.T) {
+	const sessionCount = 10
+
+	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
+	t.Chdir(dir)
+	paths.ClearWorktreeRootCache()
+
+	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
+
+	// Create sessions with shadow branches, then mark them stale ENDED.
+	// Each session's FilesTouched = ["test.txt"], which won't overlap with the
+	// unrelated.txt commit below, triggering the force-condense path.
+	for i := range sessionCount {
+		sessionID := fmt.Sprintf("ended-session-%d", i)
+		setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
+		state, err := s.loadSessionState(context.Background(), sessionID)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		staleAt := time.Now().Add(-(forceCondenseThreshold + time.Minute))
+		state.Phase = session.PhaseEnded
+		state.EndedAt = &staleAt
+		require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(context.Background(), state))
+	}
+
+	// Commit an unrelated file — no overlap with any session's FilesTouched.
+	wt, err := repo.Worktree()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "unrelated.txt"), []byte("user work"), 0o644))
+	_, err = wt.Add("unrelated.txt")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = wt.Commit("unrelated\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: a1b2c3d4e5f6\n", &git.CommitOptions{
+		Author: &object.Signature{Name: "User", Email: "user@test.com", When: time.Now()},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	paths.ClearWorktreeRootCache()
+
+	// First PostCommit: force-condenses all stale ENDED sessions.
+	firstStart := time.Now()
+	require.NoError(t, s.PostCommit(context.Background()))
+	firstElapsed := time.Since(firstStart)
+
+	// Create second commit — all sessions are now FullyCondensed and should be skipped.
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "second.txt"), []byte("second"), 0o644))
+	_, err = wt.Add("second.txt")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = wt.Commit("second\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: b1b2b3b4b5b6\n", &git.CommitOptions{
+		Author: &object.Signature{Name: "User", Email: "user@test.com", When: time.Now()},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	paths.ClearWorktreeRootCache()
+
+	s2 := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
+	secondStart := time.Now()
+	require.NoError(t, s2.PostCommit(context.Background()))
+	secondElapsed := time.Since(secondStart)
+
+	// Second PostCommit must be significantly faster — sessions are FullyCondensed and skipped.
+	assert.Less(t, secondElapsed, firstElapsed/2,
+		"second PostCommit should be much faster once sessions are FullyCondensed (issue #591 regression)")
+	t.Logf("first PostCommit (%d stale sessions): %v, second (all skipped): %v",
+		sessionCount, firstElapsed, secondElapsed)
+}

+// CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed condenses an ENDED session and marks it
+// FullyCondensed in one operation. Used by the session stop hook to eagerly
+// clean up sessions so PostCommit doesn't have to process them.
+//
+// This does NOT call CondenseSessionByID because that method has two behaviors
+// we don't want: (1) it calls clearSessionState when no shadow branch exists
+// (deletes the state file entirely), and (2) it sets Phase = IDLE. Instead,
+// we inline the condensation logic with ENDED-appropriate behavior.
+//
+// Fail-open: if condensation fails, the session is left in its current state
+// and PostCommit's force-condense safety net will catch it later.
+func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
+	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
+
+	state, err := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
+	}
+	if state == nil {
+		return nil // No state file
+	}
+
+	// Sessions with FilesTouched must be processed by PostCommit for carry-forward
+	// tracking — each user commit that overlaps with tracked files gets its own
+	// checkpoint. Eagerly condensing here would prevent that 1:1 linkage.
+	if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	// Only condense if there's uncondensed data
+	if state.StepCount <= 0 {
+		// No data and no files — mark FullyCondensed
+		state.FullyCondensed = true
+		return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
+	}
+
+	// Check if shadow branch exists — required for condensation
+	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to open repository",
+			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
+			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
+		)
+		return nil // fail-open
+	}
+
+	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
+	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
+	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
+	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
+
+	if !hasShadowBranch {
+		// No shadow branch = no checkpoint data to condense.
+		// Unlike CondenseSessionByID, we do NOT delete the state file.
+		logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense: no shadow branch",
+			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
+			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
+		)
+		state.StepCount = 0
+		state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
+		return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
+	}
+
+	// Generate checkpoint ID and condense
+	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
+	if err != nil {
+		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to generate checkpoint ID",
+			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
+		)
+		return nil // fail-open
+	}
+
+	// Condense with nil committedFiles (include all FilesTouched)
+	result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop failed, PostCommit will retry",
+			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
+			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
+		)
+		return nil // fail-open
+	}
+
+	// Update state — keep Phase = ENDED (unlike CondenseSessionByID which sets IDLE)
+	state.StepCount = 0
+	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
+	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
+	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
+	state.PromptAttributions = nil
+	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
+	state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
+	// Phase stays ENDED — do NOT set to IDLE
+
+	logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop succeeded",
+		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
+		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
+	)
+
+	if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	// Clean up shadow branch
+	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
+		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to clean up shadow branch",
+			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
+			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
+		)
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}

+// subagent sessions end with uncommitted files that never overlap with a later
+// parent-session commit. The stale ENDED subagent sessions must be force-condensed
+// on that later commit so they do not accumulate and get re-processed forever.
+func TestSubagentAccumulation_Issue591(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t)
+
+	type subagentInfo struct {
+		SessionID string
+		File      string
+	}
+
+	t.Log("Phase 1: start parent session and create stale ended subagent sessions")
+
+	parent := env.NewSession()
+	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(parent.ID); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit for parent failed: %v", err)
+	}

+
+	const numSubagents = 4
+	subagents := make([]subagentInfo, 0, numSubagents)
+
+	for i := 0; i < numSubagents; i++ {
+		sub := env.NewSession()
+		file := fmt.Sprintf("subagent_work_%d.go", i)
+		content := fmt.Sprintf("package main\n\nfunc SubagentWork%d() {}\n", i)
+
+		if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(sub.ID); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit for subagent %d failed: %v", i, err)
+		}
+
+		env.WriteFile(file, content)

+			{Path: file, Content: content},
+		})
+
+		if err := env.SimulateStop(sub.ID, sub.TranscriptPath); err != nil {

+		}
+		if err := env.SimulateSessionEnd(sub.ID); err != nil {

+		}
+
+		state, err := env.GetSessionState(sub.ID)

+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d StepCount should be > 0 before cleanup", i)
+		}

+			t.Fatalf("subagent %d should not be FullyCondensed before cleanup", i)
+		}

+		if state.Phase != session.PhaseEnded {

+		}

+// TestPostCommit_Issue591_SubagentScaleRegression is a regression test for GitHub
+// issue #591: accumulated stale ENDED sessions caused O(N) overhead on every commit
+// (~73-103ms per session, indefinitely). After the fix, they are force-condensed on
+// the first PostCommit and skipped via FullyCondensed on all subsequent commits.
+//
+// Behavioral coverage (FullyCondensed/StepCount/FilesTouched assertions) lives in
+// TestPostCommit_EndedSessionCarryForward_ForceCondensedWithoutOverlap. This test
+// focuses on the performance contract: the second PostCommit must be significantly
+// faster than the first once sessions are marked FullyCondensed.
+func TestPostCommit_Issue591_SubagentScaleRegression(t *testing.T) {
+	const sessionCount = 10
+
+	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
+	t.Chdir(dir)
+	paths.ClearWorktreeRootCache()
+
+	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
+
+	// Create sessions with shadow branches, then mark them stale ENDED.
+	// Each session's FilesTouched = ["test.txt"], which won't overlap with the
+	// unrelated.txt commit below, triggering the force-condense path.
+	for i := range sessionCount {
+		sessionID := fmt.Sprintf("ended-session-%d", i)
+		setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
+		state, err := s.loadSessionState(context.Background(), sessionID)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		staleAt := time.Now().Add(-(forceCondenseThreshold + time.Minute))
+		state.Phase = session.PhaseEnded
+		state.EndedAt = &staleAt
+		require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(context.Background(), state))
+	}
+
+	// Commit an unrelated file — no overlap with any session's FilesTouched.
+	wt, err := repo.Worktree()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "unrelated.txt"), []byte("user work"), 0o644))
+	_, err = wt.Add("unrelated.txt")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = wt.Commit("unrelated\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: a1b2c3d4e5f6\n", &git.CommitOptions{
+		Author: &object.Signature{Name: "User", Email: "user@test.com", When: time.Now()},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	paths.ClearWorktreeRootCache()
+
+	// First PostCommit: force-condenses all stale ENDED sessions.
+	firstStart := time.Now()
+	require.NoError(t, s.PostCommit(context.Background()))
+	firstElapsed := time.Since(firstStart)
+
+	// Create second commit — all sessions are now FullyCondensed and should be skipped.
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "second.txt"), []byte("second"), 0o644))
+	_, err = wt.Add("second.txt")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = wt.Commit("second\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: b1b2b3b4b5b6\n", &git.CommitOptions{
+		Author: &object.Signature{Name: "User", Email: "user@test.com", When: time.Now()},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	paths.ClearWorktreeRootCache()
+
+	s2 := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
+	secondStart := time.Now()
+	require.NoError(t, s2.PostCommit(context.Background()))
+	secondElapsed := time.Since(secondStart)
+
+	// Second PostCommit must be significantly faster — sessions are FullyCondensed and skipped.
+	assert.Less(t, secondElapsed, firstElapsed/2,
+		"second PostCommit should be much faster once sessions are FullyCondensed (issue #591 regression)")
+	t.Logf("first PostCommit (%d stale sessions): %v, second (all skipped): %v",
+		sessionCount, firstElapsed, secondElapsed)
+}

+func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
+	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
+

+		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)

+	// tracking — each user commit that overlaps with tracked files gets its own
+	// checkpoint. Eagerly condensing here would prevent that 1:1 linkage.

+		return nil
+	}
+
+	// Only condense if there's uncondensed data
+	if state.StepCount <= 0 {
+		// No data and no files — mark FullyCondensed
+		state.FullyCondensed = true
+		return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
+	}
+
+	// Check if shadow branch exists — required for condensation
+	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to open repository",
+			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
+			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
+		)
+		return nil // fail-open
+	}
+
+	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
+	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
+	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
+	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
+
+	if !hasShadowBranch {
+		// No shadow branch = no checkpoint data to condense.
+		// Unlike CondenseSessionByID, we do NOT delete the state file.
+		logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense: no shadow branch",
+			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
+			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
+		)
+		state.StepCount = 0
+		state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
+		return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
+	}
+
+	// Generate checkpoint ID and condense
+	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
+	if err != nil {
+		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to generate checkpoint ID",
+			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
+		)
+		return nil // fail-open
+	}
+
+	// Condense with nil committedFiles (include all FilesTouched)
+	result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop failed, PostCommit will retry",
+			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
+			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
+		)
+		return nil // fail-open
+	}
+
+	// Update state — keep Phase = ENDED (unlike CondenseSessionByID which sets IDLE)
+	state.StepCount = 0
+	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
+	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
+	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
+	state.PromptAttributions = nil
+	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
+	state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
+	// Phase stays ENDED — do NOT set to IDLE
+
+	logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop succeeded",
+		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
+		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
+	)

+		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
+	}

+			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
+			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
+		)
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}

   102→// In this case, data is extracted from the live transcript instead.
   103→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSession(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, state *SessionState, committedFiles map[string]struct{}, opts ...condenseOpts) (*CondenseResult, error) {
   104→	ag, _ := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType) //nolint:errcheck // ag may be nil for unknown agent types; callers use type assertions so nil is safe
   105→	var o condenseOpts
   106→	if len(opts) > 0 {
   107→		o = opts[0]
   108→	}
   109→
   110→	// Get shadow branch — use pre-resolved ref if available, otherwise resolve from repo.
   111→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   112→	ref := o.shadowRef
   113→	var hasShadowBranch bool
   114→	if ref != nil {
   115→		hasShadowBranch = true
   116→	} else {
   117→		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   118→		var err error
   119→		ref, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
   120→		hasShadowBranch = err == nil
   121→	}
   122→
   123→	// Re-resolve transcript path before any reads — handles agents that relocate
   124→	// transcripts mid-session (e.g., Cursor CLI flat → nested layout change).
   125→	// Errors are ignored; downstream readers handle missing transcripts gracefully.
   126→	resolveTranscriptPath(state) //nolint:errcheck,gosec // best-effort; downstream readers handle missing files
   127→
   128→	var sessionData *ExtractedSessionData
   129→	if hasShadowBranch {
   130→		var extractErr error
   131→		sessionData, extractErr = s.extractSessionData(ctx, repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, state.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, state.Phase.IsActive())
   132→		if extractErr != nil {
   133→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data: %w", extractErr)
   134→		}
   135→	} else {
   136→		if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
   137→			return nil, errors.New("shadow branch not found and no live transcript available")
   138→		}
   139→		if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   140→			prepareTranscriptIfNeeded(ctx, ag, state.TranscriptPath)
   141→		}
   142→		var extractErr error
   143→		sessionData, extractErr = s.extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(ctx, state)
   144→		if extractErr != nil {
   145→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data from live transcript: %w", extractErr)
   146→		}
   147→	}
   148→
   149→	// Backfill session state token usage from the freshly-extracted transcript.
   150→	// Some agents (e.g., Copilot CLI) write aggregate token data (session.shutdown)
   151→	// AFTER all hooks return, so state.TokenUsage from turn-end only has fallback data.
   152→	// By condensation time, the transcript has the authoritative totals.
   153→	// Only replace when we got authoritative data (e.g., session.shutdown provides
   154→	// InputTokens; the fallback path only captures OutputTokens). This avoids
   155→	// overwriting accumulated multi-checkpoint totals with partial checkpoint data.
   156→	if sessionData.TokenUsage != nil && sessionData.TokenUsage.InputTokens > 0 {
   157→		state.TokenUsage = sessionData.TokenUsage
   158→	}
   159→
   160→	// For 1:1 checkpoint model: filter files_touched to only include files actually
   161→	// committed in this specific commit. This ensures each checkpoint represents
   162→	// exactly the files in that commit, not all files mentioned in the transcript.
   163→	if len(committedFiles) > 0 {
   164→		hadFilesBeforeFiltering := len(sessionData.FilesTouched) > 0
   165→
   166→		if hadFilesBeforeFiltering {
   167→			filtered := make([]string, 0, len(sessionData.FilesTouched))
   168→			for _, f := range sessionData.FilesTouched {
   169→				if _, ok := committedFiles[f]; ok {
   170→					filtered = append(filtered, f)
   171→				}
   172→			}
   173→			sessionData.FilesTouched = filtered
   174→		}
   175→
   176→		if len(sessionData.FilesTouched) == 0 && !hadFilesBeforeFiltering {
   177→			sessionData.FilesTouched = make([]string, 0, len(committedFiles))
   178→			for f := range committedFiles {
   179→				sessionData.FilesTouched = append(sessionData.FilesTouched, f)
   180→			}
   181→		}
   182→	}
   183→
   184→	// Get checkpoint store
   185→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   186→	if err != nil {
   187→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   188→	}
   189→
   190→	// Get author info
   191→	authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
   192→
   193→	// Determine attribution base commit
   194→	attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   195→	if attrBase == "" {
   196→		attrBase = state.BaseCommit
   197→	}
   198→
   199→	attribution := calculateSessionAttributions(ctx, repo, ref, sessionData, state, attributionOpts{
   200→		headTree:              o.headTree,
   201→		repoDir:               o.repoDir,
   202→		attributionBaseCommit: attrBase,
   203→		headCommitHash:        o.headCommitHash,
   204→	})
   205→
   206→	// Get current branch name
   207→	branchName := GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
   208→
   209→	// Generate summary if enabled
   210→	var summary *cpkg.Summary
   211→	if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled(ctx) && len(sessionData.Transcript) > 0 {
   212→		summarizeCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "summarize")
   213→
   214→		var scopedTranscript []byte
   215→		switch state.AgentType {
   216→		case agent.AgentTypeGemini:
   217→			scoped, sliceErr := geminicli.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   218→			if sliceErr != nil {
   219→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "failed to scope Gemini transcript for summary",
   220→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   221→					slog.String("error", sliceErr.Error()))
   222→			}
   223→			scopedTranscript = scoped
   224→		case agent.AgentTypeOpenCode:
   225→			scoped, sliceErr := opencode.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   226→			if sliceErr != nil {
   227→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "failed to scope OpenCode transcript for summary",
   228→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   229→					slog.String("error", sliceErr.Error()))
   230→			}
   231→			scopedTranscript = scoped
   232→		case agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode, agent.AgentTypeCursor, agent.AgentTypeFactoryAIDroid, agent.AgentTypeUnknown:
   233→			scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   234→		}
   235→		if len(scopedTranscript) > 0 {
   236→			var err error
   237→			summary, err = summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(summarizeCtx, scopedTranscript, sessionData.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, nil)
   238→			if err != nil {
   239→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "summary generation failed",
   240→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   241→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   242→			} else {
   243→				logging.Info(summarizeCtx, "summary generated",
   244→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
   245→			}
   246→		}
   247→	}
   248→
   249→	// Write checkpoint metadata using the checkpoint store
   250→	if err := store.WriteCommitted(ctx, cpkg.WriteCommittedOptions{
   251→		CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
   252→		SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
   253→		Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
   254→		Branch:                      branchName,
   255→		Transcript:                  sessionData.Transcript,
   256→		Prompts:                     sessionData.Prompts,
   257→		FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
   258→		CheckpointsCount:            state.StepCount,
   259→		EphemeralBranch:             shadowBranchName,
   260→		AuthorName:                  authorName,
   261→		AuthorEmail:                 authorEmail,
   262→		Agent:                       state.AgentType,
   263→		Model:                       state.ModelName,
   264→		TurnID:                      state.TurnID,
   265→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: state.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
   266→		CheckpointTranscriptStart:   state.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
   267→		TokenUsage:                  sessionData.TokenUsage,
   268→		SessionMetrics:              buildSessionMetrics(state),
   269→		InitialAttribution:          attribution,
   270→		Summary:                     summary,
   271→	}); err != nil {
   272→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	return &CondenseResult{
   276→		CheckpointID:         checkpointID,
   277→		SessionID:            state.SessionID,
   278→		CheckpointsCount:     state.StepCount,
   279→		FilesTouched:         sessionData.FilesTouched,
   280→		Prompts:              sessionData.Prompts,
   281→		TotalTranscriptLines: sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
   282→		Transcript:           sessionData.Transcript,
   283→	}, nil
   284→}

   286→// buildSessionMetrics creates a SessionMetrics from session state if any metrics are available.
   287→// Returns nil if no hook-provided metrics exist (e.g., for agents that don't report them).
   288→func buildSessionMetrics(state *SessionState) *cpkg.SessionMetrics {
   289→	if state.SessionDurationMs == 0 && state.SessionTurnCount == 0 && state.ContextTokens == 0 && state.ContextWindowSize == 0 {
   290→		return nil
   291→	}
   292→	return &cpkg.SessionMetrics{
   293→		DurationMs:        state.SessionDurationMs,
   294→		TurnCount:         state.SessionTurnCount,
   295→		ContextTokens:     state.ContextTokens,
   296→		ContextWindowSize: state.ContextWindowSize,
   297→	}
   298→}

   300→// attributionOpts provides pre-resolved git objects to avoid redundant reads.
   301→type attributionOpts struct {
   302→	headTree              *object.Tree // HEAD commit tree (already resolved by PostCommit)
   303→	shadowTree            *object.Tree // Shadow branch tree (already resolved by PostCommit)
   304→	repoDir               string       // Repository worktree path for git CLI commands
   305→	attributionBaseCommit string       // Base commit hash for non-agent file detection (empty = fall back to go-git tree walk)
   306→	headCommitHash        string       // HEAD commit hash for non-agent file detection (empty = fall back to go-git tree walk)
   307→}
   308→
   309→func calculateSessionAttributions(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState, opts ...attributionOpts) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
   310→	// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
   311→	// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
   312→	// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
   313→	//
   314→	// When shadowRef is nil (agent committed mid-turn before SaveStep),
   315→	// HEAD is used as the shadow tree. This is correct because the agent's
   316→	// commit IS HEAD — there are no user edits between agent work and commit.
   317→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "attribution")
   318→
   319→	var o attributionOpts
   320→	if len(opts) > 0 {
   321→		o = opts[0]
   322→	}
   323→
   324→	headTree := o.headTree
   325→	if headTree == nil {
   326→		headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
   327→		if headErr != nil {
   328→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
   329→				slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
   330→			return nil
   331→		}
   332→
   333→		headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
   334→		if commitErr != nil {
   335→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
   336→				slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
   337→			return nil
   338→		}
   339→
   340→		var treeErr error
   341→		headTree, treeErr = headCommit.Tree()
   342→		if treeErr != nil {
   343→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
   344→				slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
   345→			return nil
   346→		}
   347→	}
   348→
   349→	// Get shadow tree: from pre-resolved cache, shadow branch, or HEAD (agent committed directly).
   350→	shadowTree := o.shadowTree
   351→	if shadowTree == nil {
   352→		if shadowRef != nil {
   353→			shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
   354→			if shadowErr != nil {
   355→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
   356→					slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
   357→					slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
   358→				return nil
   359→			}
   360→			var shadowTreeErr error
   361→			shadowTree, shadowTreeErr = shadowCommit.Tree()
   362→			if shadowTreeErr != nil {
   363→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
   364→					slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
   365→				return nil
   366→			}
   367→		} else {
   368→			// No shadow branch: agent committed mid-turn. Use HEAD as shadow
   369→			// because the agent's work is the commit itself.
   370→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: using HEAD as shadow (no shadow branch)")
   371→			shadowTree = headTree
   372→		}
   373→	}
   374→
   375→	// Get base tree (state before session started)
   376→	var baseTree *object.Tree
   377→	attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   378→	if attrBase == "" {
   379→		attrBase = state.BaseCommit // backward compat
   380→	}
   381→	if baseCommit, baseErr := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(attrBase)); baseErr == nil {
   382→		if tree, baseTErr := baseCommit.Tree(); baseTErr == nil {
   383→			baseTree = tree
   384→		} else {
   385→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base tree unavailable",
   386→				slog.String("error", baseTErr.Error()))
   387→		}
   388→	} else {
   389→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base commit unavailable",
   390→			slog.String("error", baseErr.Error()),
   391→			slog.String("attribution_base", attrBase))
   392→	}
   393→
   394→	// Log accumulated prompt attributions for debugging
   395→	var totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved int
   396→	for i, pa := range state.PromptAttributions {
   397→		totalUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   398→		totalUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   399→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution data",
   400→			slog.Int("checkpoint", pa.CheckpointNumber),
   401→			slog.Int("user_added", pa.UserLinesAdded),
   402→			slog.Int("user_removed", pa.UserLinesRemoved),
   403→			slog.Int("agent_added", pa.AgentLinesAdded),
   404→			slog.Int("agent_removed", pa.AgentLinesRemoved),
   405→			slog.Int("index", i))
   406→	}
   407→
   408→	attribution := CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   409→		ctx,
   410→		baseTree,
   411→		shadowTree,
   412→		headTree,
   413→		sessionData.FilesTouched,
   414→		state.PromptAttributions,
   415→		o.repoDir,
   416→		o.attributionBaseCommit,
   417→		o.headCommitHash,
   418→	)
   419→
   420→	if attribution != nil {
   421→		logging.Info(logCtx, "attribution calculated",
   422→			slog.Int("agent_lines", attribution.AgentLines),
   423→			slog.Int("human_added", attribution.HumanAdded),
   424→			slog.Int("human_modified", attribution.HumanModified),
   425→			slog.Int("human_removed", attribution.HumanRemoved),
   426→			slog.Int("total_committed", attribution.TotalCommitted),
   427→			slog.Float64("agent_percentage", attribution.AgentPercentage),
   428→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_added", totalUserAdded),
   429→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_removed", totalUserRemoved),
   430→			slog.Int("files_touched", len(sessionData.FilesTouched)))
   431→	}
   432→
   433→	return attribution
   434→}

   436→// extractSessionData extracts session data from the shadow branch.
   437→// filesTouched is the list of files tracked during the session (from SessionState.FilesTouched).
   438→// agentType identifies the agent (e.g., "Gemini CLI", "Claude Code") to determine transcript format.
   439→// liveTranscriptPath, when non-empty and readable, is preferred over the shadow branch copy.
   440→// This handles the case where SaveStep was skipped (no code changes) but the transcript
   441→// continued growing — the shadow branch copy would be stale.
   442→// checkpointTranscriptStart is the line offset (Claude) or message index (Gemini) where the current checkpoint began.
   443→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionData(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, shadowRef plumbing.Hash, sessionID string, filesTouched []string, agentType types.AgentType, liveTranscriptPath string, checkpointTranscriptStart int, isActive bool) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   444→	ag, _ := agent.GetByAgentType(agentType) //nolint:errcheck // ag may be nil for unknown agent types; callers use type assertions so nil is safe
   445→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef)
   446→	if err != nil {
   447→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   448→	}
   449→
   450→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   451→	if err != nil {
   452→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   453→	}
   454→
   455→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   456→	// sessionID is already an "entire session ID" (with date prefix)
   457→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   458→
   459→	// Extract transcript — prefer the live file when available, fall back to shadow branch.
   460→	// The shadow branch copy may be stale if the last turn ended without code changes
   461→	// (SaveStep is only called when there are file modifications).
   462→	var fullTranscript string
   463→	if liveTranscriptPath != "" {
   464→		// Ensure transcript file exists (OpenCode creates it lazily via `opencode export`).
   465→		// Only wait for flush when the session is active — for idle/ended sessions the
   466→		// transcript is already fully flushed (the Stop hook completed the flush).
   467→		if isActive {
   468→			prepareTranscriptIfNeeded(ctx, ag, liveTranscriptPath)
   469→		}
   470→		if liveData, readErr := os.ReadFile(liveTranscriptPath); readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state
   471→			fullTranscript = string(liveData)
   472→		}
   473→	}
   474→	if fullTranscript == "" {
   475→		// Fall back to shadow branch copy
   476→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   477→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   478→				fullTranscript = content
   479→			}
   480→		} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   481→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   482→				fullTranscript = content
   483→			}
   484→		}
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	// Process transcript based on agent type
   488→	if fullTranscript != "" {
   489→		data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
   490→		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(agentType, fullTranscript)
   491→		// Read prompts from shadow branch tree (source of truth after SaveStep)
   492→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.PromptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   493→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil && content != "" {
   494→				data.Prompts = splitPromptContent(content)
   495→			}
   496→		}
   497→		// Filesystem fallback (written at turn start, covers mid-turn commits)
   498→		if len(data.Prompts) == 0 {
   499→			data.Prompts = readPromptsFromFilesystem(ctx, sessionID)
   500→		}
   501→	}
   502→
   503→	// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
   504→	data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
   505→
   506→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   507→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   508→		data.TokenUsage = agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, checkpointTranscriptStart, "") //TODO: why do we not use here subagents dir?
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	return data, nil
   512→}

   514→// extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript extracts session data directly from the live transcript file.
   515→// This is used for mid-session commits where no shadow branch exists yet.
   516→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(ctx context.Context, state *SessionState) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   517→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   518→
   519→	ag, _ := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType) //nolint:errcheck // ag may be nil for unknown agent types; callers use type assertions so nil is safe
   520→
   521→	// Resolve the transcript path (handles agents that relocate mid-session).
   522→	transcriptPath, resolveErr := resolveTranscriptPath(state)
   523→	if resolveErr != nil {
   524→		return nil, resolveErr
   525→	}
   526→
   527→	liveData, err := os.ReadFile(transcriptPath) //nolint:gosec // path validated by resolveTranscriptPath
   528→	if err != nil {
   529→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read live transcript: %w", err)
   530→	}
   531→
   532→	if len(liveData) == 0 {
   533→		return nil, errors.New("live transcript is empty")
   534→	}
   535→
   536→	fullTranscript := string(liveData)
   537→	data.Transcript = liveData
   538→	data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
   539→	data.Prompts = readPromptsFromFilesystem(ctx, state.SessionID)
   540→
   541→	// Resolve files touched: prefers hook-populated state, falls back to transcript extraction
   542→	data.FilesTouched = s.resolveFilesTouched(ctx, state)
   543→
   544→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   545→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   546→		data.TokenUsage = agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, "") //TODO: why do we not use here subagents dir?
   547→	}
   548→
   549→	return data, nil
   550→}
   551→
   552→// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
   553→// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
   554→// For Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
   555→// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
   556→func countTranscriptItems(agentType types.AgentType, content string) int {
   557→	if content == "" {
   558→		return 0
   559→	}
   560→
   561→	// OpenCode uses export JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]}
   562→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   563→		session, err := opencode.ParseExportSession([]byte(content))
   564→		if err == nil && session != nil {
   565→			return len(session.Messages)
   566→		}
   567→		return 0
   568→	}
   569→
   570→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   571→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   572→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
   573→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   574→			return len(transcript.Messages)
   575→		}
   576→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
   577→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   578→			return 0
   579→		}
   580→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   581→	}
   582→
   583→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   584→	allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   585→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   586→	for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   587→		allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   588→	}
   589→	return len(allLines)
   590→}
