   592→// extractUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from transcript content.
   593→// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
   594→func extractUserPrompts(agentType types.AgentType, content string) []string {
   595→	if content == "" {
   596→		return nil
   597→	}
   598→
   599→	// Droid has its own envelope format — use its parser to normalize first
   600→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeFactoryAIDroid {
   601→		lines, _, err := factoryaidroid.ParseDroidTranscriptFromBytes([]byte(content), 0)
   602→		if err != nil {
   603→			return nil
   604→		}
   605→		var prompts []string
   606→		for _, line := range lines {
   607→			if line.Type != transcript.TypeUser {
   608→				continue
   609→			}
   610→			if text := transcript.ExtractUserContent(line.Message); text != "" {
   611→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(text); stripped != "" {
   612→					prompts = append(prompts, stripped)
   613→				}
   614→			}
   615→		}
   616→		return prompts
   617→	}
   618→
   619→	// OpenCode uses JSONL with a different per-line schema than Claude Code
   620→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   621→		prompts, err := opencode.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   622→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   623→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   624→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   625→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   626→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   627→				}
   628→			}
   629→			return cleaned
   630→		}
   631→		return nil
   632→	}
   633→
   634→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   635→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   636→		prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   637→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   638→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   639→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   640→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   641→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   642→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   643→				}
   644→			}
   645→			return cleaned
   646→		}
   647→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
   648→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   649→			return nil
   650→		}
   651→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   652→	}
   653→
   654→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   655→	return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
   656→}
   657→
   658→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   659→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   660→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   661→	var prompts []string
   662→	for _, line := range lines {
   663→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   664→		if line == "" {
   665→			continue
   666→		}
   667→
   668→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   669→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   670→			continue
   671→		}
   672→
   673→		// Check for user message:
   674→		// - Claude Code uses "type": "human" or "type": "user"
   675→		// - Cursor uses "role": "user"
   676→		msgType, _ := entry["type"].(string) //nolint:errcheck // type assertion on interface{} from JSON
   677→		msgRole, _ := entry["role"].(string) //nolint:errcheck // type assertion on interface{} from JSON
   678→		isUser := msgType == "human" || msgType == "user" || msgRole == "user"
   679→		if !isUser {
   680→			continue
   681→		}
   682→
   683→		// Extract message content
   684→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   685→		if !ok {
   686→			continue
   687→		}
   688→
   689→		// Handle string content
   690→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   691→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   692→			if cleaned != "" {
   693→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   694→			}
   695→			continue
   696→		}
   697→
   698→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   699→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   700→			var texts []string
   701→			for _, item := range arr {
   702→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   703→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   704→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   705→							texts = append(texts, text)
   706→						}
   707→					}
   708→				}
   709→			}
   710→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   711→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   712→				if cleaned != "" {
   713→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   714→				}
   715→			}
   716→		}
   717→	}
   718→	return prompts
   719→}

   721→// splitPromptContent splits prompt.txt content on the "\n\n---\n\n" separator.
   722→// Returns nil if content is empty.
   723→func splitPromptContent(content string) []string {
   724→	if content == "" {
   725→		return nil
   726→	}
   727→	parts := strings.Split(content, "\n\n---\n\n")
   728→	var result []string
   729→	for _, p := range parts {
   730→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(p)
   731→		if trimmed != "" {
   732→			result = append(result, trimmed)
   733→		}
   734→	}
   735→	return result
   736→}

   738→// readPromptsFromFilesystem reads prompt.txt from the filesystem session metadata directory.
   739→// This file is written at turn start and updated at each SaveStep, providing prompt data
   740→// even for mid-turn commits where the shadow branch may not have been updated.
   741→func readPromptsFromFilesystem(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) []string {
   742→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   743→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(ctx, sessionDir)
   744→	if err != nil {
   745→		return nil
   746→	}
   747→	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)) //nolint:gosec // path from session ID
   748→	if err != nil || len(data) == 0 {
   749→		return nil
   750→	}
   751→	return splitPromptContent(string(data))
   752→}

   754→// clearFilesystemPrompt removes the filesystem prompt.txt for a session.
   755→// Called after condensation so subsequent checkpoints start fresh.
   756→func clearFilesystemPrompt(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) {

   766→// CondenseSessionByID condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
   767→// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
   768→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   769→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "condense-by-id")
   770→
   771→	// Load session state
   772→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   773→	if err != nil {
   774→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   775→	}
   776→	if state == nil {
   777→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   778→	}
   779→
   780→	// Open repository
   781→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   782→	if err != nil {
   783→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   784→	}
   785→
   786→	// Generate a checkpoint ID
   787→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   788→	if err != nil {
   789→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   790→	}
   791→
   792→	// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
   793→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   794→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   795→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   796→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   797→
   798→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   799→		// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
   800→		// Just clean up the state file.
   801→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
   802→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   803→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   804→		)
   805→		if err := s.clearSessionState(ctx, sessionID); err != nil {
   806→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   807→		}
   808→		return nil
   809→	}
   810→
   811→	// Condense the session
   812→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
   813→	if err != nil {
   814→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
   815→	}
   816→
   817→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed by ID",
   818→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   819→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   820→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   821→	)
   822→
   823→	// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
   824→	state.StepCount = 0
   825→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   826→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   827→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   828→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   829→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   830→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   831→
   832→	if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
   833→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   834→	}
   835→
   836→	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
   837→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   838→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   839→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   840→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   841→		)
   842→		// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
   843→	}
   844→
   845→	return nil
   846→}
   847→
   848→// CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed condenses an ENDED session and marks it
   849→// FullyCondensed in one operation. Used by the session stop hook to eagerly
   850→// clean up sessions so PostCommit doesn't have to process them.
   851→//
   852→// This does NOT call CondenseSessionByID because that method has two behaviors
   853→// we don't want: (1) it calls clearSessionState when no shadow branch exists
   854→// (deletes the state file entirely), and (2) it sets Phase = IDLE. Instead,
   855→// we inline the condensation logic with ENDED-appropriate behavior.
   856→//
   857→// Fail-open: if condensation fails, the session is left in its current state.
   858→// PostCommit will re-discover the session on the next commit if its BaseCommit
   859→// still matches the parent of HEAD.
   860→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   861→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   862→
   863→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   864→	if err != nil {
   865→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   866→	}
   867→	if state == nil {
   868→		return nil // No state file
   869→	}
   870→
   871→	// Sessions with FilesTouched must be processed by PostCommit for carry-forward
   872→	// tracking — each user commit that overlaps with tracked files gets its own
   873→	// checkpoint. Eagerly condensing here would prevent that 1:1 linkage.
   874→	if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   875→		return nil
   876→	}
   877→
   878→	// Only condense if there's uncondensed data
   879→	if state.StepCount <= 0 {
   880→		// No data and no files — mark FullyCondensed
   881→		state.FullyCondensed = true
   882→		return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
   883→	}
   884→
   885→	// Check if shadow branch exists — required for condensation
   886→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   887→	if err != nil {
   888→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to open repository",
   889→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   890→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   891→		)
   892→		return nil // fail-open
   893→	}
   894→
   895→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   896→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   897→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   898→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   899→
   900→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   901→		// No shadow branch = no checkpoint data to condense.
   902→		// Unlike CondenseSessionByID, we do NOT delete the state file.
   903→		logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense: no shadow branch",
   904→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   905→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   906→		)
   907→		state.StepCount = 0
   908→		state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
   909→		return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
   910→	}
   911→
   912→	// Generate checkpoint ID and condense
   913→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   914→	if err != nil {
   915→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to generate checkpoint ID",
   916→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   917→		)
   918→		return nil // fail-open
   919→	}
   920→
   921→	// Condense with nil committedFiles (include all FilesTouched)
   922→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
   923→	if err != nil {
   924→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop failed, PostCommit will retry",
   925→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   926→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   927→		)
   928→		return nil // fail-open
   929→	}
   930→
   931→	// Update state — keep Phase = ENDED (unlike CondenseSessionByID which sets IDLE)
   932→	state.StepCount = 0
   933→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   934→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   935→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   936→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   937→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   938→	state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
   939→	// Phase stays ENDED — do NOT set to IDLE
   940→
   941→	logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop succeeded",
   942→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   943→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   944→	)
   945→
   946→	if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
   947→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   948→	}
   949→
   950→	// Clean up shadow branch
   951→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   952→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to clean up shadow branch",
   953→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   954→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   955→		)
   956→	}
   957→
   958→	return nil
   959→}
   960→
   961→// cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused deletes a shadow branch if no other active sessions reference it.
   962→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx context.Context, _ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
   963→	// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
   964→	allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates(ctx)
   965→	if err != nil {
   966→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   967→	}
   968→
   969→	for _, state := range allStates {
   970→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   971→			continue
   972→		}
   973→		otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   974→		if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
   975→			// Another session still needs this shadow branch
   976→			return nil
   977→		}
   978→	}
   979→
   980→	// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
   981→	// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
   982→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(ctx, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   983→		// Branch already gone is not an error
   984→		if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
   985→			return nil
   986→		}
   987→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
   988→	}
   989→	return nil
   990→}

1→// lifecycle.go implements the generic lifecycle event dispatcher.
     2→// It routes normalized events from any agent to the appropriate framework actions.
     3→//
     4→// The dispatcher inverts the current flow from "agent handler calls framework functions"
     5→// to "framework dispatcher calls agent methods." Agents are passive data providers;
     6→// the dispatcher handles all orchestration: state transitions, strategy calls,
     7→// file change detection, metadata generation.
     8→package cli
     9→
    10→import (
    11→	"context"
    12→	"errors"
    13→	"fmt"
    14→	"log/slog"
    15→	"os"
    16→	"path/filepath"
    17→	"strings"
    18→	"time"
    19→
    20→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent"
    21→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/logging"
    22→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/paths"
    23→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/session"
    24→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy"
    25→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/transcript"
    26→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/validation"
    27→	"github.com/entireio/cli/perf"
    28→)
    29→
    30→// DispatchLifecycleEvent routes a normalized lifecycle event to the appropriate handler.
    31→// Returns nil if the event was handled successfully.
    32→func DispatchLifecycleEvent(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
    33→	if ag == nil {
    34→		return errors.New("agent cannot be nil")
    35→	}
    36→	if event == nil {
    37→		return errors.New("event cannot be nil")
    38→	}
    39→
    40→	switch event.Type {
    41→	case agent.SessionStart:
    42→		return handleLifecycleSessionStart(ctx, ag, event)
    43→	case agent.TurnStart:
    44→		return handleLifecycleTurnStart(ctx, ag, event)
    45→	case agent.TurnEnd:
    46→		return handleLifecycleTurnEnd(ctx, ag, event)
    47→	case agent.Compaction:
    48→		return handleLifecycleCompaction(ctx, ag, event)
    49→	case agent.SessionEnd:
    50→		return handleLifecycleSessionEnd(ctx, ag, event)
    51→	case agent.SubagentStart:
    52→		return handleLifecycleSubagentStart(ctx, ag, event)
    53→	case agent.SubagentEnd:
    54→		return handleLifecycleSubagentEnd(ctx, ag, event)
    55→	case agent.ModelUpdate:
    56→		return handleLifecycleModelUpdate(ctx, ag, event)
    57→	default:
    58→		return fmt.Errorf("unknown lifecycle event type: %d", event.Type)
    59→	}
    60→}
    61→
    62→// handleLifecycleSessionStart handles session start: shows banner, checks concurrent sessions,
    63→// fires state machine transition.
    64→func handleLifecycleSessionStart(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
    65→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
    66→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-start",
    67→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
    68→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
    69→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
    70→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
    71→	)
    72→
    73→	if event.SessionID == "" {
    74→		return fmt.Errorf("no session_id in %s event", event.Type)
    75→	}
    76→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(event.SessionID); err != nil {
    77→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s event: %w", event.Type, err)
    78→	}
    79→
    80→	// Build informational message
    81→	message := "\n\nPowered by Entire:\n  This conversation will be linked to your next commit."
    82→
    83→	// Check for concurrent sessions and append count if any
    84→	_, countSessionsSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "count_active_sessions")
    85→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
    86→	if count, err := strat.CountOtherActiveSessionsWithCheckpoints(ctx, event.SessionID); err == nil && count > 0 {
    87→		message += fmt.Sprintf("\n  %d other active conversation(s) in this workspace will also be included.\n  Use 'entire status' for more information.", count)
    88→	}
    89→	countSessionsSpan.End()
    90→
    91→	// Output informational message if the agent supports hook responses.
    92→	// Claude Code reads JSON from stdout; agents that don't implement
    93→	// HookResponseWriter silently skip (avoids raw JSON in their terminal).
    94→	_, hookResponseSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "write_hook_response")
    95→	if event.ResponseMessage != "" {
    96→		message = event.ResponseMessage
    97→	}
    98→	if writer, ok := agent.AsHookResponseWriter(ag); ok {
    99→		if err := writer.WriteHookResponse(message); err != nil {
   100→			hookResponseSpan.RecordError(err)
   101→			hookResponseSpan.End()
   102→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write hook response: %w", err)
   103→		}
   104→	}
   105→	hookResponseSpan.End()
   106→
   107→	// Store model hint if the agent provided model info on SessionStart
   108→	if event.Model != "" {
   109→		if err := strategy.StoreModelHint(ctx, event.SessionID, event.Model); err != nil {
   110→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to store model hint on session start",
   111→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   112→		}
   113→	}
   114→
   115→	// Fire EventSessionStart for the current session (if state exists).
   116→	if state, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, event.SessionID); loadErr != nil {
   117→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state on start",
   118→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   119→	} else if state != nil {
   120→		persistEventMetadataToState(event, state)
   121→		if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, state, session.EventSessionStart, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   122→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "session start transition failed",
   123→				slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   124→		}
   125→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   126→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session state on start",
   127→				slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   128→		}
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	return nil
   132→}
   133→
   134→// handleLifecycleModelUpdate persists the model name for the current session.
   135→//
   136→// If the session state file already exists (e.g., Gemini's BeforeModel fires
   137→// after TurnStart), the model is written directly to state.ModelName — no hint
   138→// file needed. Otherwise falls back to StoreModelHint for cross-process
   139→// persistence (see its doc comment for the full rationale).
   140→func handleLifecycleModelUpdate(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   141→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   142→	logging.Info(logCtx, "model-update",
   143→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   144→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
   145→	)
   146→
   147→	if event.SessionID == "" || event.Model == "" {
   148→		return nil
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	// Prefer writing directly to session state when it exists
   152→	state, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, event.SessionID)
   153→	if loadErr != nil {
   154→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "could not load session state for model update, using hint file",
   155→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   156→	}
   157→	if loadErr == nil && state != nil {
   158→		state.ModelName = event.Model
   159→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   160→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session state with model",
   161→				slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   162→		}
   163→		return nil
   164→	}
   165→
   166→	// State doesn't exist yet (or failed to load) — use hint file (see StoreModelHint doc)
   167→	if err := strategy.StoreModelHint(ctx, event.SessionID, event.Model); err != nil {
   168→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to store model hint",
   169→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   170→	}
   171→
   172→	return nil
   173→}
   174→
   175→// handleLifecycleTurnStart handles turn start: captures pre-prompt state,
   176→// ensures strategy setup, initializes session.
   177→func handleLifecycleTurnStart(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   178→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   179→	logging.Info(logCtx, "turn-start",
   180→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   181→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   182→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
   183→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
   184→	)
   185→
   186→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   187→	if sessionID == "" {
   188→		return fmt.Errorf("no session_id in %s event", event.Type)
   189→	}
   190→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   191→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s event: %w", event.Type, err)
   192→	}
   193→
   194→	// Fill model from hint file if the agent didn't provide it on this hook
   195→	if event.Model == "" {
   196→		if hint := strategy.LoadModelHint(ctx, sessionID); hint != "" {
   197→			event.Model = hint
   198→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "loaded model from hint file",
   199→				slog.String("model", hint))
   200→		}
   201→	}
   202→
   203→	// Capture pre-prompt state (including transcript position via TranscriptAnalyzer)
   204→	_, captureSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "capture_pre_prompt_state")
   205→	if err := CapturePrePromptState(ctx, ag, sessionID, event.SessionRef); err != nil {
   206→		captureSpan.RecordError(err)
   207→		captureSpan.End()
   208→		return err
   209→	}
   210→	captureSpan.End()
   211→
   212→	// Append prompt to prompt.txt on filesystem so it's available for
   213→	// mid-turn commits (before SaveStep writes it to the shadow branch).
   214→	// Prompts are separated by "\n\n---\n\n" to support multiple turns.
   215→	if event.Prompt != "" {
   216→		sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   217→		if sessionDirAbs, absErr := paths.AbsPath(ctx, sessionDir); absErr == nil {
   218→			if mkErr := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); mkErr == nil {
   219→				promptPath := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   220→				existing, readErr := os.ReadFile(promptPath) //nolint:gosec // session metadata path
   221→				var content string
   222→				if readErr == nil && len(existing) > 0 {
   223→					content = string(existing) + "\n\n---\n\n" + event.Prompt
   224→				} else {
   225→					content = event.Prompt
   226→				}
   227→				if writeErr := os.WriteFile(promptPath, []byte(content), 0o600); writeErr != nil { //nolint:gosec // path from internal metadata, not user input
   228→					logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to write prompt.txt",
   229→						slog.String("error", writeErr.Error()))
   230→				}
   231→			}
   232→		}
   233→	}
   234→
   235→	// Ensure strategy setup and initialize session
   236→	_, initSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "init_session")
   237→	if err := strategy.EnsureSetup(ctx); err != nil {
   238→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to ensure strategy setup",
   239→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   243→	if err := strat.InitializeSession(ctx, sessionID, ag.Type(), event.SessionRef, event.Prompt, event.Model); err != nil {
   244→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to initialize session state",
   245→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   246→	}
   247→	initSpan.End()
   248→
   249→	return nil
   250→}
   251→
   252→// handleLifecycleTurnEnd handles turn end: validates transcript, extracts metadata,
   253→// detects file changes, saves step + checkpoint, transitions phase.
   254→//
   255→//nolint:maintidx // high complexity due to sequential orchestration of 8 steps (validation, extraction, file detection, filtering, token calc, step save, phase transition, cleanup) - splitting would obscure the flow
   256→func handleLifecycleTurnEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   257→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   258→	logging.Info(logCtx, "turn-end",
   259→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   260→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   261→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
   262→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
   263→	)
   264→
   265→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   266→	if sessionID == "" {
   267→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   268→	}
   269→
   270→	// Fill model from hint file if the agent didn't provide it on this hook
   271→	if event.Model == "" && sessionID != unknownSessionID {
   272→		if hint := strategy.LoadModelHint(ctx, sessionID); hint != "" {
   273→			event.Model = hint
   274→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "loaded model from hint file",
   275→				slog.String("model", hint))
   276→		}
   277→	}
   278→
   279→	transcriptRef := event.SessionRef
   280→	if transcriptRef == "" {
   281→		return errors.New("transcript file not specified")
   282→	}
   283→
   284→	// If agent implements TranscriptPreparer, materialize the transcript file.
   285→	// This must run BEFORE fileExists: agents like OpenCode lazily fetch transcripts
   286→	// via `opencode export`, so the file doesn't exist until PrepareTranscript creates it.
   287→	// Claude Code's PrepareTranscript just flushes (always succeeds). Agents without
   288→	// TranscriptPreparer (Gemini, Droid) are unaffected.
   289→	_, prepareSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "prepare_and_validate_transcript")
   290→	if preparer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptPreparer(ag); ok {
   291→		if err := preparer.PrepareTranscript(ctx, transcriptRef); err != nil {
   292→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to prepare transcript",
   293→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   294→		}
   295→	}
   296→
   297→	if !fileExists(transcriptRef) {
   298→		prepareSpan.RecordError(fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found: %s", transcriptRef))
   299→		prepareSpan.End()
   300→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found: %s", transcriptRef)
   301→	}
   302→
   303→	// Early check: bail out quickly if the repo has no commits yet.
   304→	if repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository(ctx); err == nil && strategy.IsEmptyRepository(repo) {
   305→		prepareSpan.RecordError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   306→		prepareSpan.End()
   307→		logging.Info(logCtx, "skipping checkpoint - will activate after first commit")
   308→		return NewSilentError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   309→	}
   310→	prepareSpan.End()
   311→
   312→	// Create session metadata directory
   313→	_, copySpan := perf.Start(ctx, "copy_transcript")
   314→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   315→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(ctx, sessionDir)
   316→	if err != nil {
   317→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir
   318→	}
   319→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   320→		copySpan.RecordError(err)
   321→		copySpan.End()
   322→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   323→	}
   324→
   325→	// Copy transcript to session directory
   326→	transcriptData, err := ag.ReadTranscript(transcriptRef)
   327→	if err != nil {
   328→		copySpan.RecordError(err)
   329→		copySpan.End()
   330→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read transcript: %w", err)
   331→	}
   332→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   333→	if err := os.WriteFile(logFile, transcriptData, 0o600); err != nil {
   334→		copySpan.RecordError(err)
   335→		copySpan.End()
   336→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write transcript: %w", err)
   337→	}
   338→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "copied transcript",
   339→		slog.String("path", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName))
   340→	copySpan.End()
   341→
   342→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on TurnStart)
   343→	_, extractSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "extract_metadata")
   344→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID)
   345→	if err != nil {
   346→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load pre-prompt state",
   347→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   348→	}
   349→
   350→	// Determine transcript offset
   351→	transcriptOffset := resolveTranscriptOffset(ctx, preState, sessionID)
   352→
   353→	// Backfill prompt.txt from transcript when prompt data is missing.
   354→	// This handles agents whose exec mode doesn't fire UserPromptSubmit (e.g., Factory AI
   355→	// Droid). The transcript is the source of truth — if ExtractPrompts returns nothing,
   356→	// there genuinely were no prompts. We track whether backfill occurred so we can
   357→	// update session state after SaveStep (which may reinitialize state).
   358→	var backfilledPrompt string
   359→	promptPath := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   360→	existingPrompt, readPromptErr := os.ReadFile(promptPath) //nolint:gosec // file content is safe session metadata
   361→	if readPromptErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(readPromptErr) {
   362→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to read prompt.txt, skipping backfill",
   363→			slog.String("error", readPromptErr.Error()))
   364→	} else if len(existingPrompt) == 0 {
   365→		if extractor, ok := agent.AsPromptExtractor(ag); ok {
   366→			prompts, extractErr := extractor.ExtractPrompts(transcriptRef, transcriptOffset)
   367→			if extractErr != nil {
   368→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract prompts from transcript",
   369→					slog.String("error", extractErr.Error()))
   370→			} else if len(prompts) > 0 {
   371→				content := strings.Join(prompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   372→				if writeErr := os.WriteFile(promptPath, []byte(content), 0o600); writeErr != nil {
   373→					logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to backfill prompt.txt from transcript",
   374→						slog.String("error", writeErr.Error()))
   375→				} else {
   376→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "backfilled prompt.txt from transcript",
   377→						slog.Int("prompt_count", len(prompts)))
   378→					backfilledPrompt = prompts[len(prompts)-1]
   379→				}
   380→			}
   381→		}
   382→	}
   383→
   384→	// Compute subagents directory for agents that support subagent extraction.
   385→	// Subagent transcripts live in <transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/
   386→	subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptRef), event.SessionID, "subagents")
   387→
   388→	// Extract metadata via agent interface (modified files)
   389→	var modifiedFiles []string
   390→
   391→	if analyzer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptAnalyzer(ag); ok {
   392→		// Extract modified files - prefer SubagentAwareExtractor if available to include subagent files
   393→		if subagentExtractor, subOk := agent.AsSubagentAwareExtractor(ag); subOk {
   394→			if files, fileErr := subagentExtractor.ExtractAllModifiedFiles(transcriptData, transcriptOffset, subagentsDir); fileErr != nil {
   395→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files (with subagents)",
   396→					slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   397→			} else {
   398→				modifiedFiles = files
   399→			}
   400→		} else {
   401→			// Fall back to basic extraction (main transcript only)
   402→			if files, _, fileErr := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(transcriptRef, transcriptOffset); fileErr != nil {
   403→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files",
   404→					slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   405→			} else {
   406→				modifiedFiles = files
   407→			}
   408→		}
   409→	}
   410→	extractSpan.End()
   411→
   412→	// Generate commit message from last prompt (read from session state, set at TurnStart).
   413→	// In exec mode, session state LastPrompt may be empty because UserPromptSubmit never fires.
   414→	// Fall back to backfilledPrompt extracted from the transcript.
   415→	_, commitMsgSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "generate_commit_message")
   416→	lastPrompt := ""
   417→	if sessionState, stateErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID); stateErr == nil && sessionState != nil {
   418→		lastPrompt = sessionState.LastPrompt
   419→	}
   420→	if lastPrompt == "" && backfilledPrompt != "" {
   421→		lastPrompt = backfilledPrompt
   422→	}
   423→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt, ag.Type())
   424→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "using commit message",
   425→		slog.Int("message_length", len(commitMessage)))
   426→	commitMsgSpan.End()
   427→
   428→	// Get worktree root for path normalization
   429→	_, detectSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "detect_file_changes")
   430→	repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   431→	if err != nil {
   432→		detectSpan.RecordError(err)
   433→		detectSpan.End()
   434→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree root: %w", err)
   435→	}
   436→
   437→	var preUntrackedFiles []string
   438→	if preState != nil {
   439→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "pre-prompt state",
   440→			slog.Int("pre_existing_untracked_files", len(preState.UntrackedFiles)))
   441→		preUntrackedFiles = preState.PreUntrackedFiles()
   442→	}
   443→
   444→	// Detect file changes via git status
   445→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(ctx, preUntrackedFiles)
   446→	if err != nil {
   447→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to compute file changes",
   448→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   449→	}
   450→	detectSpan.End()
   451→
   452→	// Filter and normalize all paths
   453→	_, normalizeSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "filter_and_normalize_paths")
   454→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   455→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   456→	if changes != nil {
   457→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   458→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   459→
   460→		// Merge git-status modified files as a fallback for transcript parsing.
   461→		// Transcript parsing is the primary source for modified files, but it can miss
   462→		// files if the agent uses an unrecognized tool or the transcript format changes.
   463→		// Git status catches any tracked file with working-tree changes.
   464→		relModifiedFiles = mergeUnique(relModifiedFiles, FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Modified, repoRoot))
   465→	}
   466→
   467→	// Filter transcript-extracted files to exclude files already committed to HEAD.
   468→	// When an agent commits files mid-turn, those files are condensed by PostCommit
   469→	// and should not be re-added to FilesTouched by SaveStep. A file is "committed"
   470→	// if it exists in HEAD with the same content as the working tree.
   471→	relModifiedFiles = filterToUncommittedFiles(ctx, relModifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   472→	normalizeSpan.End()
   473→
   474→	// Backfill session state LastPrompt early so `entire status` shows the prompt
   475→	// even when no files were modified (before the early return below).
   476→	if backfilledPrompt != "" {
   477→		if state, stateErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID); stateErr == nil && state != nil && state.LastPrompt == "" {
   478→			state.LastPrompt = backfilledPrompt
   479→			if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   480→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to backfill LastPrompt in session state",
   481→					slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   482→			}
   483→		}
   484→	}
   485→
   486→	// Check if there are any changes
   487→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   488→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   489→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no files modified during session, skipping checkpoint")
   490→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(ctx, sessionID, event)
   491→		if cleanupErr := CleanupPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID); cleanupErr != nil {
   492→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to cleanup pre-prompt state",
   493→				slog.String("error", cleanupErr.Error()))
   494→		}
   495→		return nil
   496→	}
   497→
   498→	// Log file changes
   499→	logFileChanges(ctx, relModifiedFiles, relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles)
   500→
   501→	// Get git author
   502→	author, err := GetGitAuthor(ctx)
   503→	if err != nil {
   504→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   505→	}
   506→
   507→	// Get strategy and agent type
   508→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   509→	agentType := ag.Type()
   510→
   511→	// Get transcript position/identifier from pre-prompt state
   512→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   513→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   514→	if preState != nil {
   515→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   516→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.TranscriptOffset
   517→	}
   518→
   519→	// Calculate token usage - prefer SubagentAwareExtractor to include subagent tokens
   520→	tokenUsage := agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, transcriptData, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   521→
   522→	// Build fully-populated step context and delegate to strategy
   523→	stepCtx := strategy.StepContext{
   524→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   525→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   526→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   527→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   528→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   529→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   530→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   531→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptRef,
   532→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   533→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   534→		AgentType:                agentType,
   535→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   536→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   537→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   538→	}
   539→
   540→	if err := strat.SaveStep(ctx, stepCtx); err != nil {
   541→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save step: %w", err)
   542→	}
   543→
   544→	// Update session state with backfilled prompt after SaveStep.
   545→	// Done after SaveStep because SaveStep may reinitialize session state,
   546→	// which would overwrite an earlier LastPrompt update.
   547→	if backfilledPrompt != "" {
   548→		if state, stateErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID); stateErr == nil && state != nil && state.LastPrompt == "" {
   549→			state.LastPrompt = backfilledPrompt
   550→			if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   551→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to backfill LastPrompt in session state",
   552→					slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   553→			}
   554→		}
   555→	}
   556→
   557→	// Transition session phase and cleanup
   558→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(ctx, sessionID, event)
   559→	if cleanupErr := CleanupPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID); cleanupErr != nil {
   560→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to cleanup pre-prompt state",
   561→			slog.String("error", cleanupErr.Error()))
   562→	}
   563→
   564→	return nil
   565→}
   566→
   567→// handleLifecycleCompaction handles context compaction: saves current progress
   568→// but stays in ACTIVE phase (unlike TurnEnd which transitions to IDLE).
   569→// Also resets the transcript offset since the transcript may be truncated.
   570→func handleLifecycleCompaction(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   571→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   572→	logging.Info(logCtx, "compaction",
   573→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   574→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   575→	)
   576→
   577→	// Fire EventCompaction to trigger ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched (stays in ACTIVE)
   578→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   579→	sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   580→	if loadErr != nil {
   581→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state for compaction",
   582→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   583→	}
   584→	if sessionState != nil {
   585→		persistEventMetadataToState(event, sessionState)
   586→
   587→		if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, sessionState, session.EventCompaction, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   588→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "compaction transition failed",
   589→				slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   590→		}
   591→
   592→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, sessionState); saveErr != nil {
   593→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to save session state after compaction",
   594→				slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   595→		}
   596→	}
   597→
   598→	logging.Info(logCtx, "context compaction detected")
   599→	return nil
   600→}
   601→
   602→// handleLifecycleSessionEnd handles session end: marks the session as ended.
   603→func handleLifecycleSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   604→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   605→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-end",
   606→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   607→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   608→	)
   609→
   610→	if event.SessionID == "" {
   611→		return nil // No session to update
   612→	}
   613→
   614→	// Note: We intentionally don't clean up cached transcripts here.
   615→	// Post-session commits (carry-forward in ENDED phase) may still need
   616→	// the transcript to extract file changes. Cleanup is handled by
   617→	// `entire clean` or when the session state is fully removed.
   618→
   619→	if err := markSessionEnded(ctx, event, event.SessionID); err != nil {
   620→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to mark session ended",
   621→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   622→		// Don't attempt eager condense if we couldn't even mark the session ended —
   623→		// the session state may be in an inconsistent state.
   624→		return nil
   625→	}
   626→
   627→	// Eagerly condense session data so PostCommit doesn't have to process it.
   628→	// This prevents zombie ENDED sessions from accumulating and causing O(N)
   629→	// overhead on every future commit (GitHub issue #591).
   630→	// Fail-open: if this fails, the session remains in its current state and
   631→	// PostCommit will re-discover it if its BaseCommit matches the parent of HEAD.
   632→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)

   642→// handleLifecycleSubagentStart handles subagent start: captures pre-task state.
   643→func handleLifecycleSubagentStart(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   644→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   645→	logging.Info(logCtx, "subagent started",
   646→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),

   649→		slog.String("transcript", event.SessionRef),

   660→// handleLifecycleSubagentEnd handles subagent end: detects changes, saves task checkpoint.
   661→func handleLifecycleSubagentEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   662→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   663→	if event.SubagentType == "" && event.TaskDescription == "" {
   664→		// Extract subagent type and description from tool input
   665→		event.SubagentType, event.TaskDescription = ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(event.ToolInput)
   666→	}
   667→
   668→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   669→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(event.SessionRef)
   670→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   671→	if event.SubagentID != "" {
   672→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, event.SubagentID)
   673→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   674→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   675→		}
   676→	}
   677→
   678→	// Log context
   679→	subagentEndAttrs := []any{
   680→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   681→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   682→		slog.String("tool_use_id", event.ToolUseID),
   683→	}
   684→	if event.SubagentID != "" {
   685→		subagentEndAttrs = append(subagentEndAttrs, slog.String("agent_id", event.SubagentID))
   686→	}
   687→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   688→		subagentEndAttrs = append(subagentEndAttrs, slog.String("subagent_transcript", subagentTranscriptPath))
   689→	}
   690→	logging.Info(logCtx, "subagent completed", subagentEndAttrs...)
   691→
   692→	// Extract modified files from hook payload and/or subagent transcript
   693→	var modifiedFiles []string
   694→	modifiedFiles = append(modifiedFiles, event.ModifiedFiles...)
   695→	if analyzer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptAnalyzer(ag); ok {
   696→		transcriptToScan := event.SessionRef
   697→		if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   698→			transcriptToScan = subagentTranscriptPath
   699→		}
   700→		if files, _, fileErr := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(transcriptToScan, 0); fileErr != nil {
   701→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files from subagent",
   702→				slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   703→		} else {
   704→			modifiedFiles = mergeUnique(modifiedFiles, files)
   705→		}
   706→	}
   707→
   708→	// Load pre-task state and detect file changes.
   709→	// If no pre-task state exists (agent doesn't support pre-task hook), fall back
   710→	// to the session's pre-prompt state. Without either, DetectFileChanges receives
   711→	// nil and treats ALL untracked files as new — which would create spurious task
   712→	// checkpoints for pre-existing untracked files (e.g., .github/hooks/entire.json).
   713→	preState, err := LoadPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID)
   714→	if err != nil {
   715→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load pre-task state",
   716→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   717→	}
   718→	var preUntrackedFiles []string
   719→	if preState != nil {
   720→		preUntrackedFiles = preState.PreUntrackedFiles()
   721→	}
   722→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(ctx, preUntrackedFiles)
   723→	if err != nil {
   724→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to compute file changes",
   725→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   726→	}
   727→
   728→	// Get worktree root and normalize paths
   729→	repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   730→	if err != nil {
   731→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree root: %w", err)
   732→	}
   733→
   734→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   735→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   736→	if changes != nil {
   737→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   738→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   739→		relModifiedFiles = mergeUnique(relModifiedFiles, FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Modified, repoRoot))
   740→	}
   741→
   742→	// If no changes, skip
   743→	if len(relModifiedFiles) == 0 && len(relNewFiles) == 0 && len(relDeletedFiles) == 0 {
   744→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no file changes detected, skipping task checkpoint")
   745→		_ = CleanupPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   746→		return nil
   747→	}
   748→
   749→	// Find checkpoint UUID from main transcript (best-effort)
   750→	var checkpointUUID string
   751→	// Use the existing CLI-level checkpoint UUID finder
   752→	mainLines, _ := parseTranscriptForCheckpointUUID(event.SessionRef) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort
   753→	if mainLines != nil {
   754→		checkpointUUID, _ = FindCheckpointUUID(mainLines, event.ToolUseID)
   755→	}
   756→
   757→	// Get git author
   758→	author, err := GetGitAuthor(ctx)
   759→	if err != nil {
   760→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   761→	}
   762→
   763→	// Build task checkpoint context
   764→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   765→	agentType := ag.Type()
   766→
   767→	taskStepCtx := strategy.TaskStepContext{
   768→		SessionID:              event.SessionID,
   769→		ToolUseID:              event.ToolUseID,
   770→		AgentID:                event.SubagentID,
   771→		ModifiedFiles:          relModifiedFiles,
   772→		NewFiles:               relNewFiles,
   773→		DeletedFiles:           relDeletedFiles,
   774→		TranscriptPath:         event.SessionRef,
   775→		SubagentTranscriptPath: subagentTranscriptPath,
   776→		CheckpointUUID:         checkpointUUID,
   777→		AuthorName:             author.Name,
   778→		AuthorEmail:            author.Email,
   779→		SubagentType:           event.SubagentType,
   780→		TaskDescription:        event.TaskDescription,
   781→		AgentType:              agentType,
   782→	}
   783→
   784→	if err := strat.SaveTaskStep(ctx, taskStepCtx); err != nil {
   785→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save task step: %w", err)
   786→	}
   787→
   788→	_ = CleanupPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   789→	return nil
   790→}

   792→// --- Helper functions ---
   793→
   794→// resolveTranscriptOffset determines the transcript offset to use for parsing.
   795→// Prefers pre-prompt state, falls back to session state.
   796→func resolveTranscriptOffset(ctx context.Context, preState *PrePromptState, sessionID string) int {
   797→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle")
   798→	if preState != nil && preState.TranscriptOffset > 0 {
   799→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "pre-prompt state found, parsing transcript from offset",
   800→			slog.Int("offset", preState.TranscriptOffset))
   801→		return preState.TranscriptOffset
   802→	}
   803→
   804→	// Fall back to session state
   805→	sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   806→	if loadErr != nil {
   807→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state",
   808→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   809→		return 0
   810→	}
   811→	if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   812→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "session state found, parsing transcript from offset",
   813→			slog.Int("offset", sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart))
   814→		return sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   815→	}
   816→
   817→	return 0
   818→}

   820→// parseTranscriptForCheckpointUUID is a thin wrapper around transcript parsing for checkpoint UUID lookup.
   821→// Returns parsed transcript lines for use with FindCheckpointUUID.
   822→func parseTranscriptForCheckpointUUID(transcriptPath string) ([]transcriptLine, error) {
   823→	lines, err := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   824→	if err != nil {
   825→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing transcript for checkpoint UUID: %w", err)
   826→	}
   827→	return lines, nil
   828→}

   830→// transitionSessionTurnEnd transitions the session phase to IDLE and dispatches turn-end actions.
   831→func transitionSessionTurnEnd(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, event *agent.Event) {
   832→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle")
   833→	turnState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   834→	if loadErr != nil {
   835→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state for turn end",
   836→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   837→		return
   838→	}
   839→	if turnState == nil {
   840→		return
   841→	}
   842→
   843→	persistEventMetadataToState(event, turnState)
   844→
   845→	if err := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, turnState, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); err != nil {
   846→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "turn-end transition failed",
   847→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   848→	}
   849→
   850→	// Always dispatch to strategy for turn-end handling. The strategy reads
   851→	// work items from state (e.g. TurnCheckpointIDs), not the action list.
   852→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   853→	if err := strat.HandleTurnEnd(ctx, turnState); err != nil {
   854→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "turn-end action dispatch failed",
   855→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   856→	}
   857→
   858→	if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, turnState); updateErr != nil {
   859→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session phase on turn end",
   860→			slog.String("error", updateErr.Error()))
   861→	}
   862→}
   863→
   864→// markSessionEnded transitions the session to ENDED phase via the state machine.
   865→// If event is non-nil, hook-provided metrics are persisted to state before saving.
   866→func markSessionEnded(ctx context.Context, event *agent.Event, sessionID string) error {
   867→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   868→	if err != nil {
   869→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   870→	}
   871→	if state == nil {
   872→		return nil // No state file, nothing to update
   873→	}
   874→
   875→	if event != nil {
   876→		persistEventMetadataToState(event, state)
   877→	}
   878→
   879→	if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, state, session.EventSessionStop, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   880→		logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), "session stop transition failed",
   881→			slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   882→	}
   883→
   884→	now := time.Now()
   885→	state.EndedAt = &now
   886→
   887→	if err := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
   888→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   889→	}
   890→	return nil
   891→}
   892→
   893→// logFileChanges logs the files modified, created, and deleted during a session.
   894→func logFileChanges(ctx context.Context, modified, newFiles, deleted []string) {
   895→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle")
   896→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "files changed during session",
   897→		slog.Int("modified", len(modified)),
   898→		slog.Int("new", len(newFiles)),
   899→		slog.Int("deleted", len(deleted)))
   900→}
   901→
   902→func persistEventMetadataToState(event *agent.Event, state *strategy.SessionState) {
   903→	// Update ModelName if provided (model is known by turn-end even on first turn)
   904→	if event.Model != "" {
   905→		state.ModelName = event.Model
   906→	}
   907→
   908→	// Persist hook-provided session metrics (e.g., from Cursor hooks)
   909→	if event.DurationMs > 0 {
   910→		state.SessionDurationMs = event.DurationMs
   911→	}
   912→	// Use hook-reported turn count if available (take max); otherwise
   913→	// increment on each TurnEnd event to count turns ourselves.
   914→	if event.TurnCount > 0 {
   915→		if event.TurnCount > state.SessionTurnCount {
   916→			state.SessionTurnCount = event.TurnCount
   917→		}
   918→	} else if event.Type == agent.TurnEnd {
   919→		state.SessionTurnCount++
   920→	}
   921→	if event.ContextTokens > 0 {
   922→		state.ContextTokens = event.ContextTokens
   923→	}
   924→	if event.ContextWindowSize > 0 {
   925→		state.ContextWindowSize = event.ContextWindowSize
   926→	}
   927→}

   124→	// transcripts mid-session (e.g., Cursor CLI flat → nested layout change).
   125→	// Errors are ignored; downstream readers handle missing transcripts gracefully.
   126→	resolveTranscriptPath(state) //nolint:errcheck,gosec // best-effort; downstream readers handle missing files
   127→
   128→	var sessionData *ExtractedSessionData
   129→	if hasShadowBranch {
   130→		var extractErr error
   131→		sessionData, extractErr = s.extractSessionData(ctx, repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, state.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, state.Phase.IsActive())
   132→		if extractErr != nil {
   133→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data: %w", extractErr)
   134→		}
   135→	} else {
   136→		if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
   137→			return nil, errors.New("shadow branch not found and no live transcript available")
   138→		}
   139→		if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   140→			prepareTranscriptIfNeeded(ctx, ag, state.TranscriptPath)
   141→		}
   142→		var extractErr error
   143→		sessionData, extractErr = s.extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(ctx, state)
   144→		if extractErr != nil {
   145→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data from live transcript: %w", extractErr)
   146→		}
   147→	}
   148→
   149→	// Backfill session state token usage from the freshly-extracted transcript.
   150→	// Some agents (e.g., Copilot CLI) write aggregate token data (session.shutdown)
   151→	// AFTER all hooks return, so state.TokenUsage from turn-end only has fallback data.
   152→	// By condensation time, the transcript has the authoritative totals.
   153→	// Only replace when we got authoritative data (e.g., session.shutdown provides
   154→	// InputTokens; the fallback path only captures OutputTokens). This avoids
   155→	// overwriting accumulated multi-checkpoint totals with partial checkpoint data.
   156→	if sessionData.TokenUsage != nil && sessionData.TokenUsage.InputTokens > 0 {
   157→		state.TokenUsage = sessionData.TokenUsage
   158→	}
   159→
   160→	// For 1:1 checkpoint model: filter files_touched to only include files actually
   161→	// committed in this specific commit. This ensures each checkpoint represents
   162→	// exactly the files in that commit, not all files mentioned in the transcript.
   163→	if len(committedFiles) > 0 {
   164→		hadFilesBeforeFiltering := len(sessionData.FilesTouched) > 0
   165→
   166→		if hadFilesBeforeFiltering {
   167→			filtered := make([]string, 0, len(sessionData.FilesTouched))
   168→			for _, f := range sessionData.FilesTouched {
   169→				if _, ok := committedFiles[f]; ok {
   170→					filtered = append(filtered, f)
   171→				}
   172→			}
   173→			sessionData.FilesTouched = filtered
   174→		}
   175→
   176→		if len(sessionData.FilesTouched) == 0 && !hadFilesBeforeFiltering {
   177→			sessionData.FilesTouched = make([]string, 0, len(committedFiles))
   178→			for f := range committedFiles {
   179→				sessionData.FilesTouched = append(sessionData.FilesTouched, f)
   180→			}
   181→		}
   182→	}
   183→
   184→	// Get checkpoint store
   185→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   186→	if err != nil {
   187→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   188→	}
   189→
   190→	// Get author info
   191→	authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
   192→
   193→	// Determine attribution base commit
   194→	attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   195→	if attrBase == "" {
   196→		attrBase = state.BaseCommit
   197→	}
   198→
   199→	attribution := calculateSessionAttributions(ctx, repo, ref, sessionData, state, attributionOpts{
   200→		headTree:              o.headTree,
   201→		repoDir:               o.repoDir,
   202→		attributionBaseCommit: attrBase,
   203→		headCommitHash:        o.headCommitHash,
   204→	})
   205→
   206→	// Get current branch name
   207→	branchName := GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
   208→
   209→	// Generate summary if enabled
   210→	var summary *cpkg.Summary
   211→	if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled(ctx) && len(sessionData.Transcript) > 0 {
   212→		summarizeCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "summarize")
   213→
   214→		var scopedTranscript []byte
   215→		switch state.AgentType {
   216→		case agent.AgentTypeGemini:
   217→			scoped, sliceErr := geminicli.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   218→			if sliceErr != nil {
   219→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "failed to scope Gemini transcript for summary",
   220→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   221→					slog.String("error", sliceErr.Error()))
   222→			}
   223→			scopedTranscript = scoped
   224→		case agent.AgentTypeOpenCode:
   225→			scoped, sliceErr := opencode.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   226→			if sliceErr != nil {
   227→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "failed to scope OpenCode transcript for summary",
   228→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   229→					slog.String("error", sliceErr.Error()))
   230→			}
   231→			scopedTranscript = scoped
   232→		case agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode, agent.AgentTypeCursor, agent.AgentTypeFactoryAIDroid, agent.AgentTypeUnknown:
   233→			scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   234→		}
   235→		if len(scopedTranscript) > 0 {
   236→			var err error
   237→			summary, err = summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(summarizeCtx, scopedTranscript, sessionData.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, nil)
   238→			if err != nil {
   239→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "summary generation failed",
   240→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   241→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   242→			} else {
   243→				logging.Info(summarizeCtx, "summary generated",
   244→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
   245→			}
   246→		}
   247→	}
   248→
   249→	// Write checkpoint metadata using the checkpoint store
   250→	if err := store.WriteCommitted(ctx, cpkg.WriteCommittedOptions{
   251→		CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
   252→		SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
   253→		Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
   254→		Branch:                      branchName,
   255→		Transcript:                  sessionData.Transcript,
   256→		Prompts:                     sessionData.Prompts,
   257→		FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
   258→		CheckpointsCount:            state.StepCount,
   259→		EphemeralBranch:             shadowBranchName,
   260→		AuthorName:                  authorName,
   261→		AuthorEmail:                 authorEmail,
   262→		Agent:                       state.AgentType,
   263→		Model:                       state.ModelName,
   264→		TurnID:                      state.TurnID,
   265→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: state.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
   266→		CheckpointTranscriptStart:   state.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
   267→		TokenUsage:                  sessionData.TokenUsage,
   268→		SessionMetrics:              buildSessionMetrics(state),
   269→		InitialAttribution:          attribution,
   270→		Summary:                     summary,
   271→	}); err != nil {
   272→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	return &CondenseResult{
   276→		CheckpointID:         checkpointID,
   277→		SessionID:            state.SessionID,
   278→		CheckpointsCount:     state.StepCount,
   279→		FilesTouched:         sessionData.FilesTouched,
   280→		Prompts:              sessionData.Prompts,
   281→		TotalTranscriptLines: sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
   282→		Transcript:           sessionData.Transcript,
   283→	}, nil
   284→}

   286→// buildSessionMetrics creates a SessionMetrics from session state if any metrics are available.
   287→// Returns nil if no hook-provided metrics exist (e.g., for agents that don't report them).
   288→func buildSessionMetrics(state *SessionState) *cpkg.SessionMetrics {
   289→	if state.SessionDurationMs == 0 && state.SessionTurnCount == 0 && state.ContextTokens == 0 && state.ContextWindowSize == 0 {
   290→		return nil
   291→	}
   292→	return &cpkg.SessionMetrics{
   293→		DurationMs:        state.SessionDurationMs,
   294→		TurnCount:         state.SessionTurnCount,
   295→		ContextTokens:     state.ContextTokens,
   296→		ContextWindowSize: state.ContextWindowSize,
   297→	}
   298→}
